निःस्वन: निःस्वन निः-स्वन, अस्, m. (fr. स्वन् with निस्), sound, noise, voice; [cf. नि-स्वन।]
निःस्वभाव: निःस्वभाव निः-स्वभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, void of peculiarities, without peculiar properties.
निःस्वादु: निःस्वादु निः-स्वादु, उस्, उस् or द्वी, उ, taste-less, void of flavour, insipid, unsavoury.
निःस्वाध्याय: निःस्वाध्याय निः-स्वाध्याय, अस्, आ, अम्, not muttering prayers, not repeating texts. —निःस्वा-ध्याय-वषट्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, neither repeating holy texts nor sacrificing.
निकक्ष: निकक्ष नि-कक्ष, अस्, m., Ved. the armpit.
निकट: निकट नि-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, situated at the side, near, proximate, close by; without neighbours, kinless?; (अस्, अम्), m. n. proximity; (ए), ind. in the neighbourhood, at hand. —निकटी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, approached.
निकथित: निकथित नि-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, told, re-lated (?).
निकथितिन्: निकथितिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has told.
निकम्: निकम् नि-कम्, cl. 10. A. -कामयते, -च-कमे, &c., to long for, wish for, have a desire for, lust after (with acc.).
निकाम: नि-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desirous of, longing for, vehemently desiring, (often at the beginning of a comp. in the sense of नि-कामम्, ind.); (अस्), m. desire, wish; (अम्), ind. according to wish or desire, willingly, according to pleasure or to one's satisfaction, to one's heart's content; यदा निकामम्, if you please, if you like. —निकाम-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, covetous. —निकाम-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, raining ac-cording to wish.
निकामन्: नि-कामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. desirous of, longing for.
निकामन: नि-कामन, अम्, n. desire, longing after.
निकामयमान: नि-कामयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, longing for, wish-ing for.
निकर: निकर नि-कर, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कॄ with नि), a heap, pile; a flock or multitude; a bundle; pith, sap, essence; suitable gift, a honorarium; a treasure, the best of anything, a treasure belonging to Kuvera.
निकार: 1. नि-कार, अस्, m. piling up or winnowing corn; tossing or lifting up.
निकार 1. and 2. नि-कार। For 1. see above; for 2. see under नि-कृ, p. 483, col. 1.
2. नि-कार, अस्, m. putting down, bringing down, humiliation, subjugation; injury, insult, wrong, offence; wickedness, malice, abuse, reproach, disrespect; op-position, contradiction.
निकष: निकष नि-कष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कष् for कर्ष् = कृष् with नि), the touchstone, the streak of gold or test made on it [cf. नि-काष]; (आ), f., N. of the mother of Rāvaṇa or of the mother of the Piśitāśana fiends or imps in general. —निकषात्-मज (°षा-आत्°), अस्, m. a Rākṣasa, a sort of demon; [cf. कषा-पुत्र।]
निकषा: नि-कषा, ind. near to (with acc.), proximate; in the middle, betwixt, between (with acc.).
निकषाय: निकषाय, Nom. A. निकषायते, &c., to be used or serve as a touchstone.
निकस: निकस नि-कस, निकसात्मज = नि-कष and निकषात्मज, q. v.
निकाणम्: निकाणम् नि-काणम्, ind. (fr. rt. कण् with नि), having closed the eyes; निकाणम् अक्षि जल्-पति or अक्षि-निकाणं जल्पति, he speaks with closed eyes.
निकाय: निकाय नि-काय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. चि with नि), a heap, an assemblage, a group, class, association or set of persons who perform like duties; a congre-gation, a school; a flock, multitude in general; a house, dwelling-place, habitation, hiding-place; the body; (according to Mahī-dhara) the air, wind (Ved.); a butt, aim, mark; the universal Soul, Supreme Being. —निकायान्तरीय (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to another assemblage or school.
निकायिन्: नि-कायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, an epithet of particular oblations or sacrifices.
निकाय्य: नि-काय्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), a dwelling, house.
निकारिन्: नि-कारिन्, ई, m., Ved. an injurer, oppressor.
निकावल्गा: निकावल्गा निकावल्गा, f., N. of a woman, (perhaps rather two names, निका and वल्गा।)
निकाश: निकाश नि-काश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. काश् with नि), the horizon; appearance, sight; (at the end of an adj. comp.) having the appearance of, similar, like; [cf. नी-काश।]
निकाषम्: निकाषम् नि-काषम्, ind. having pounded or mixed together.
निकिल्बिष: निकिल्बिष नि-किल्बिष, अम्, n., Ved. freeing from sin, deliverance from evil.
निकुचिति: निकुचिति नि-कुचिति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. कुञ्च् with नि), contraction ?; [cf. Pāṇ. I. 2, 18.]
निकुच्यकर्णि: निकुच्य-कर्णि, ind. with the ears hanging down.
निकुञ्चक: नि-कुञ्चक, अस्, m. a measure of capacity equal to (1/4) of a Kuḍava; a species of reed (= वानीर).
निकुञ्ज: निकुञ्ज नि-कुञ्ज, अस्, अम्, m. n. = कुञ्ज, an arbour, a bower, a place overgrown with shrubs and creepers, a thicket.
निकुञ्जिकाम्ला: निकुञ्जिकाम्ला (°का-अम्°), f. a species of plant (= कुञ्जिका, कुञ्ज-वल्लरी).
निकुम्भ: निकुम्भ नि-कुम्भ, अस्, m. the plant Croton Polyandrum; N. of a Dānava who, like Kumbha, was son of Pra-hlāda, (he was father of Sunda and Upa-sunda); N. of a Rakṣas; of a son of Kumbha-karṇa; of an attendant of Śiva; of one of Skanda's attendants; N. of one of the Viśve Devāḥ, (also read विस्कुम्भु); N. of a hero on the side of the Kurus; N. of a king of Ayodhyā, son of Hary-aśva and father of Saṃhatāśva; (ई), f. the plant Croton Polyandrum. —निकुम्भाख्य-जीव (°भ-आख्°), अम्, n. a plant, Croton Jamalgota (= जय-पाल).
निकुम्भित: नि-कुम्भित, अम्, n. a kind of time in music.
निकुम्भिला: नि-कुम्भिला, f. (fr. कुम्भ, a jar?), a place where oblations are offered; a grove at the western gate of Laṅkā for the performance of sacrificial rites; (according to another commentator) an image of Bhadra-kālī on the west side of Laṅkā; (also, according to some, नि-कुम्भिलस्, m., and नि-कुम्-भिलम्, n.)
निकुरुम्ब: निकुरुम्ब नि-कुरुम्ब or नि-कुरुम्बक, अम्, n. a flock, mass, multitude; (also read नि-कुरम्ब, -नि-कुरूम्ब, नि-कुरुम्भ।)
निकुलीनिका: निकुलीनिका नि-कुलीनिका, f. a family art or one inherited by birth, any skill or skilful act pecu-liar to a race.
निकूल: निकूल नि-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, going down hill, (opposed to उत्-कूल); standing on a declivity or bank.
निकृ: निकृ नि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to put down, bring down, lower, humiliate, subdue, overcome, overpower, depreciate, debase; to act in a low or base manner, to treat ill; (in the post-Vedic literature only occurring in the past part. नि-कृत, q. v.): Desid. नि-चिकीर्षति, to wish to subdue.
निकर्तव्य: नि-कर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acted badly or basely, to be injured; (अस्माकं तैर् निकर्तव्यम्, a wrong is to be done us by them.)
निकृत: नि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought down, lowered, cast down, humbled, humiliated; insulted, offended; afflicted; injured; tricked, cheated, deceived; re-moved, set aside, dismissed; dishonest, wicked, per-verse; low, base, vile; (अम्), n. lowering, humbling, humiliation; (also read नि-कृति।) —निकृत-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, evil-minded. —निकृत-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, depraved in mind.
निकृति: नि-कृति, इस्, f. low conduct, baseness, wicked-ness, dishonest practice, dishonesty, fraud, deception, deceit, cheating; offence, insult; abuse, reproach; rejection, removal; poverty, indigence; wickedness, a wicked person (personified as a daughter of A-dharma and Hiṃsā, or Nirṛti); (इस्, इस्, इ), base, low, dishonest, wicked; (इस्), m., N. of one of the eight Vasus. —निकृति-प्रज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, versed in dishonesty, well acquainted with vice.
निकृतिन्: निकृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. नि-कृत), = नि-कृति, dis-honest, low, base, wicked.
निकृत्या: नि-कृत्या, f. wickedness, dishonesty, fraud, &c., = नि-कृति।
निकृत्वन्: नि-कृत्वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. acting basely, deceitful.
निकृत्: निकृत् नि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut down, hew down, cut away, cut or chop off, cut through, cut asunder, cut to pieces, massacre; tear off, tear away, wear away; A. (-ते), to cut one-self (or one's nails &c.); to cut down &c.: Caus. -कर्तयति, &c., to cause to cut or cut down.
निकर्तन: नि-कर्तन, अम्, n. cutting down, cutting to pieces, cutting off.
निकृत्त: नि-कृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cut off, cut up. —निकृत्त-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, cut up by the roots.
निकृन्तन: नि-कृन्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, cutting down, cutting off, destroying; (अस्), m., N. of a hell; (अम्), n. massacring, cutting, cutting off, destruction; an in-strument for cutting.
निकृष्: निकृष् नि-कृष्, cl. 1. 6. P. -कर्षति, -कृ-षति, -कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw down, drag down; to tear asunder (?). In Mahā-bh. 1. 3616. नि-कृष्यते may mean ‘is drawn down by the stream of a river.’
निकर्षण: नि-कर्षण, अम्, n. an open space for recreation, a sort of play-ground in or near a town; a court at the entrance of a house; a neighbourhood.
निकृष्ट: नि-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, debased, low, base, vile, vulgar; despised, outcast; near; (अम्), n. vicinity, proximity. —निकृष्टाशय (°ट-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having base intentions. —निकृष्टाशय-ता, f. the state of one who has base intentions, base disposition of mind; jealousy. —निकृष्टोपाधि-ता (°ट-उप्°), f. a state of base or low deception.
निकेचाय: निकेचाय नि-केचाय, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. चि with नि), piling or collecting repeatedly.
निकेत: निकेत नि-केत or नि-केतक, अस्, m. = केतन, a house, mansion, habitation; a mark, countersign.
निकेतन: निकेतन नि-केतन, अस्, m. an onion; (अम्), n. = नि-केत, a house, mansion, abode, habitation, temple.
निकोचक: निकोचक नि-कोचक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुञ्च् with नि), the tree Alangium Decapetalum; (अम्), n. the fruit of this tree.
निकोचन: नि-कोचन, अम्, n. contracting, contraction, com-pression.
निकोठक: निकोठक नि-कोठक, अस्, m. = नि-कोचक above.
निकोथक: निकोथक नि-कोथक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कुथ् with नि), N. of a teacher with the epithet Bhāyajātya.
निकोश्य: निकोश्य नि-कोश्य, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a particular part of the entrails of sacrificial animals; [cf. कोश्य।]
निक्तहस्त: निक्तहस्त निक्त-हस्त। See rt. निज्, p. 485.
निक्रन्द्: निक्रन्द् नि-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. -क्रन्दति, -क्रन्-दितुम्, Ved. to utter a cry in a direction downwards (as a bird on a tree): Caus. -क्रन्दयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to roar &c.
निक्रम्: निक्रम् नि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति, -क्र-मितुम्, to set the foot on the ground, put down the feet; to enter; to tread down (with acc.)
निक्रमण: नि-क्रमण, अम्, n., Ved. putting down the feet, treading down; the place where the foot is put, foot-step, foot-fall.
निक्रीड्: निक्रीड् नि-क्रीड्, Caus. -क्रीडयति, &c., to play, sport.
निक्रीड: नि-क्रीड, अस्, m. play, sport; मरुतां निक्रीडः, N. of a Sāman.
निक्वण: निक्वण नि-क्वण or नि-क्वाण, अस्, m. a musical tone or sound; any sound.
निक्ष्: निक्ष् निक्ष्, cl. 1. P. निक्षति, &c., to pierce (Ved.); to kiss.
निक्षा: निक्षा निक्षा, f. a nit; (a wrong form for लिक्षा।)
निक्षिप्: निक्षिप् नि-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A. -क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw down, cast or put down, throw upon, put or lay down; put in, pour in; to deliver anything (acc.) to a person (loc.); to give or hand over, grant; to deposit, commit, deliver to any one's charge, intrust; to install, appoint, establish; to lay aside, give up, leave off, cast off, repel; to encamp: Caus. -क्षेपयति, &c., to cause to put down, to cause to be set down in writing.
निक्षिपत्: नि-क्षिपत्, अन्, अन्ती or अती, अत्, throwing down or on, placing in or upon.
निक्षिप्त: नि-क्षिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown down or upon, put down, laid down or on, placed into, thrust into; deposited, pawned, pledged; rejected, abandoned, foregone, given or thrown away; sent, sent off or away. —निक्षिप्त-वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has ceased talking or left off boasting.
निक्षिप्य: नि-क्षिप्य, ind. having placed or laid down or upon; having given in charge, having intrusted or deposited in a place of safety.
निक्षेप: नि-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing upon, casting on (with loc.); a deposit, pledge, trust, anything de-posited without a seal in trust or as a compensation, anything pawned; abandoning, parting with, throw-ing away; sending or putting away; wiping, drying; in निक्षेप-लिपि probably N. of a country; [cf. उत्-क्षेप, प्र-क्षेप, वि-क्षेप।]
निक्षेपण: नि-क्षेपण, अम्, n. putting down (the feet); a means by which or place in which anything is kept.
निक्षेपित: नि-क्षेपित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be put down or set down in writing, committed to writing, in-scribed.
निक्षेप्तृ: नि-क्षेप्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what places or deposits, delivers to one's care; (ता), m. a depositor, a pawner or pledger.
निक्षेप्य: नि-क्षेप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited, to be thrust into.
निक्षुभा: निक्षुभा नि-क्षुभा, f. (fr. rt. क्षुभ् with नि), N. of the mother of Maga.
निखन्: निखन् नि-खन्, cl. 1. P. A. -खनति, -ते, -खनितुम्, to dig into (the ground), bury; to dig in or up, root up; to infix, pierce (with an arrow &c.), to fix, implant.
निखनन: नि-खनन, अम्, n. digging in, burying.
निखात: नि-खात, अस्, आ, अम्, dug in, buried; dug up, excavated; fixed in the ground as a stake.
निखानित: नि-खानित, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. the Caus.), infixed, dug in, fixed.
निखर्ब: निखर्ब नि-खर्ब or नि-खर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, dwarfish, a dwarf; (अम्), n. a billion; [cf. खर्व।]
निखर्वट: नि-खर्वट, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas.
निखिद्: निखिद् नि-खिद्, cl. 6. P., Ved. -खिदति, -खेत्तुम्, to press down; (Sāy.) to cut off, remove.
निखिल: निखिल नि-खिल, अस्, आ, अम् (probably for निः-खिल), complete, all, whole, entire; (एन), ind. completely, totally; [cf. खिल, अ-ख्°।]
निखुर्यप: निखुर्यप निखुर्य-प (?), अस्, m., Ved. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
निगड: निगड नि-गड, अस्, अम्, m. n. (probably fr. rt. गड् = rt. गल्; cf. नि-गल), an iron chain for the feet, a fetter, especially the chain used to secure the hind feet of an elephant or a noose for catching the feet and throwing an animal down, a fetter or shackle in general, gyves.
निगडन: नि-गडन, अम्, n. putting in irons or fetters, binding, fettering.
निगडय: निगडय, Nom. P. निगडयति, &c., to put in irons or fetters, to bind, fetter.
निगडित: नि-गडित, अस्, आ, अम्, chained, bound, tied, &c.
निगण: निगण नि-गण, अस्, m. the smoke of a burnt offering or sacrificial fire; [cf. नि-गरण।]
निगद्: निगद् नि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, &c., to recite, proclaim, declare, communicate, tell, speak, say, shout out; to speak to, address any one (with acc.), to tell anything to any one (with two acc.); to enumerate; to call: Pass. -गद्यते, &c., to be re-cited, to be named or called: Caus. -गादयति, &c., to cause to recite, tell, &c.
निगद: नि-गद or नि-गाद, अस्, m. reciting, audible recitation of prayers or charms; a prayer or sacrificial formula recited aloud; mention, mentioning; speech, speaking, discourse; N. of a teacher with the epithet Pārṇavalki.
निगदत्: नि-गदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, reciting, addressing, speaking, saying, speaking to.
निगदित: नि-गदित, अस्, आ, अम्, recited, told, said, spoken; (अम्), n. speech. —निगदित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has spoken, having spoken.
निगद्य: नि-गद्य, ind. having told, having declared.
निगाद: नि-गाद, अस्, m. speech, discourse, recitation, &c.
निगादिन्: नि-गादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, reciting, telling, speaking, &c.
निगम्: निगम् नि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्, to settle down upon (Ved.); to enter (acc. or loc.); inire feminam (Ved.); to go to any place or state, to undergo, become (e. g. शान्तिं नि-गम्, to be-come pacified); to be inserted: Caus. -गमयति, to cause to go in, to insert.
निगम: नि-गम, अस्, m. insertion, especially of the name of a deity into a liturgical formula; the place or passage in a book where a word occurs, especially a passage of the Vedas or the actual word quoted from such a passage; the Veda or the Vedic text; the root (as the source from which a word comes); a sacred precept, the words of a god or holy man; certainty, assurance; a town, a city; a market, a fair; a road, a market road; trade, traffic; a camp or caravan of itinerant merchants, a merchant; = लुण्डी; (अम्), n. a particular number.
निगमन: नि-गमन, अम्, n. insertion, quotation of words (from the Veda &c.) or the word &c. quoted; the conclusion in a syllogism, the deduction; going in or into.
निगमिन्: निगमिन्, ई, इनी, इ, familiar with or versed in the Vedas or in holy writ.
निगर्ह्: निगर्ह् नि-गर्ह्, cl. 10. P. -गर्हयति, -यि-तुम्, to disdain, despise.
निगल्: निगल् नि-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, &c., to fall down (?).
निगल: नि-गल, अस्, अम्, m. n. = नि-गड, q. v.
निगा: निगा नि-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, &c., to go into, enter, attach one's self to; to come or get into any state &c.; to nestle.
निगु: निगु नि-गु, उस्, m. = मनस्, the mind, the faculty of feeling and reasoning; (according to others) dirt, excrement [cf. rt. 4. गु]; a root; painting; (उस्, उस्, उ), pleasing, charming.
निगुत्: निगुत् नि-गुत्, त्, m. (probably fr. rt. 3. गु with नि), Ved. (according to Sāy.) an enemy; [cf. नैगुत।]
निगुह्: निगुह् नि-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते, गूहितुम्, to cover, conceal, hide: Caus. -गूहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to cover or hide.
निगूढ: नि-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, concealed; profound, recondite, mysterious, obscure; (अम्), ind. privately, secretly. —निगूढ-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, secret in operation. —निगूढ-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, well con-cealed or hidden. —निगूढ-निश्चय, अस्, आ, अम्, whose resolve or determination is concealed. —नि-गूढ-रोमन्, आ, आ, अ, having concealed hair. —निगूढार्थ (°ढ-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a hidden sense or purpose, difficult to be understood, abstruse, occult.
निगूढक: नि-गूढक, अस्, m. a species of wild bean; [cf. वन-मुद्ग।]
निगूहक: नि-गूहक, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding, concealing.
निगूहनीय: नि-गूहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hidden or con-cealed; to be covered or protected or defended.
निगृहीत: नि-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, seized, arrested; held back, restrained, confined, subdued, checked; harassed, assailed, attacked.
निगॄ: निगॄ नि-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति and -गिलति, &c., to swallow, swallow up, swallow down, ingur-gitate, devour: Caus. Pass. -गार्यते and -गाल्यते: Intens., Ved. -जेगिल्यते, -गल्गलीति, to swallow with a gurgling sound.
निगरण: नि-गरण, अम्, n. swallowing, devouring, deglu-tition; (अस्), m. the throat, the gullet, esophagus; the smoke of a burnt offering; [cf. नि-गण।]
निगार: नि-गार, अस्, m. swallowing, swallowing down, devouring.
निगारक: नि-गारक, अस्, इका, अम्, = नि-गालक, swallowing.
निगाल: नि-गाल, अस्, m. the throat or neck of a horse; [cf. गल, नि-गरण।] —निगाल-वत्, आन्, m. a horse.
निगालक: नि-गालक, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowing, devouring.
निगीर्ण: नि-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, swallowed; (metaphorically) left out, omitted, not expressed; (अ-निगीर्ण, ex-pressed.)
निगीर्यमाण: नि-गीर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being swallowed down; (with act. sense?), swallowing, devouring.
निगै: निगै नि-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to accompany with song; to sing, chant; to proclaim, announce.
निगीत: नि-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung, chanted; said.
निग्रन्थ्: निग्रन्थ् नि-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. P. -ग्रथ्नाति, &c., to intertwine, interweave.
निग्रन्थन: नि-ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. (probably a corruption of नि-क्रन्थन; cf. क्रथ्, क्रथन), killing, de-stroying, slaughter; [cf. निर्-ग्रन्थन।]
निग्रह्: निग्रह् नि-ग्रह्, in the older language नि-ग्रभ्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -गृह्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to hold down, keep down, de-press, keep under, keep in check; to keep back, hold back, stop, obstruct, restrain, suppress, con-fine; to seize, catch, apprehend, hold, hold fast; to oppress, overpower, subdue, conquer; to chastise, punish, tame; to draw together, contract, close (as the eyes): Caus. -ग्राहयति, to cause to be apprehended or seized: Caus. of the Desid. -जिघृक्षयति, to cause any one to desire to keep under or suppress.
निगृहीति: नि-गृहीति, इस्, f. restraint, check; overpowering.
निगृहीतृ: नि-गृहीतृ, wrong form for नि-ग्रहीतृ, q. v.
निगृह्णत्: नि-गृह्णत्, अन्, अती, अत्, seizing, taking; keeping, suppressing, restraining.
निगृह्य: 1. नि-गृह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be held back; to be punished, punishable; deserving chastisement or reproof.
2. नि-गृह्य, ind. having taken; having arrested or confined; having restrained or suppressed.
निग्रह: नि-ग्रह, अस्, m. keeping down, holding down, keeping under, keeping back, keeping in check, coercion, restraining, binding, restraint, subjugation, subduing, restraint of the appetite &c., abstinence; obstruction, suppression, putting down; seizing, catching, confinement, capture, arrest; the arresting or suppressing of disease, cure; taking down, hum-bling, punishing, punishment, chastisement, rebuke, rebuff, reprimand, blame; aversion, dislike, disgust; (in the Nyāya phil.) putting down in argument, fault in a syllogism, flaw in an argument, failure in proof; any place for catching hold of, a handle; a boundary, a limit; N. of Śiva and of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa. —निग्रह-स्थान, अम्, n. the predicament of rebuke for failure in argument.
निग्रहण: नि-ग्रहण, अस्, आ, अम्, holding down, holding back, suppressing; (अम्), n. subduing, suppression; capture, confinement, prison; defeat, punishment.
निग्रहीतव्य: नि-ग्रहीतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be chastised or punished, punishable.
निग्रहीतृ: नि-ग्रहीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who seizes or lays hold of; one who keeps back or prevents; seizing, restraining, binding.
निग्राभ: नि-ग्राभ, अस्, m., Ved. pressing down; N. of a verse recited when the Soma plants are pressed.
निग्राभ्य: नि-ग्राभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., with आपस्, the water with which the Soma plants are sprinkled before they are pressed.
निग्राह: नि-ग्राह, अस्, m. punishment, chastisement, (used in imprecations, e. g. निग्राहस् ते भूयात्, confusion seize thee, &c.)
निग्राह्य: नि-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suppressed or punished, punishable.
निघ: निघ नि-घ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. हन् with नि), as high as broad; (anything) whose height and cir-cumference are equal; a round or circle, a ball; sin. —निघानिघ (°घ-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of different forms or sizes.
निघण्ट: निघण्ट नि-घण्ट (said to be fr. rt. गम् or हन् or हृ with नि; gender doubtful), a word; a glossary or collection of words or names, (in this sense properly pl.); often the collection of Vedic words explained in the Nirukta, see नि-घण्टु below.
निघण्टि: नि-घण्टि, probably only a wrong form for नि-घण्ट or नि-घण्टु।
निघण्टिका: नि-घण्टिका, f. a species of bulbous plant (= गुलञ्च-कन्द).
निघण्टु: नि-घण्टु, उस्, m. (or नि-घण्टुक), any vocabu-lary or collection of words or names, but especially a N. of the Vedic glossary explained by Yāska in his Nirukta, (in this sense usually pl. निघण्टवस् as embracing five chapters.) —निघण्टु-भाष्य, अम्, n. ‘commentary on part of the Nighaṇṭus,’ N. of a work by Deva-rāja on the three chapters of synonyms incompletely treated by Yāska. —निघण्टु-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of glossaries,’ N. of a medical lexicon commonly called Abhidhāna-cūḍā-maṇi.
निघर्ष: नि-घर्ष, अस्, m. rubbing, friction, pounding, crushing.
निघस: निघस नि-घस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घस् with नि), eating; food, victuals.
निघात: निघात नि-घात, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus. of rt. हन् with नि), a blow, stroke; suppression of accent, absence of accent.
निघाति: नि-घाति, इस्, f. an iron club or mace or hammer (?).
निघातिन्: नि-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking down, killing, de-stroying.
निघुष्: निघुष् नि-घुष् (rt. 2. घुष् = घृष् with नि), Caus. P. -घोषयति, -यितुम्, to tread down, trample under foot, crush, pound, grind.
निघुष्ट: निघुष्ट नि-घुष्ट, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. घुष् with नि), sound, noise.
निघृष्: निघृष् नि-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, &c., to rub into, rub down, rub, pound, grind, triturate; graze, chafe, abrade, wear away by rubbing, excoriate.
निघर्षण: नि-घर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, friction, grinding, trituration; [cf. निर्-घर्षण।]
निघृष्ट: नि-घृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground; chafed, worn, grazed, abraded, excoriated; subdued.
निघृष्व: नि-घृष्व, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed off, abraded, excoriated; small, insignificant; (अस्), m. a hoof; wind; an ass or a mule; a boar; a road; (अम्), n. the mark of a hoof (?).
निघ्न: निघ्न नि-घ्न, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. नि-हन्), depend-ant, subservient, docile; dependant on a substantive (as an adjective); (after a numeral) multiplied with; (अस्), m., N. of a son of An-araṇya and father of An-amitra; of a son of An-amitra.
निघ्नक: निघ्न-क, अस्, आ, अम्, = नि-घ्न, dependant.
निघ्नत्: नि-घ्नत्, अन्, अती, अत्, smiting, slaying, killing, destroying, overcoming.
निघ्नान: नि-घ्नान, अस्, आ, अम्, slaying, killing.
निचक्र: निचक्र नि-चक्र, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
निचङ्कुण: निचङ्कुण नि-चङ्कुण for नि-चुङ्कुण, q. v.
निचन्द्र: निचन्द्र नि-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.
निचमन: निचमन नि-चमन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. चम् with नि), sipping, taking liquid into the mouth.
निचय: निचय नि-चय। See under 1. नि-चि below.

नि-चय, अस्, m. piling up, heaping up; collection, heap, multitude, quantity, store, stock, provisions (e. g. षण्-मास-निचय, provisioned for six months); assemblage, assemblage or collection of parts con-stituting a whole (e. g. शरीर-निचय, the assem-blage of parts of which the body consists; वधू-निचय, a collection of women); certainty, ascertain-ment (in this sense for निश्-चय, q. v.).
निचाङ्कुण: निचाङ्कुण नि-चङ्कुण for नि-चुङ्कुण, q. v.
निचाय्: निचाय् नि-चाय्, cl. 1. P. -चायति, &c. (oc-curring only in the form नि-चाय्य), Ved. to regard with reverence, honour, worship; to see; [cf. rt. 4. चि।]
निचाय्य: नि-चाय्य, ind. having seen, having observed.
निचि: निचि 1. नि-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -चिनुते, -चेतुम्, to pile up, heap up.
निचि 2. नि-चि, cl. 3. P. -चिकेति, -चिकाय, &c., Ved. to observe, perceive, recognise: Desid., Ved. -चिकीषते, to observe, watch, guard.
निचयिन्: नि-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heaped up, containing a quantity, full of, abounding in.
निचाय: नि-चाय, अस्, m. a heap (as a measure).
निचित: नि-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, piled up, heaped up, full of, filled; covered, overspread; raised up; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a warrior-tribe [cf. नैचित्य]; (आ), f., N. of a river.
निचेकाय: नि-चेकाय, अस्, m. (fr. the Intens.), continual or repeated piling up.
निचेय: नि-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be piled or heaped up.
निचिर: नि-चिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. attentive, observant, vigilant; (आ), m. du. epithet of Mitra-Varuṇa; (Sāy.) excessively ancient (= नितरां चिरन्तनौ).
निचिर नि-चिर। See under 2. नि-चि above.
निचेतृ: नि-चेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. an observer; observing, paying attention.
निचिकी: निचिकी निचिकी, f. an excellent cow (= नैचिकी, q. v.).
निचुङ्कुण: निचुङ्कुण नि-चुङ्कुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. Intens. of rt. कुण्?), Ved. roaring, murmuring; (अस्), m., N. of a Vāruṇi; (often read नि-चङ्कुण or नि-चाङ्कुण।)
निचुम्पुण: निचुम्पुण नि-चुम्पुण, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. चुप्?), Ved. an epithet of Soma (because, according to Yāska, निचमनेन प्रीणाति); of the Ava-bhṛtha; of the sea (because, according to Yāska, निचमनेन पूर्यते); moving about?; (अस्), m., N. of a Śaunaḥśepha.
निचुल: निचुल नि-चुल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चुल् with नि), the tree Barringtonia Acutangula, commonly called Hijjal, = वेतस; = नि-चोल, an upper garment, over-coat; (also read नि-चूल।)
निचुलक: नि-चुलक, अम्, n. an outer garment; a breast-plate, a cuirass.
निचोल: नि-चोल, अस्, m. a cover, wrapper, veil, surtout.
निचोलक: नि-चोलक, अस्, m. a sort of jacket, bodice, mantle, but especially a soldier's jacket serving as a cuirass or breast-plate; (अम्), n. = नि-चुलक।
निचृत्: निचृत् 1. नि-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्ति-तुम्, to insert, infix, fix into.
2. नि-चृत्, त्, f. a defective metre; [cf. अति-न्°, नि-वृत्।]
निचेरु: निचेरु नि-चेरु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. चर् with नि), Ved. gliding; creeping; an epithet of the Ava-bhṛtha.
निच्छवि: निच्छवि निच्छवि, इस्, f., N. of a district (= तीर-भुक्ति), the modern Tirhut; [cf. लिच्छवि।]
निच्छिद्र: निच्छिद्र नि-च्छिद्र for निश्-छिद्र, q. v.
निच्छिवि: निच्छिवि निच्छिवि, इस्, m., N. of one of the degraded castes sprung from the outcast or Vrātya Kṣatriyas (see Manu X. 22; their occupation appears to have been the public exhibition of gymnastic performances &c., as they are classed with the Jhallas, Mallas, and others).
निच्छेद: निच्छेद नि-च्छेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. छिद् with नि), cutting off; (in arithmetic) leaving no common measure, reduced by the common divisor to the least term so as not to allow of further reduction (in this sense for निश्-छेद).
निज्: निज् निज्, cl. 3. P. A. नेनेक्ति (3rd pl. नेनिजति), नेनिक्ते, निनेज, निनिजे, नेक्ता, नेक्ष्यति, -ते, अनिजत्, अनैक्षीत्, अनिक्त, नेक्तुम्, to wash, clean, cleanse, purify; A. to wash or clean one's self; to nourish: Pass. निज्यते, &c., to be washed: Caus. नेजयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अनीनि-जत्: Desid. निनिक्षति, -ते: Intens. नेनिज्यते, नेनिजीति, नेनेक्ति; [cf. rt. निञ्ज्: Zend śnizh, ‘to snow:’ Gr. νίζ-ω, νίπ-τ-ω, χέρ-νιβ-α (acc.) νίπ-τρο-ν, νῐ́φ-α (acc.), νιφ-ά(δ)-ς, νῐφ-ετό-ς, νῑ́φει: Lat. Nep-tūnu-s = νιπτόμενο-ς, ‘bathing;’ ning-i-t, ningu-i-t, ningu-i-s, nix, base niv for nigv: Goth. snaivs, ‘snow:’ Old Germ. sneo, ‘snow;’ sniwit, ‘it snows:’ Lith. snig-ti, sning-ti, ‘to snow;’ snḗg-a-s, ‘snow;’ snaig-alà, ‘a flake of snow:’ Slav. sne†g-ŭ, ‘snow:’ Hib. nigh-im, ‘I wash;’ nigh-te, ‘washed,’ = Sanskrit निक्त।]
निक्त: निक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, washed, cleaned, cleansed, rinsed; sprinkled. —निक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. clean-handed, having clean hands.
निज: निज नि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. जन् with नि), innate, native, congenital, indigenous; own, of one's own party or country; proper, peculiar; continual, per-petual; (आस्), m. pl. one's own people. नि-ज is used in later Sanskrit as a reflexive possessive pronoun, like स्व, for ‘my own,’ ‘his own,’ ‘our own,’ &c.; and frequently for simple ‘my,’ ‘his,’ ‘our,’ &c. —निज-कर्मन्, अ, n. one's own work, any duty pertaining to one's self. —निज-कर्म-बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, fettered by one's own works. —निज-घास, अस्, m. ‘devouring his own,’ N. of a demon. —निज-धृति, इस्, f., N. of a river in Śāka-dvīpa. —निज-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (according to the commentators) = स्वभाव-मुक्त, liberated in own nature, essen-tially liberated (?). —निज-लाभ-पूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, engrossed in self-interest, self-satisfied. —निज-स्व, अम्, n. own property. —निजार्थम् (°ज-अर्°), ind. for one's own sake, for one's self.
निजघ्नि: निजघ्नि नि-जघ्नि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. नि-हन्), Ved. striking down, overpowering; [cf. जघ्नि।]
निजानुका: निजानुका नि-जानुका, f. (fr. नि-जानु), Ved. shaking or trembling of the knees (?).
निजिघृक्षयत्: निजिघृक्षयत् नि-जिघृक्षयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (Caus. of Desid. of rt. ग्रह् with नि), causing to be desirous of overpowering or excelling.
निजुर्व्: निजुर्व् नि-जुर्व् or नि-जूर्व्, cl. 1. P. -जूर्वति, &c., to consume by fire; (Sāy.) to destroy, kill.
निजुर्: नि-जुर्, ऊर्, f., Ved. killing, destroying.
निजुह्नूषु: निजुह्नूषु नि-जुह्नूषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. ह्नु with नि), wishing to conceal or deny.
निञ्ज्: निञ्ज् निञ्ज्, cl. 2. A. निक्ते, &c., = rt. निज्, q. v.
निटल: निटल नि-टल or नि-टाल, अम्, n. the fore-head. —निटलाक्ष (°ल-अक्ष), अस्, m. ‘having an eye on the forehead,’ an epithet of Śiva; (incor-rectly spelt निटिलाक्ष।)
निडी: निडी नि-डी, cl. 1. 4. A. -डयते and -डीयते, &c., to fly down.
निडीन: नि-डीन, अम्, n. the downward flight or swoop of a bird or a peculiar mode of flying.
निणिज्: निणिज् नि-णिज्, क् (according to Sāy. fr. नि-निज्, to purify), milk; (according to modern scholars this word may be an adverb related to नि-ण्य।)
निण्डिका: निण्डिका निण्डिका, f. a species of convol-vulus, = तिण्डी; (probably wrongly for तिण्डिका।)
निण्य: निण्य नि-ण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि), Ved. in-terior, hidden, concealed, secret, mysterious, (in Ṛg-veda 1. 32, 10, = निर्-नामधेय, nameless, according to Sāy.); (अम्), n. a secret, a mystery; (अम्), ind. secretly, mysteriously.
नितततपम्: नितततपम् नितततपम्, ind., Ved. an ono-matopoetic word to denote the speech of a stutterer.
नितन्: नितन् नि-तन्, cl. 8. P. A. -तनोति, -नुते, -तनितुम्, Ved. to pervade, penetrate, pierce; to cause to grow downwards (as a shoot, root, &c.).
नितत्नी: नि-तत्नी, f., Ved. a species of plant; N. of an Iṣṭakā; N. of one of the seven stars of the asterism Kṛttikā.
नितान: नि-तान, अस्, m., Ved. the shoot of a plant which grows downwards; N. of a man with the patronymic Māruta.
नितप्: नितप् नि-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्, Ved. to emit heat downwards; to consume.
नितम्: नितम् नि-तम्, Caus. P. -तमयति, &c., Ved. to choke, suffocate.
नितान्त: नि-तान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, extraordinary, excessive, exceeding, much, considerable; (अम्), ind. exceed-ingly, excessively, very, much, in a high degree. —नितान्तावृक्ष (°त-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, excessively treeless.
नितम्ब: नितम्ब नि-तम्ब, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. तम्ब्, probably connected with rt. स्तम्भ्), the buttocks or posteriors, especially of a woman, (in this sense generally नितम्बौ, m. du.); the cir-cumference of the hip and loins; the ridge or side or protuberant flank or swell of a mountain [cf. गिरि-नितम्ब]; a precipice; the sloping bank or shore of a river; the shoulder; a particular position of the hands in dancing; (आ), f. a form of Durgā. —नि-तम्ब-ता, f. the state of having large hips. —नि-तम्ब-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having beautiful buttocks or hips, καλλίπυγος; (ती), f. a woman. —नितम्ब-विम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having Vimba-like hips.
नितम्बिन्: नितम्बिन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.), having buttocks; having beautiful hips; having graceful slopes, having beautiful sides (as a moun-tain); (इनी), f. a woman with large and handsome hips.
नितम्भू: नितम्भू नितम्भू, ऊस्, m., N. of a person mentioned in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 1765; (per-haps for नित्यम्-भू।)
नितराम्: नितराम् नि-तराम्, ind. (fr. नि with the comparative affix), downwards, towards the lower part (Ved.); in a low tone (Ved.); completely, wholly, entirely; much, extremely, excessively, in a high degree; in an especial manner, always, con-tinually, eternally; at all events; certainly; [cf. Angl. Sax. nidher; Old Germ. nidar.]
नितल: नितल नि-तल, अम्, n. one of the seven divisions of the lower regions. See पाताल।
नितिक्त: नितिक्त नि-तिक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तिज् with नि), Ved. excited, roused up.
नितिक्ति: नि-तिक्ति, इस्, f., Ved. excitement, haste, speed; (इ), ind. quickly, speedily; (Sāy.) = 3rd sing. Pres. of rt. तिज् = तीक्ष्णी-करोति, he sharpens.
नितुद्: नितुद् नि-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते, -तोत्-तुम्, Ved. to pierce, penetrate, pierce into; to goad; (Sāy.) to incite or pain vehemently, or to issue forth (= नितरां व्यथयति or निर्-गच्छति).
नितोद: नि-तोद, अस्, m. piercing, a prick, puncture, hole.
नितोदिन्: नि-तोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. piercing, penetrating.
नितृद्: नितृद् नि-तृद्, cl. 7. P. A. -तृणत्ति, -तृन्त्ते, -तर्दितुम्, Ved. to pierce, penetrate, cleave in two.
नितॄ: नितॄ नि-तॄ, cl. 6. P. -तिरति, -तरितुम्, -त-रीतुम्, Ved. to dispel, subdue, overpower, obstruct.
नितोशन: नितोशन नि-तोशन, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. तुश् with नि), Ved. sprinkling, distributing, granting; (अस्), m. a distributer, granter.
नित्य: नित्य नित्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि), own (Ved.); continual, perpetual, regularly repeated, constant, uninterrupted, endless, eternal, everlasting; invariable, regular, fixed, regularly prescribed, inevitable, not op-tional, (opposed to काम्य &c.); necessary, obligatory, essential; ordinary, usual, (opposed to नैमित्तिक, unusual, produced by an unusual cause); constantly dwelling in, perpetually engaged in, (often at the end of a comp., e. g. अरण्य-नित्य, constantly dwelling in a forest; तपो-नित्य, engaged in constant penance); (with समास) a necessary compound which cannot be resolved without losing its meaning, because the separate ideas have merged in one, as in जमद्-अग्नि; (with स्वरित) = जात्य, the primary or independent Svarita, as opposed to the secondary or dependent; (अस्), m. the ocean; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā; a Śakti or form of Durgā; an epithet of the goddess Ma-nasā; (अम्), n. constant and indispensable rite or act; (अम्), ind. always, ever, daily, constantly, continually, perpetually, everlastingly, eternally; न नित्यम्, not always, never, (in Manu VI. 8. नित्यम् अन्-आदाता = never a receiver.) —नित्य-कर्मन्, अ, n. or नित्य-क्रिया, f. constant act or duty, as observance of the five great sacrifices or any daily and necessary rite. —नित्य-कृत्य, अम्, n. regular and necessary act or ceremony; daily or regular act or routine. —नित्य-गति, इस्, इस्, इ, moving continually; (इस्), m. air or wind, the god of wind. —नित्य-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, constantly born. —नित्य-ता, f. perpetuity, eternity, continuance, continual repetition, (as मैथुन-नित्यता, continually repeated coitus); perseverance; necessity. —नित्य-त्व, अम्, n. invariableness, per-petuity, eternity; endurance; inevitableness, neces-sity. —नित्य-दा, ind. always, ever, perpetually, con-stantly, eternally, at all times. —नित्य-दान, अम्, n. daily alms-giving. —नित्य-धृत्, त्, त्, त्, constantly bearing or maintaining, observing daily duties (?). —नित्य-धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, constantly maintained or kept up. —नित्य-नाथ-सिद्ध, अस्, m., N. of an author. —नित्य-नियम, अस्, m. fixed rule, constant observance. —नित्य-नैमित्तिक, अम्, or नित्य-नैमित्तिकं कर्म, n. any regularly re-curring occasional act or ceremony or any rite con-stantly performed to accomplish some object, as Śrāddhas at fixed lunar periods. —नित्य-परिवृत, अस्, m., N. of a Buddha. —नित्य-परीक्षण, अम्, n. constant investigation or inspection. —नित्य-पूजा-यन्त्र, अम्, n. a kind of amulet. —नित्य-प्रलय, अस्, m. the constant dissolution of living beings. —नित्य-भाव, अस्, m. the state of being eternal, eternity. —नित्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed of or consisting of anything eternal, eternal. —नित्य-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, always busy, ever engaged in. —नित्य-यौवन, अम्, n. perpetual youth; (अस्, ई, अम्), ever or always young; (आ), f. an epithet of Draupadī. —नित्यर्तु (°य-ऋ), उस्, उस्, उ, regularly recurring at the seasons, annual. —नित्य-वत्स, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. always possessing a calf; (आ), f. a par-ticular form of Sāma supplication; (अम्), n., N. of several Sāmans. —नित्य-वित्रस्त, अस्, m. ‘constantly scared,’ N. of an antelope. —नित्य-वैकुण्ठ, अस्, m., N. of a particular residence of Viṣṇu, the heaven of Viṣṇu. —नित्य-व्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, always expending, constantly disbursing; (आ), f. always ex-pending, ever laying out. —नित्य-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, perpetually alarmed, always suspicious. —नित्य-शय, अस्, आ, अम्, always sleeping or reclining. —नित्य-शस्, ind. always, continually, constantly, eternally. —नित्य-संहृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, always exulting or triumphant; always rivalling one another, (in this sense संहृष्ट = सङ्घृष्ट।) —नित्य-सम, अस्, m. the assertion that all things remain the same (?). —नित्य-समास, see नित्य. —नित्य-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘ever perfect,’ a Jaina predicate of the soul. —नित्य-स्तोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. receiving perpetual praise, constantly lauded. —नित्य-स्नायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, constantly bathing or making ablutions. —नित्यान-ध्याय (°य-अन्°), अस्, m. invariable suspension of repetition of the Vedas, (a term applied to periods when the perusal of the Vedas is invariably prohibited, as the day of full moon, new moon, the eighth and fourteenth days of the half month.) —नित्यानन्द (°य-आन्°), अस्, m. eternal happiness. —नित्यानन्द-रसोदधि (°स-उद्°), इस्, m. ‘ocean of the essence of eternal joy,’ God. —नित्यानन्दाश्रम (°द-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of a commentator. —नित्यानित्य (°य-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, eternal and perishable, permanent and temporary. —नित्यायुक्त (°य-आय्°), अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; (also read नित्योयुक्त; cf. नित्यो-द्युक्त।) —नित्यारित्र (°य-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having (its) own oars, ever fitted with oars (i. e. according to Sāy. with priests). —नित्योत्क्षिप्त-हस्त (°य-उत्°), अस्, m. ‘who always raises his hand,’ N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —नित्योदित (°य-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a man. —नित्योद्युक्त (°य-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva; [cf. नित्यायुक्त।]
नित्यज्: नित्यज् नि-त्यज्, cl. 1. P. -त्यजति, -त्यक्तुम्, Ved. to scare or drive away.
निद्: निद् 1. निद्, cl. 1. P. A. नेदति, नेदते, निनेद, निनिदे or निनेदे, नेदिता, &c., to be near [cf. rt. नेद्, नेदीयस्, नेदिष्ठ]; to ridicule, blame, reproach, censure, &c., (in this sense properly a separate rt., the form of which is usually निन्द्, q. v.): Desid., Ved. निनित्सति, to wish to reproach or depreciate; [cf. rt. निन्द्; Gr. ὄ-νειδ-ο-ς, probably λοίδ-ο-ρο-ς; Goth. ga-nait-yan, nai-teins, probably neith; Old Germ. neiz-yan; Angl. Sax. naet-an, naet-ing, nidh, ge-nidhe, ‘hatred;’ Mod. Germ. neid, ‘envy.’]
2. निद्, त्, f., Ved. mocking, ridiculing, despising, censure, contempt; (त्), m. one who ridicules or con-temns, a blamer, an enemy.
निदा: निदा 2. नि-दा (rt. 1. दा), cl. 3. P. -ददाति, &c., Ved. to give. (For 1. निदा see above.)
निदा 3. नि-दा (rt. 4. दा, to bind), cl. 4. P. -द्यति, &c., Ved. to fasten.
निदान: 1. निदान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (= निद्यमान), reproached, ridiculed. (For 2. see 3. नि-दा, col. 3.)

2. नि-दान, अम्, n. (for 1. निदान see col. 2), a band, a rope, a halter; a rope for tying up a calf &c.; a first or original cause, a primary or remote cause [cf. नि-बन्धन]; original form, essence, (निदानेन, ind. originally, essentially, properly); the cause of a disease, inquiry into the causes of disease, pathology, i. e. study of the symptoms with a view to trace the remote or proximate causes, (re-garded as a department of medical science; the six-teen Nidānas being the title of the sixteen divisions into which it is divided; cf. निदान-स्थान); N. of a work on metres and Vedic Stomas (see निदान-सूत्र); end, termination, cessation; purification, purity, correctness; claiming the reward of peni-tential acts. —निदान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. founded on a cause, essential. —निदान-सूत्र, अम्, n. a work in ten Prapāṭhakas on metres and Vedic Stomas. —निदान-स्थान, अम्, n. one of the five depart-ments of medical science, inquiry into the causes of diseases, pathology.
निद्यमान: निद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being reproached, &c.
निद: निद नि-द, अम्, n. (said to be fr. नि-दो), poison, venom.
निदण्ड: निदण्ड नि-दण्ड, अस्, m., according to a commentator = निहित-दण्ड, a stick put aside or laid down; (अस्, आ, अम्), one who has put down a stick (i. e. not using force), one who has laid down a staff.
निदत्त: नि-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, given, given absolutely; [cf. नीत्त।]
निदद्रु: निदद्रु निद-द्रु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. निद + द्रु), a man.
निदर्शन: नि-दर्शन, अस्, ई, अम्, pointing to, showing, foreshowing, prognosticating, indicating; proclaim-ing, announcing, teaching; suiting, pleasing?; (आ), f. a simile, a comparison; (अम्), n. seeing, look-ing into, view, insight, sight, vision (e. g. स्वप्न-निदर्शन, a vision in sleep); pointing to; showing; evidence; an example or illustration; a designation of the third member of a complete syllogism (usually called उद्-आहरण, q. v.); a foreboding, prognostic, sign, mark, omen; a scheme, system; injunction, pre-cept, ordinance, scriptural authority; authority, text.
निदह्: निदह् नि-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn down, consume by fire.
निदाघ: नि-दाघ, अस्, m. (according to native lexicogra-phers also अम्, n.), heat, warmth; the hot season (May and June), summer; internal heat, sweat, perspiration; N. of a man; N. of a son of Pulastya; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of the former person. —निदाघ-कर, अस्, m. ‘heat causer’ or ‘hot-rayed,’ the sun. —निदाघ-काल, अस्, m. ‘the time of heat,’ the hot season, two months previous to the rains, about May and June. —निदाघ-सिन्धु, उस्, m. a river in hot weather, one nearly dry.
निदातृ: नि-दातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who fastens or ties up; (Sāy.) a restrainer, obstructer, (as if fr. rt. 3. दा।)
निदित: नि-दित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. preserved, concealed; (Sāy.) completely bound or fettered (= नितराम् बद्ध).
निदिग्ध: निदिग्ध नि-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. दिह् with नि), smeared, anointed, plastered; clinging to; (आ), f. small cardamoms.
निदिग्धिका: निदिग्धिका, f. = कण्ट-कारिका, a species of prickly nightshade, Solanum Jacquini [cf. निर्-दिग्धिका, निर्-दग्धिका]; cardamoms.
निदिध्यासन: निदिध्यासन नि-दिध्यासन, अम्, n. (fr. the Desid. of rt. ध्यै), profound and repeated medi-tation.
नि-दिध्यासन, अम्, n. profound meditation, deep and repeated consideration, thinking of or re-calling repeatedly.
निदिध्यासु: नि-दिध्यासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desiring to meditate upon.
नि-दिध्यासु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of meditating on.
निदिध्येय: नि-दिध्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deeply meditated upon.
निदिश्: निदिश् नि-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to order, point out, &c.; (perhaps for निर्-दिश् and apparently only used in the derivatives below.)
निदिष्ट: नि-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ordered, directed; advised, enjoined; explained, pointed out.
निदेश: नि-देश, अस्, m. order, command, direction, in-struction; speech, speaking, narration, conversation; vicinity, proximity, neighbourhood; = भाजन, a vessel, vase; (ए), ind. in the vicinity, near. —निदेश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, executing orders, obedient, servile.
निदेश नि-देश। See नि-दिश्, p. 486, col. 3.
निदेशिन्: नि-देशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, showing, directing, ordering, pointing out; (इनी), f. a region, quarter, point of the compass.
निदेश्य: नि-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ordered, to be told.
निदेष्टृ: नि-देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, who or what points out or orders; explaining, advising, commanding.
निदी: निदी नि-दी, cl. 3. P. (see rt. 2. दी), Ved. to shine down upon; (Sāy. = नितराम् प्र-काश्, to shine exceedingly.)
निदुश: निदुश निदुश, अस्, m. a fish.
निदृश्: निदृश् नि-दृश्, Caus. -दर्शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to see, to show, point, to point out; to introduce, cause to enter; to impart knowledge, communicate, teach; advise; to appear (in a vision) to any person (acc.).
निदर्शक: नि-दर्शक, अस्, आ, अम्, seeing into, perceiving; seeing; pointing out, proclaiming, announcing.
निदर्शित: नि-दर्शित, अस्, आ, अम्, illustrated, exemplified.
निदर्शिन्: नि-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, seeing, viewing, having an insight into, familiar with, knowing.
निद्रा: निद्रा 1. नि-द्रा or नि-द्रै, cl. 1. 2. P. A. -द्रायति, -ते, -द्राति, &c., to fall asleep, sleep.

2. नि-द्रा, f. (said to be fr. rt. निन्द् + affix र), sleep, slumber, sleepiness, sloth; (in flowers the budding state is considered as sleep. hence निद्रां त्यज् = to bloom); a mystical N. of the letter भ्। —निद्रा-दरिद्र, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —निद्रान्-ध (°रा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blind with sleep. —नि-द्रा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. rousing from sleep, awaking; [cf. भग्न-निद्र।] —निद्रा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting in sleep. —निद्रा-योग, अस्, m. sleep and deep meditation; [cf. योग-निद्रा।] —निद्रा-लस (°रा-अल्°), अस्, आ, अम्, slothful from drowsi-ness, fast asleep, sleepy. —निद्रा-वृक्ष, अस्, m. darkness. —निद्रा-सञ्जनन, अम्, n. ‘producing drowsiness,’ phlegm, the phlegmatic humor.
निद्राण: नि-द्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep, sleepy, drowsy; shut up, closed (as a bud or blossom).
निद्रात्: नि-द्रात्, आन्, आती or आन्ती, आत्, sleeping.
निद्रायमाण: नि-द्रायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep.
निद्रालु: नि-द्रालु, उस्, उस्, उ, sleeping, sleepy, drowsy, slothful; (उस्), m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; (उस्), f. the plant Solanum Melongena; another plant (= वन-वर्वरिका); a kind of perfume (= नली). —नि-द्रालु-त्व, अम्, n. sleepiness, drowsiness.
निद्रित: निद्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, sleeping, asleep. —निद्रित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having slept.
निधन: निधन नि-धन, अम्, n. (in some senses apparently fr. 1. नि-धा below, but in others more probably fr. धन् = rt. हन्, to kill, with नि; cf. प्र-धन), settling down in a residence, residence, place of residence, domicile, resting-place, receptacle (Ved.); race, family; conclusion, end; dying, death, destruction, loss, disappearance, annihilation, (in these senses also rarely नि-धनस्, m., see Hari-vaṃśa 4846); the concluding passage or words at the end of a Sāman which is sung in chorus, (several words are used for this purpose, e. g. स्वर्-ज्योतिः, वषट्, व्रतम्, ईम्, नाम्, &c.); the finale in music; (अम्), n., N. of the eighth mansion; (अस्), m. the head of a family; (अस्, आ, अम्), without money, poor, (in this sense for निर्-धन); [cf. rt. हन्; Gr. θάν-α-το-ς; Hib. nidh, nith, ‘manslaughter, battle.’] —निधन-काम, अम्, n., Ved., N. of several Sāmans. —निधन-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, causing death, destroying, destructive. —निधन-क्रिया, f. a funeral ceremony. —निधन-ता, f. poverty, indigence. —निधन-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of the end or of destruction. —निधन-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. become final or like a finale in music. —निधन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a finale in music.
निधा: निधा 1. नि-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, -धातुम्, to put down, lay down, put or lay into, fix in, deposit, lodge, bury; (with मनस्) to fix or direct the thoughts upon or towards (dat.); resolve, determine; (with क्रियाम्) to direct one's labours, use efforts; to appoint; to lay aside, put away, remove, relinquish; lay up, treasure up, put into a safe place; to preserve for one's self (A.); to deliver, intrust, commit, present; (with हृदये or मनसि) to keep in mind, bear in mind, re-member, lay to heart, keep close; to keep down, keep back, restrain; to end, close; to place in any state, render: Pass. -धीयते, to be place on or in, to be deposited, be situated in or on, be absorbed into, to rest in: Caus. -धापयति, &c., to cause to be put or laid on or into, to cause to be deposited or preserved; to appoint: Intens. (?), Ved. 3rd sing. -देध्यत्।
2. नि-धा, f., Ved. laying snares; a net; a collection of snares, a snare. —निधा-पति, इस्, m. the possessor or bearer of snares.
निधातव्य: नि-धातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be put down or de-posited; to be delivered; to be directed towards; to be concealed.
निधातृ: नि-धातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a depositor, one who deposits, keeps, conceals, &c.
निधान: नि-धान, अम्, n. putting down, laying down, depositing, (दण्ड-निधान, putting down or laying aside the stick, i. e. not using force, = mildness, clemency); keeping, preserving; a place where any-thing is laid, a vessel in which anything is deposited, a receptacle; a place of cessation or rest; anything laid up, a treasure, a divine treasure (especially be-longing to Kuvera, god of wealth); store, hoard, property, possessions, wealth. —निधानेश (°न-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasure,’ a Yakṣa.
निधान्य: नि-धान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fit for being laid or put down.
निधापक: नि-धापक, अस्, m. one who causes to be put down or deposited; a weapon (?); burnt timber (?), charcoal (?); the castor-oil plant (?).
निधाप्य: नि-धाप्य, ind. having caused to be placed or fixed in, having installed or appointed.
निधाय: नि-धाय, ind. having fixed or placed in or on, (मनसि निधाय, fixing or laying up in the mind, reflecting.)
निधि: नि-धि, इस्, m. setting down or serving up food &c. (Ved.); the lower part or bottom of the Ukhā (Ved.); a place where anything is laid or deposited, a receptacle, (अपां निधिः, the receptacle of waters, the ocean, sea; also N. of a Sāman; sometimes निधि alone stands for ‘the ocean’); a place for storing up, a storehouse, treasury, granary, a nest, &c.; (figuratively) a treasure-house of good qualities, a man endowed with many good qualities; a treasure, store, hoard, any collection of wealth or valuables; a divine treasure belonging to Kuvera, (nine of which are enumerated, viz. the Padma, Mahā-padma, Śaṅkha, Makara, Kacchapa, Mukunda, Nanda, Nīla, and Kharba; their nature is not exactly defined, though some of them appear to be precious gems; according to the Tāntrika system they are personified and worshipped as demi-gods, attendant either upon Kuvera who is sometimes called निधीनम् अधि-पः, ‘lord of the Nidhis,’ or upon Lakṣmī, the goddess of prosperity); N. of a particular medicinal plant, commonly Jīvikā; a kind of perfume (= नलिका); दैवो निधिः, ‘the divine treasure,’ N. of a particular philosophical doctrine. —निधि-गोप, अस्, m. guardian of treasure. —निधि-नाथ, अस्, m. or निधि-प्रभु, उस्, m. or निधीश्वर (°धि-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera. —निधि-प, अस्, m. guardian of treasure; [cf. निधि-पा।] —निधि-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera; N. of a rich merchant. —निधिपति-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a merchant. —निधि-पा, आस्, Ved., or निधि-पाल, अस्, m. guardian of treasure. —निधि-पालित, अस्, m., N. of a merchant. —निधि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. pos-sessing treasure, forming a store. —निधीश or नि-धीश्वर (°धि-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of treasures,’ an epithet of Kuvera. —निध्य्-अर्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, treasure seeking.
निधीयमान: नि-धीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being laid down or deposited, &c.
निधेय: नि-धेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be placed in or on, to be deposited.
निहित: नि-हित, अस्, आ, अम्, put down, deposited, &c. See s. v.

निहित नि-हित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. नि-धा), placed, laid, fixed, lodged, situated, deposited, de-livered, given, intrusted; inserted, infixed, attached; applied to; bestowed upon; treasured up; held; laid (as dust by rain); uttered in a deep tone. —निहित-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, one who lays aside the rod, one who shows clemency. —निहित-नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, having the eyes fixed or directed upon (with loc.).
निधू: निधू नि-धू, cl. 5. 6. P. A. -धूनोति, -धू-नुते (in the later language also -धुनोति, -धुनुते), -धुवति, -धोतुम्, -धवितुम्, to throw down, give or deliver over (Ved.); shake to and fro, agitate.
निधुवन: नि-धुवन, अम्, n. shaking about, agitation, trembling; coition, sexual intercourse; pleasure, en-joyment; sport, play, pastime.
निधृ: निधृ नि-धृ, cl. 10. P. -धारयति, -यितुम् (Ved. -दीधर्), to place down or in, deposit in; determine; establish; render (Ved.); to keep, pre-serve; (Sāy.) to establish firmly; to conceive in the womb: Pass. -धार्यते (Ved. -दध्रे), to be placed in or deposited; to bend down, to stoop (Ved.).
निधारय: नि-धारय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. placing in or on, depositing.
निधारयत्: नि-धारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, (Sāy.) abiding in.
निधृति: नि-धृति, इस्, m., N. of a prince, a son of Vṛṣṇi; [cf. निर्-वृति, नि-वृत्ति।]
निध्यै: निध्यै नि-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्या-तुम्, to observe, perceive (Ved.); to meditate on, be absorbed in meditation; to think of, reflect on; remember: Desid. -दिध्यासति, -ते, to wish to meditate on; think of attentively (Ved.).
निदिध्यासितव्य: नि-दिध्यासितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reflected or meditated upon.
निध्यात: नि-ध्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, meditated on, thought on, imagined.
निध्यान: नि-ध्यान, अम्, n. intuition, looking at, seeing, beholding, sight.
निध्रुव: निध्रुव नि-ध्रुव, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants; [cf. नैध्रुव, नै-ध्रुवि।]
निध्रुवि: निध्रुवि नि-ध्रुवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. constant, persevering, faithful; (इस्), m., N. of a Kāśyapa and author of a Ṛg-veda hymn (IX. 63).
निध्वान: निध्वान नि-ध्वान, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ध्वन् with नि), sound.
निनङ्क्षु: निनङ्क्षु निनङ्क्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. 2. नश्), wishing or expecting to perish or die.
निनद्: निनद् नि-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति, &c., to sound, make a sound, cry out; to resound: Caus. P. -नादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sound or resound, fill with noise, cries, &c.
निनद: नि-नद or नि-नाद, अस्, m. sound, noise, cry, buzzing, humming, crying.
निनादित: नि-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to sound, filled with noise or cries; (अम्), n. a sound.
निनादिन्: नि-नादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding, resounding, ringing, crying; causing to sound, playing (as a musical instrument).
निनयन: नि-नयन, अम्, n. carrying out, performing, accomplishing; performance; pouring down.
निनर्तशत्रु: निनर्तशत्रु निनर्त-शत्रु, उस्, m., N. of a son of An-ādhṛṣṭi.
निनर्द्: निनर्द् नि-नर्द्, cl. 1. P. -नर्दति, -नर्दि-तुम्, to sound; prolong a note in chanting; [cf. अव-नर्द्।]
निनर्द: नि-नर्द, अस्, m. prolonging a note in chanting, trilling.
निनर्दत्: नि-नर्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding; prolonging a cadence.
निनह्: निनह् नि-नह्, cl. 4. P. A. -नह्यति, -ते, -नद्धुम्, Ved. to fasten, tie; [cf. नीनाह।]
निनद्ध: नि-नद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened, tied fast.
निनाह्य: नि-नाह्य, अस्, m., Ved. a water-jar; (according to the commentaries) a water-jar put into the ground.
निनित्सु: निनित्सु निनित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt. निद्), Ved. wishing to censure or blame.
निनी: निनी नि-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -ने-तुम्, to lead to, carry or bring towards, bring near, bring, fetch; to incline, bend; to pour on or into (Ved.); to carry out, perform, accomplish, cause; to spend (time).
निनीषा: निनीषा निनीषा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. 1. नी), wishing to bring, desire or intention of carrying or taking or leading away.
निनीषु: निनीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous to take or lead, wishing to bring; wishing to spend (as time).
निनृत्त: निनृत्त नि-नृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, repeated (as a portion of a verse or syllable; lit. danced again). —निनृत्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having repetition (as above).
निन्द्: निन्द् निन्द् (sometimes written निद्, q. v.), cl. 1. P. निन्दति (rarely A. -ते), निनिन्द, निन्दिष्यति, अनिन्दीत्, निन्दितुम्, to blame, censure, reprimand, contemn, despise, ridicule.
निन्द: निन्द in निन्द-तल, अस्, ई, अम्, = निन्दित-हस्त, having a maimed or defective hand; (some-times read निम्न-तल।)
निन्दक: निन्दक, अस्, आ, अम्, blaming, defaming, re-proachful, abusive, scurrilous, censorious; one who ridicules or blames, a scorner.
निन्दत्: निन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, blaming, censuring, abusing, ridiculing.
निन्दन: निन्दन, अम्, n. reproach, censure, blame.
निन्दनीय: निन्दनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, blamable, liable to reproof or censure or blame, reprehensible; [cf. अ-न्°।]
निन्दा: निन्दा, f. blame, censure, reproach, reproof, abuse, defamation, scorn, reviling; injury, injuring, wicked-ness; [cf. निदा।] —निन्दा-स्तुति, इस्, f. praise which involves reproof, ironical praise, irony.
निन्दित: निन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, blamed, abused, reviled, reproved, despised, rejected; low, despicable, worthy of being reviled; prohibited, forbidden.
निन्दितृ: निन्दितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who ridicules or blames or despises.
निन्दिन्: निन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, blaming, censuring, reproaching.
निन्दु: निन्दु, उस्, f. a woman bearing a dead child.
निन्द्य: निन्द्य, अस्, आ, अम्, blamable, to be censured or reproached, despicable, reprehensible, bad, vile; for-bidden, prohibited; [cf. अ-न्।] —निन्द्य-ता, f. or निन्द्य-त्व, अम्, n. blamableness, infamy, con-temptibleness.
निन्व्: निन्व् निन्व् (or according to some सिन्व्), cl. 1. P. निन्वति, &c., to wet or sprinkle; or to attend, wait on, worship ?; (the two mean-ings have probably arisen from a confusion between सेचने and सेवने।)
निप: निप नि-प। See under 2. नि-पा, col. 2.
नि-प, अस्, अम्, m. n. a water-jar; (अस्), m. the Kadamba tree, Nauclea Cadamba (= कदम्ब).
निपक्षति: निपक्षति नि-पक्षति, इस्, f., Ved. the second rib.
निपठ: निपठ नि-पठ, अस्, m. or निपठन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. पठ् with नि), reading, recitation, studying.
निपठित: नि-पठित, अस्, आ, अम्, read, recited, studied, (hence निपठितिन्, Pāṇ. V. 2, 88.)
निपठिति: नि-पठिति, इस्, f. reading, recitation, study.
निपाठ: नि-पाठ, अस्, m. = नि-पठ, reading, study of the sacred books or public perusal of popular poems.
निपत्: निपत् नि-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fly down, fall down, tumble down, settle down, fall, descend, alight, throw one's self down; to fall upon, throw one's self upon, assault, assail, fall into, rush into, rush in, flow in, disembogue into, discharge into; fall into ruin; to fall into (any state or con-dition); to fall into (a place), enter, insert one's self, become fixed in; to befall, happen, take place; to fall to the share of (with loc.): Caus. -पातयति, -अपीपतत्, -यितुम्, to cause to fall down, throw down, fell, cast down, cause to fall on (e. g. to cause a stick to fall on any one = strike with a stick); to hurl down; to cast, throw, hurl, throw into; to let in, inlay, emboss; to direct (the eyes &c.) upon; to spit on, spit out; to ruin, kill, destroy (with abl.); to raise or levy a tribute from (with करान् and abl. c., in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 3313); (in grammar) to put down as a special or irregular form, to give as an irregularity, consider as anomalous or irregular; (नि-पात्यते is put down or mentioned as a special rule or irregular form.)
निपतत्: नि-पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flying down, falling down, falling, descending, alighting, prostrating one's self, &c.
निपतन: नि-पतन, अम्, n. flying down, falling down, falling, descending; alighting, flying.
निपतित: नि-पतित, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen down, fallen; de-scended, alighted.
निपत्य: नि-पत्य, ind. having fallen down, having pros-trated one's self, having descended or alighted. —नि-पत्य-रोहिणी, f. falling and ascending (?).
निपत्या: नि-पत्या, f. any slippery ground; a field of battle.
निपात: नि-पात, अस्, m. falling down, falling, descending, coming down, alighting; falling upon, attacking; casting, hurling; death, dying; accidental occurrence or mention; putting down as irregular or exceptional, irregular form, irregularity (e. g. पूर्व-निपात, irregular occurrence of a word at the beginning instead of at the end of a compound; पर-निपात, irregular placing of a word at the end instead of beginning); the opposite extremity, the lower end; (in grammar) a particle, the term for all adverbs in-cluding conjunctions and interjections, (called निपात as falling into the sentence in various senses, i. e. taking their place after other words to modify the sense in various ways.) —निपात-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being a particle. —निपात-प्रतीकार, अस्, m. the repelling of assaults.
निपातक: नि-पातक, अस्, अम्, m. n. = पातक, a bad deed, a sin.
निपातन: नि-पातन, अस्, आ, अम्, throwing down, overthrow-ing, killing, destroying; (अम्), n. causing to descend or fall, throwing down, overthrowing; beating, knocking down; putting on; touching with; killing, destroying; (in grammar) putting down as an irre-gularity, accidental mention or use of a word; a form which by its rare occurrence shows itself to be irre-gular; irregularity, exception; falling down, hurrying down, flying down.
निपातनीय: नि-पातनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cast down or over-thrown, caused to fall (e. g. दण्डो निपातनीयस्, the stick must be caused to fall, punishment must be inflicted).
निपातित: नि-पातित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to fall or descend; beaten down; killed; irregular, excepted.
निपातिन्: नि-पातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, falling down, flying down or on, alighting; striking down, destroying, a destroyer.
निपात्य: नि-पात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be cast down or over-thrown; to be put down or mentioned as an irregu-larity.
निपात्यमान: नि-पात्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thrown down, being precipitated.
निपलाशम्: निपलाशम् नि-पलाशम्, ind., Ved. (Sāy.) without speaking, i. e. like a tree without foliage (or as a leafless tree moves without rustling).
निपा: निपा 1. नि-पा, cl. 2. P. -पाति, -पातुम्, &c., to guard, protect, defend; observe, watch over: Caus. -पालयति, -यितुम्, to protect, guard, govern.
निपा 2. नि-पा, cl. 1. and 2. P. -पिबति or -पिवति, -पातुम्, to drink in, imbibe, suck in; to absorb, dry up: Caus. P. -पाययति, -यितुम्, to cause to imbibe or suck in.
निपान: नि-पान or निपानक, अम्, n. drinking, im-bibing; any reservoir of water, any place or trough near a well for watering cattle; a well, pool; a milk-pail. —निपान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having reser-voirs or ponds, abounding in pools, &c.
निपीत: नि-पीत, अस्, आ, अम्, drunk in, drunk up, absorbed, imbibed, dried up.
निपीयमान: नि-पीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being drunk in or imbibed.
निपाक: निपाक नि-पाक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. पच् with नि), cooking, maturing, ripening.
निपाद: निपाद नि-पाद, अस्, m., Ved. low ground, a valley; (Sāy.) high and low ground.
निपिष्: निपिष् नि-पिष्, cl. 7. P., Ved. -पिनष्टि, -पेष्टुम्, to crush.
निपीड्: निपीड् नि-पीड्, cl. 10. P. -पीडयति, -यितुम्, to press close to or against, press together, squeeze; to embrace; to impress; to cause pain, afflict, plague, trouble; (in astronomy) to eclipse.
निपीडन: नि-पीडन, अम्, n. squeezing, pressing; hurting, giving pain; (आ), f. oppression.
निपीडयत्: नि-पीडयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, pressing, pressing to-gether; (दन्तान् दन्तैर् निपीडयन्, gnashing the teeth.)
निपीडित: नि-पीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, squeezed, pressed, embraced; pained, hurt. —निपीडितालक्तक-वत् (°त-अल्°), ind. like pressed lac.
निपीड्य: नि-पीड्य, ind. having pressed; having pressed against or upon; having embraced; having hurt.
निपीय्: निपीय् नि-पीय्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -पीयति, -यि-तुम्, to revile, abuse, treat with contempt.
निपु: निपु निपु, उस्, m., N. of a man.
निपुण: निपुण नि-पुण, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. पुण् with नि; perhaps fr. rt. पुष् + affix न, through which dialectically पुण्ण = पुण), clever, adroit, skilful, skilled in, conversant with (loc. and gen.); experienced; kind or friendly towards (with loc. or with प्रति); sharp, acute, fine, delicate; complete, perfect, accurate; (अम् or एन), ind. skilfully, cleverly, sharply; completely, perfectly, totally, exactly, care-fully; in a delicate manner. —निपुण-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more clever, perfect, &c.; (अम्), ind. cleverly; perfectly. —निपुण-तस्, ind. cleverly, skilfully; completely. —निपुण-ता, f. skilfulness, cleverness, conversancy, adroitness, versatility; carefulness, accu-racy. —निपुण-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, sharp-sighted, clever, knowing.
निपुणिका: निपुणिका, f. ‘the clever one,’ N. of a waiting-maid in the Vikramorvaśī.
निपुथ्: निपुथ् नि-पुथ्, Caus. -पोथयति, -यितुम्, to dash down.
निपुर्: निपुर् नि-पुर्, ऊर्, f., Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) = सूक्ष्म-देह, the subtle body.
निपूत: निपूत नि-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. strained, filtered, purified.
निप्रहन्: निप्रहन् नि-प्र-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्-तुम्, to kill (with gen. of the object).
निप्रियाय: निप्रियाय निप्रियाय (fr. नि-प्रिय), Nom. A. निप्रियायते, &c., Ved. to keep in one's pos-session, not to be willing to give up.
निफला: निफला नि-फला, f. the plant Cardiosper-mum Halicacabum (= ज्योतिष्मती).
निफालन: निफालन नि-फालन, अम्, n. (probably incorrect for नि-भालन), seeing, sight.
निफेन: निफेन नि-फेन, अम्, n. = अ-फेन, opium.
निबद्ध: नि-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound in or on, bound; fastened, tied, connected, bound or sewed together, fastened to; caught (as in a net), fettered, enchained, chained to, dependant on; connected, coherent; shut up, closed, stopped, obstructed; confined, costive; checked, restrained, restricted to; bound over or called as a witness (Manu VIII. 76); composed, written; fixed in, inlaid (as with gold or jewels), enchased, set, inserted; committed, intrusted; enveloped, enclosed, involved, covered with; constructed of, formed of, consisting of; accompanied by, furnished or endowed with; relating to, contained or involved in.
निबन्ध्: निबन्ध् नि-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्-धुम्, to bind on, bind, tie, fasten, tie together; to fetter, enchain, imprison, ensnare; to attach, to join, unite, connect; compose (in writing), record, write; to construct; to draw together, contract (e. g. भ्रु-कुटीम्, the brow); to fix, hold fast, confine, restrain, obstruct, stop, close up, restrict; to fix on, place or put upon, impose; to put together, form, acquire; (with पदम्) to put the foot upon, i. e. to under-take anything; to fix or direct upon; to appoint, commission, charge; to place, locate; to destroy, (Mahā-bh. Virāṭa-p. 982; cf. rt. वध्।)
निबन्द्धृ: नि-बन्द्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, who or what ties or binds, a binder, fastener; (धा), m. a com-poser, writer, author; a commentator; (also written नि-बन्धृ।)
निबन्ध: नि-बन्ध, अस्, m. binding on, binding, fastening, tying, attachment, attachment to, intentness on; com-posing, writing down, recording; restraint, obstruc-tion, confinement, constipation, suppression of urine, strangury; a band, bond, fetter; fixed property, not movable or fluctuating; a grant of property, an assign-ment of cattle or money for support; foundation, origin, root, cause, reason; any literary composition or treatise; a commentary or explanation of technical rules [cf. ग्रन्थ]; N. of a particular work; the plant Azadirachta Indica; (अम्), n. song, singing. —निबन्ध-दान, अम्, n. grant of property, as-signment or gift of a corrody. —निबन्ध-सङ्-ग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a commentary on Su-śruta's medical work.
निबन्धन: नि-बन्धन, अस्, ई, अम्, binding, fastening, fettering; (ई), f. band, bond, fetter; (अम्), n. the act of fastening to, binding together, ligation; con-structing, building (as a bridge &c.); checking, re-straining, confining; band, fetter; that to which anything is fastened or on which it rests; a receptacle; the part of a lute where the strings are fastened, the tie or peg of a lute; cause, origin, reason, motive, condition; (in grammar) syntax; a composition; a commentary; a grant, an assignment.
निबन्धित: नि-बन्धित, अस्, आ, अम्, bound, fastened, con-fined, tied.
निबन्धिन्: नि-बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, binding, confining; joined or connected by or with, hanging together, cohering; causing, being a cause or having a reason.
निबर्हण: नि-बर्हण, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, &c.; (अम्), n. destruction, annihilation, &c. See नि-वर्हण।
निबल: निबल निबल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a particular number.
निबाध्: निबाध् नि-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -बाधि-तुम्, Ved. to press down or together, force in; to cramp, contract, confine, obstruct; to oppress.
निबाध: नि-बाध, अस्, m. obstruction, in अ-न्°, q. v.
निबा: निबा|अ नि-बाऌह, अस्, आ, अम् (according to some fr. rt. बंह्, according to Sāy. fr. rt. बाह् = वाह्, to endeavour), Ved. forced down, thrown into.
निबुध्: निबुध् नि-बुध्, cl. 1. P. A. -बोधति, -ते, -बोधितुम्, to learn or hear anything (acc.) from any one (gen. or with सकाशात्); to attend to, listen to, (often occurring in the impv. नि-बोध); to know, consider: Caus. -बोधयति, &c., to cause to know or learn, to inform, give to understand.
निबोद्धव्य: नि-बोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be learnt; to be considered or regarded.
निबृह्: निबृह् नि-बृह् (also written नि-वृह्, q. v.), cl. 1. P. -बर्हति, -बर्हितुम्, -बर्हयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to throw down, destroy, annihilate, extirpate, eradicate.
निभ: निभ नि-भ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. भा with नि), like, resembling, similar, (only at the end of a comp.; sometimes pleonastically after adjectives, e. g. चारु-निभानन, handsome-faced; and occasionally with another word meaning ‘like,’ e. g. नग-निभो-पम, like a mountain); (अस्, अम्), m. n. appear-ance, light, manifestation; pretence, pretext, fraud, sham, trick, disguise. —निभ-ता, f. similarity, likeness.
निभञ्ज्: निभञ्ज् नि-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, -भङ्क्-तुम्, to break or dash to pieces, break asunder.
निभर्त्सन: निभर्त्सन नि-भर्त्सन, wrong reading for निर्-भर्त्सन।
निभल्: निभल् नि-भल्, cl. 10. P. A. -भालयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to perceive, see.
निभालन: नि-भालन, अम्, n. seeing, sight, perception; [cf. नि-फालन।]
निभसद्: निभसद् नि-भसद् (?), having the hinder parts directed downwards (?). See भसद्।
निभिद्: निभिद् नि-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति, -भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to break or divide asunder: Pass. -भिद्यते, to be opened, to open.
निभीम: निभीम नि-भीम, अस्, आ, अम्, terrible, fright-ful. —निभीम-विक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, of terrible valour, of formidable prowess.
निभूत: निभूत नि-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, past, gone.
निभूयप: निभूयप निभूयप, अस्, m., Ved. epithet of Viṣṇu, (meaning unknown.)
निभृ: निभृ नि-भृ, cl. 1. P. -भरति, -भर्तुम्, &c., to bear or put down, (apparently only used in the part. नि-भृत below.)
निभृत: नि-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्, borne or placed down, deposited in a low place, lowered; concealed, hidden, secret, occult, unperceived, imperceptible; modest, humble, unassuming; mild, gentle; lonely, solitary; still, silent; firm, unmoved, immovable; resolute, decided, firmly attached, faithful; filled with, full of, (Bhāgavata-Purāṇa X. 32, 20, = पूर्ण, व्याप्त); (अम्), n. humility, modesty, meekness [cf. नैभृत्य]; (अम्), ind. covertly, secretly, privately, apart, unobservedly, im-perceptibly, in a corner, out of sight. —निभृतागत (°त-आग्°), अस्, आ, अम्, secretly arrived. —निभृतात्-मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, resolute-minded, resolute. —निभृतार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having a secret meaning, occult.
निभ्रंश्: निभ्रंश् नि-भ्रंश्, Caus. -भ्राशयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to cause to fall off, to strike or break off.
निम: निम निम, अस्, m. a pin, stake (?).
निमज्ज्: निमज्ज् नि-मज्ज्, cl. 6. P. -मज्जति, -मङ्क्-तुम्, to sink into, sink down, dive, plunge into, immerse one's self, bathe, be immersed or submerged (e. g. अक्षि निमज्जति, the eye sinks; चिरं नि-ममज्ज, he remained long under the water); to be drowned; to penetrate into; to disappear, perish; to immerse or submerge in water, cause to sink (e. g. into hell, Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 4156): Caus. P. -मज्जयति, -यितुम्, to cause to dive, immerse, dip, plunge (any-thing) into water, submerge, drown; (figuratively) to cause to plunge or penetrate into a battle, lead into the thick of a fight.
निमग्न: नि-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged or immersed in, dipped into, fallen into (water &c.), submerged, sunk; gone down, set (as the sun); forcibly entered into or penetrated; (with पर-लोकाय) entered into the other world; sunk in, depressed, not prominent; overwhelmed, covered. —निमग्न-ना-भि, इस्, इस्, इ, having a depressed navel. —निमग्न-मध्या, f. a woman having a depressed (and there-fore slender) waist.
निमग्नक: नि-मग्नक, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding one's self, lurking.
निमज्जत्: नि-मज्जत्, अन्, अती, or अन्ती, अत्, bathing, diving, plunging in, sinking.
निमज्जथु: नि-मज्जथु, उस्, m. the act of diving or entering into, plunging; (with तल्पे) going to bed, sleeping.
निमज्जन: नि-मज्जन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to enter or plunge into (with gen.), immersing, absorbing; (अम्), n. bathing, diving, immersion, sinking.
निमज्जमान: नि-मज्जमान, अस्, आ, अम्, sinking, plunging into; immersed; being drowned.
निमज्जित: नि-मज्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged into the water, drowned.
निमद्: निमद् नि-मद्, Caus. P. -मादयति, -यितुम्, to pronounce distinctly but slowly.
निमद: नि-मद, अस्, m. pronunciation which is distinct but slow, one of the seven degrees of pronunciation (वाचः स्थानानि).
निमन्त्र्: निमन्त्र् नि-मन्त्र्, cl. 10. A. -मन्त्रयते, -यितुम्, to invite, summon, call (to a feast), entertain.
निमन्त्रक: नि-मन्त्रक, अस्, m. one who summons or invites, an inviter.
निमन्त्रण: नि-मन्त्रण, अम्, n. inviting, invitation; sum-moning, calling; a summons. —निमन्त्रण-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a written summons, a note of invitation.
निमन्त्रित: नि-मन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, invited, summoned, convoked; bidden to a feast, entertained.
निमन्त्र्य: नि-मन्त्र्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be invited, to be called.
निमन्यु: निमन्यु नि-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not angry, unresentful, appeased.
निमय: निमय नि-मय। See नि-मे, p. 490, col. 2.
नि-मय, अस्, m. barter, change, exchange.
निमा: निमा नि-मा [cf. नि-मे], cl. 2. 3. P. A. -माति, -मिमीते, -मातुम्, to measure; to adjust.
निमातव्य: 1. नि-मातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be measured, &c.; [the नि-मातव्य which occurs in Manu X. 94. is to be referred to नि-मे, q. v.]
2. नि-मातव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see नि-मा), to be exchanged or bartered.
निमान: नि-मान, अम्, n. measure. See अ-न्°।
निमित: 1. नि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, measured out. See दुर्-न्°।
2. नि-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed in, fixed, erected.
निमेय: 1. नि-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see नि-मे), to be measured, measurable, anything the measure or value of which can be fixed.
2. नि-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 1. see नि-मा), to be ex-changed; (अस्), m. barter, exchange; [cf. नैमेय।]
निमि: निमि 1. निमि, इस्, m., N. of several kings of Videha; of a son of Dattātreya; of a son of Ikṣvāku, (this Nimi lost his body through the curse of Vaśiṣṭha, and when the gods were willing to restore it, requested that instead of receiving his former shape he might occupy the eyes of all living creatures; the request was granted, and in consequence of the presence of Nimi, men's eyelids are ever opening and shutting; cf. नि-मिष, and see Viṣṇu-Purāṇa IV. 5); N. of the twenty-first Jaina Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; of a son of Bhajamāna; of Daṇḍa-pāṇi; of a Dānava; closing or winking of the eyes, twinkling. —निमिन्-धर, अस्, m. (fr. निमिम् acc. sing. + धर), N. of a prince.
निमि 2. नि-मि, cl. 5. P. A. -मिनोति, -मिनुते, &c., to fix in, dig in; to fix, erect.
निमित्त: निमित्त नि-मित्त, अम्, n. (probably con-nected with नि-मा above), a mark, an aim; an archer's butt, target; sign, token; prognostic, pre-sage, omen [cf. दुर्-न्°]; cause, motive, reason, instrumental or efficient cause, (opposed to उपा-दान, the material cause); निमित्त is used at the end of a comp. in the sense ‘having as a motive or cause,’ ‘caused or produced by,’ ‘occasioned by,’ e. g. विष-निमित्ता पीडा, pain caused by poison; (अम् acc., एन inst., आय dat., आत् abl., अस्य gen., ए loc.), because of, on account of, for the sake of, for the purpose of, through. —निमित्त-कारण, अम्, n. an instrumental or efficient cause, (especially the Deity considered as the agent in creation.) —निमित्त-कारण-ता, f. the state of being the efficient cause. —निमित्त-काल, अस्, m. the period or moment of time which may be regarded as causing any event; any given or specific time. —निमित्त-कृत्, त्, m. ‘omen-maker,’ a crow, raven. —निमित्त-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with omens. —निमित्त-ज्ञान, अम्, n. ‘knowledge of causes or signs,’ N. of the fifty-eighth chapter of the Kāma-sūtra by Vātsyāyana. —निमित्त-तस्, ind. by or from a special cause or reason. —निमित्त-ता, f. or निमित्त-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being a cause, causality, instrumentality. —निमित्त-धर्म, अस्, m. expiation; any occa-sional or special penance, rite, or obligation. —नि-मित्त-निदान, अम्, n., N. of a work. —निमित्त-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become a cause or reason, being a cause or means. —निमित्त-मात्र, अम्, n. the mere efficient cause or instrument. —निमित्त-विद्, त्, m. ‘omen-knower,’ an astrologer. —निमित्त-वेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hitting an aim, piercing the mark. —निमित्त-हेतु, उस्, m. an efficient cause. —नि-मित्तहेतु-त्व, अम्, n. the being an instrumental or efficient cause. —निमित्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, m. the infinitive mood (in grammar). —निमित्तावृत्ति (°त-आव्°), इस्, f. dependance upon a special cause or occasion. —निमित्ती-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make anything a cause, to use as a cause or means. —निमित्ती-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to become a cause or reason for (with loc.).
निमित्तक: नि-मित्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp.), caused or occasioned or produced by; (अम्), n. kissing, a kiss.
निमित्तायमान: निमित्तायमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. an unused Nominal verb निमित्ताय), causing, producing.
निमित्तिन्: निमित्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, operated on or influenced by a cause, having a cause or reason.
निमिश्ल: निमिश्ल नि-मिश्ल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devoted to, attached to (with loc.); (Sāy.) commixed, com-mingling, mixing with, being mixed. —निमिश्ल-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most attached to (with loc.).
निमिष्: निमिष् 1. नि-मिष्, cl. 6. P. -मिषति, -मे-षितुम्, to shut the eyelids, wink, twinkle, blink.
2. नि-मिष्, ट्, f., Ved. winking or twinkling of the eye; shutting the eyes, falling asleep [cf. निमि]; अ-निमिष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, never closing or winking the eyes; (ट्), m. a god; [cf. Nala V. 24.]
निमिष: नि-मिष, अस्, m. twinkling, winking, shutting the eye; the twinkling of an eye considered as a measure of time, a moment; morbid twinkling of the eyes; N. of a son of Garuḍa (Mahā-bh. Udyoga-parva 3595); an epithet of Viṣṇu, (also अ-निमिष।) —निमिषान्तर (°ष-अन्°), अम्, n. the interval of a moment; (एण), ind. in a twinkling, in the interval of a moment.
निमिषत्: नि-मिषत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, winking, blinking, closing the eyes.
निमेष: नि-मेष, अस्, अम्, m. n. twinkling of the eyes, (opposed to उन्-मेष); a momentary space of time, a moment, a twinkling of the eye considered as a measure of time; morbid twinkling of the eye, morbid closing of the eyelid; N. of a mythical being; निमेषं निमेषम्, every moment. —नि-मेष-कृत्, त्, f. ‘twinkler,’ lightning. —निमेष-तस्, ind., Ved. with regard to the shutting of the eyes, (according to Mahī-dhara gen. sing. of the pres. part.) —निमेष-द्युत्, त्, or निमेष-रुच्, क्, m. a fire-fly. —निमेष-मात्र, अम्, n. only a twink-ling, merely an instant; (एण), ind. in a twinkling, in an instant of time, in barely a moment. —निमे-षार्धात् (°ष-अर्°), ind. in half a twinkling of the eye, i. e. in less than an instant.
निमेष नि-मेष। See under 1. नि-मिष्, col. 1.
निमेषक: नि-मेषक, अस्, m. twinkling of the eye; a fire-fly.
निमेषण: नि-मेषण, अस्, ई, अम्, causing twinkling &c.
नि-मेषण; add — (अम्), n. the closing of the eyes.
निमिह्: निमिह् नि-मिह्, cl. 1. P. -मेहति, &c., to urine, sprinkle down urine.
निमील्: निमील् नि-मील्, cl. 1. P. -मीलति, -मीलितुम्, to shut or close the eyes, fall asleep, sleep; to close (as flowers); to die, disappear; Caus. -मीलयति, -यितुम्, to cause (one) to shut the eyes, to close; to kill.
निमीलत्: नि-मीलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, closing the eyes, winking the eyelids, twinkling.
निमीलन: नि-मीलन, अम्, n. shutting the eyelids, winking or twinkling of the eyes, winking; closing the eyes in death; (figuratively) dying, death; (in astronomy) immersion, complete obscuration, a total eclipse.
निमीलिका: नि-मीलिका, f. shutting the eyes, winking, twink-ling, blinking, conniving at anything; fraud, trick.
निमीलित: नि-मीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed, shut (as the eye), winked, blinked; blinded, darkened, obscured; [cf. रजो-निमीलित।] —निमीलिताक्ष (°त-अक्°), अस्, ई, अम्, having the eyes closed.
निमीलिन्: नि-मीलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, closing the eyes, having the eyelids shut.
निमीव्: निमीव् नि-मीव्, cl. 1. P. -मीवति, &c., to press on, press down.
निमीश्वर: निमीश्वर निमीश्वर, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of the sixteenth Arhat of the present Ut-sarpiṇī.
निमूलम्: निमूलम् नि-मूलम्, ind. down to the root.
निमृज्: निमृज् नि-मृज्, cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि (cl. 6.
