Ved. -मृजति, -ते), -मार्जितुम्, -मार्ष्टुम्, to rub in, rub upon, wipe, wipe off, wipe away, to cleanse one's self (A.); to lead to, attach to: Intens., Ved. -मामृजे, to wipe away, cleanse; to destroy: Desid., Ved. -मिमृक्षति, (in Ṛg-veda I. 64, 4, Sāy. considers नि-मिमृक्षुः as a Vedic redupli-cated perf. = नि-मृष्टाः स्थिता बभूवुः; accord-ing to some the meaning is ‘to flash down.’)
निमृग्र: नि-मृग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devoted, attached to; (Sāy.) excessively purifying or cleansing.
निमृण्: निमृण् नि-मृण्, cl. 6. P. -मृणति, &c., to dash down, strike down.
निमृद्: निमृद् नि-मृद्, cl. 9. P. -मृद्नाति, -मर्दि-तुम्, to crush, dash to pieces; to rub off.
निमे: निमे नि-मे [cf. नि-मा], cl. 1. A. -मयते, मातुम्, to change, exchange for (with inst.), barter.
निम्न: निम्न निम्न, अम्, n. (fr. नि or perhaps rather fr. rt. नम् with नि or according to others fr. rt. मन् or rt. म्ना with नि), depth, low ground, low-land; a slope, declivity; gap, chasm or cavity in the ground; a depression, deepening; (अस्, आ, अम्), deep, profound (literally or figuratively); low (as ground), depressed, sunk; (अस्), m., N. of a prince. —निम्न-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going low or deep, going downwards, descending; (आ), f. a river, mountain-stream; [cf. गिरि-न्°।] —निम्न-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, going in deep or low places; (अम्), n. a low place. —निम्न-तल, see under निन्द-तल. —निम्न-ता, f. or निम्न-त्व, अम्, n. depth, lowness, profundity. —निम्न-देश, अस्, m. or निम्न-भाग, अस्, m. a low or deep place. —निम्नोन्नत (°न-उन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, low and high, depressed and elevated, up and down.
निम्नैस्: निम्नैस्, ind., Ved. in deep places, low, down-wards; [cf. उच्चैस्, नीचैस्।]
निम्ब: निम्ब निम्ब or निम्बक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. नी), a tree with bitter fruits, Azadirachta Indica, the Nimb or Neemb tree, (the leaves of this tree are chewed at funeral ceremonies); [cf. गिरि-न्°, तृण-न्°।] —निम्ब-तरु, उस्, m. the tree Erythrina Fulgens or (according to others) Melia Sempervirens, (it is considered as one of the trees of paradise.) —निम्ब-रजस्, अस्, n. a particular high number; [cf. महा-न्°।] —निम्ब-वती, f., N. of a woman. —निम्ब-वीज, अस्, m. a tree (= राजादनी). —निम्-बार्क-करवीरार्चन-व्रत (°ब-अर्°, °र-अर्°), अम्, n., N. of a particular vow; N. of the seventy-seventh chapter of the Bhaviṣya-Purāṇa.
निम्बूक: निम्बूक निम्बूक, अस्, m. the common lime, Citrus Acida; (also read निस्बू।)
निम्लुच्: निम्लुच् नि-म्लुच् (Ved. नि-म्रुच्), cl. 1. P. -म्लोचति, &c., to set, disappear (as the sun).
निम्रुक्ति: नि-म्रुक्ति, Ved., or in later Sanskrit नि-म्लुक्ति, इस्, f. sunset, setting of the sun, disappearance.
निम्रुच्: नि-म्रुच्, क्, f., Ved. sunset, setting of the sun, evening; (क्, क्, क्), slack, loose.
निम्लोच: नि-म्लोच, अस्, m. setting of the sun, sunset.
निम्लोचनी: नि-म्लोचनी, f. (fr. an unused form नि-म्लोचन), N. of the city of Varuṇa situated on the mountain Mānasottara towards the west.
निम्लोचि: नि-म्लोचि, इस्, m., N. of a prince, son of Bhajamāna.
नियत: नि-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, curbed, restrained, held in; governed, controlled, subdued, submissive, self-governed; abstemious, self-denying, temperate; attentive, intent upon; fixed, constant, steady, per-manent, incessant; ascertained, certain, destined, settled, sure; inevitable; positive, definite; perme-able, what may be spread through or over?; (अम्), n. elementary or crude matter, the recipient of attri-butes or properties; (अम्), ind. always, constantly, decidedly, positively, surely, certainly, inevitably; for-cibly. —नियत-मानस, अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued mind or spirit. —नियत-विषय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, steadily abiding in one's own sphere. —नियतात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, self-regulated, self-controlled, self-restrained. —नियताहार (°त-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, abstemious in food, temperate. —नियतेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the passions subdued or restrained.
नियन्त्र्: नियन्त्र् नि-यन्त्र्, cl. 10. P. -यन्त्रयति, &c., to restrain, [apparently only used in the derivatives.]
नियन्त्रण: नि-यन्त्रण, अम्, n. the act of restraining, restraint, checking; governing, guiding; defining, definition.
नियन्त्रित: नि-यन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, restrained, curbed, checked; governed, guided.
नियम्: नियम् नि-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्, to check, curb, restrain, hold back, suppress, stop; to hold in (as the breath &c.); govern, control, rule, direct, regulate; to punish; to restrict; to bind, confine, fasten; to conceal; to attain, obtain; to assume; to present, offer; to place or fix upon: Caus. -यमयति, -यितुम्, to restrain, curb, check.
नियति: नि-यति, इस्, f. restraint, restriction; the fixed order of things, necessity, destiny, fate, luck, good or bad fortune; a religious duty or obligation; self-command, self-restraint; (नियति is sometimes per-sonified as a goddess, she and Āyati being regarded as daughters of Meru and wives of Dhātṛ and Vi-dhātṛ); (ई), f. an epithet of Durgā.
नियन्तवय: नि-यन्तवय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be restrained, checked, controlled, tamed; to be forced.
नियन्तृ: नि-यन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what holds in, restrains, curbs, governs, guides, tames, &c.; re-straining; (ता), m. a restrainer, charioteer, driver, coachman; a ruler, governor, master; a punisher. —नियन्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. restraint, government, abi-lity to rule, power of restraining, controlling faculty.
नियम: नि-यम, अस्, m. restraining, holding back, check-ing, keeping back; taming, subduing, preventing, confining; restraint, restriction, restriction to (with loc.); limitation; fixing, defining, definition; keeping down, lowering (as the tone of the voice); fixed rule or law, necessity, obligation; rule, precept (e. g. स्त्रीणाम् प्राकृत-भाषणम् एव नियमः, the usage of women is to speak only Prākṛt); certainty, ascertainment; agreement, contract, engagement, assent, promise, vow; any self-imposed restraint or religious observance voluntarily practised, as fast-ing, watching, pilgrimage, praying, &c.; voluntary penance, meritorious or supererogatory piety; a lesser vow, minor observance (as opposed to यम, a greater vow which must always be observed); (in rhetoric) a common-place in poetry, any conventional expres-sion or usual comparison (as notice of the birch in describing the Himālaya, of the sandal tree in de-scribing the Malaya mountains, of the peacock's cry in the rains, of the koïl in spring, &c.); Necessity or Fixed Law personified as a son of Dharma by Dhṛti; (एन or आत्), ind. by a fixed rule, necessarily, surely, certainly. —नियम-निष्ठा, f. rigid ob-servance of prescribed rites. —नियम-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a written agreement or stipulation. —नियम-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, observing fixed rules; relating to or corroborative of a rule. —नियम-पाल, अस्, m. ‘observer of vows,’ N. of a sage from whom the Nepalese derive the name of their country, (properly Nipāl.) —नियम-भङ्ग, अस्, m. breach of a stipulation or contract. —नियम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, practising or observing religious observances; (अती), f. (a woman) having the monthly courses. —नियम-स्थिति, इस्, f. a state of self-restraint, steady observance of religious obligations, asceticism.
नियमन: नि-यमन, अस्, ई, अम्, regulating, controlling, subduing, taming, overpowering; (अम्), n. subduing, checking, restraining; humiliation, coercion; binding; restriction, limitation; precept, fixed practice or rule.
नियमित: नि-यमित, अस्, आ, अम्, checked, restrained, sup-pressed, bound, confined; governed, guided; fixed, regulated, prescribed, stipulated, agreed upon.
नियम्य: 1. नि-यम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be checked or re-strained, restrainable, tamable.
2. नि-यम्य, ind. having restrained, having guided, &c.
नियाम: नि-याम, अस्, m. = नि-यम, restraint; religious vow, penance, fasting, &c., especially if an act of supererogation; = नि-यामक, a boatman, sailor; [cf. निर्-याम।]
नियामक: नि-यामक, अस्, आ, अम्, restraining, checking, con-trolling, subduing, suppressing, overpowering; re-strictive, limiting; defining more closely; guiding, governing, who or what regulates or restrains; a re-strainer, ruler, master; (अस्), m. a charioteer; a boat-man, a sailor, but variously applied to one who rows or steers, a pilot, a helmsman; [cf. निर्-याम।] —नि-यामक-ता, f. controllership, power of restraining, restraint; exact definition, explanation.
नियामन: नि-यामन, अम्, n. taming, checking, restraining; (probably incorrectly for नि-यमन।)
निययिन्: निययिन् नि-ययिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. या with नि), Ved. driving over, passing over (as a carriage).
नियान: नि-यान, अम्, n., Ved. way, access.
नियव: नियव नि-यव। See under 2. नि-यु below.
नि-यव, अस्, m. compact order, continuous line or series; (Sāy.) mixing, mixture.
नियातन: नियातन नि-यातन, अम्, n. causing to fall or descend; (wrong reading for नि-पातन, q. v.)
नियु: नियु 1. नि-यु, cl. 3. P. -युयोति, &c., Ved. to repel, keep off.
नियु 2. नि-यु, cl. 2. P. -यौति, cl. 9. P. A. -युनाति, -नीते, -यवितुम्, to join, yoke, harness; to mix; to bestow.
नियुत्: नि-युत्, त्, f., Ved. series, line, row; (Sāy.) a horse, steed (as harnessed to a car), especially one of the horses of Vāyu called Niyuts; praise, a praiser; (अस्), f. pl. series of words [cf. ग्रन्थ, नि-बन्-धन], verses, a poem; (Sāy.) a team of horses, especially the Niyuts or horses of Vāyu; N. of a wife of Rudra in one of his different forms. —नियुत्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. forming a series; flowing continuously, as the Soma; drawn by a line of horses, as Vāyu or Indra, or the Maruts; (Sāy.) possessing the Niyut steeds, possessing horses; containing the word नियुत् or नियुत्-वत् (as a verse or hymn). —नियुद्-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose car is drawn by a line or team of horses; (Sāy.) having a harnessed chariot.

नियुत नि-युत। See under 2. नि-यु, col. 1.
नियुत्वतीय: नि-युत्वतीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to Niyut-vat (Vāyu).
नियुज्: नियुज् नि-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते, -योक्तुम्, to join to, attach or fasten to; to put to (horses), yoke, harness; to place over, appoint, elect or depute any one to any office or duty (with acc. of the person and loc. of the thing or business); to give authority, authorize; to assign, employ, engage; to commit, intrust, commission; to enjoin, order, command; to constrain, urge, coerce, compel; to harass: Caus. नियुक्तक: नि-युक्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, appointed, elected, placed in authority.
नियुक्ति: नि-युक्ति, इस्, f. injunction, order, command; ap-pointment, commission, charge, office.

नियुज्यमान: नि-युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being appointed, being engaged or employed.

नियोक्तव्य: नि-योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be appointed or autho-rized, to be employed, ordered, &c.
नियोक्तृ: नि-योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who joins or fastens or attaches; (ता), m. a ruler, lord master.
नियोग: नि-योग, अस्, m. attaching or fastening to; appli-cation, use, employment, appointment, injunction, direction, order, command, commission, charge, precept; any trust or appointed task or duty, any business or function committed to one's charge; effort, exertion; certainty, ascertainment; necessity; (आत् or एन), ind. according to order or command, necessarily, certainly, surely. —नियोग-करण, अम्, n. making a command, commanding. —नियोग-तस्, ind. according to order or command. —नियोग-पाश, अस्, m. a fastening, (probably) a halter. —नि-योग-प्रयोजन, अम्, n. the object or business of any appointment, authorized act or duty. —नियोग-विधि, इस्, m. the form or rule of appointing to any act or duty. —नियोगार्थ (°ग-अर्°), अस्, m. the object of an authorized act or appointment.
नियोग नि-योग। See under नि-युज् above.
नियोगिन्: नि-योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, appointed, authorized, invested with authority, employed, engaged in any duty, attached to any business; (ई), m. a functionary, an official, officer, man in office, a minister, a deputy, an agent, &c. —नियोग्य्-अर्थ-ग्रहोपाय (°ह-उप्°), अस्, m. the resource of confiscating the property of men in office.
नियोग्य: नि-योग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be enjoined or prescribed; fit to be appointed or authorized, able or qualified for a duty [cf. नि-योज्य]; (अस्), m. (according to Vopa-deva) a master.
नियोजन: नि-योजन, अम्, n. tying or fastening (as an animal to the Yūpa or sacrificial post); uniting, attaching to; that with which anything is fastened or tied (Ved.); ordering, prescribing, commanding, directing; urging, impelling; appointing (e. g. क्रि-यासु, to affairs); (ई), f. a halter.
नियोजनीय: नि-योजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attached or joined to, to be appointed or authorized.
नियोजयितव्य: नि-योजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be appointed, to be commanded or urged or directed.
नियोजित: नि-योजित, अस्, आ, अम्, joined or attached to, con-nected with, adapted to; appointed, authorized, commissioned; directed, ordered; impelled, urged, instigated.
नियोज्य: नि-योज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fastened or attached to; fit to be appointed or employed in; to be ordered, commanded, directed, instigated; proper to be en-joined; (अस्), m. a functionary, official, employé, servant.
नियुत्सा: नियुत्सा नि-युत्सा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. युध् with नि without reduplication), N. of the wife of Pra-stāva and mother of Vi-bhu.
नियुद्ध: नि-युद्ध, अम्, n. (fr. rt. युध् with नि), fight-ing, especially fighting on foot, close fight or combat, personal struggle. —नियुद्ध-भू, ऊस्, f. a battle-field, a place where close fighting has taken place.
नियोद्धृ: नि-योद्धृ, धा, m. a combatant, a wrestler, a boxer; a cock.
नियोधक: नि-योधक, अस्, m. a fighter, combatant, wrestler, pugilist.
निर्: निर् निर् euphonically substituted for निस्, q. v., before vowels and soft consonants.
निरंश: निरंश निर्-अंश, अस्, आ, अम्, having no part or fraction remaining, whole. —निरंश-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having no part or fraction over, wholeness, completeness.
निरंशु: निरंशु निर्-अंशु, उस्, उस्, उ, having no rays, rayless.
निरक्ष: निरक्ष निर्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no dice; having no latitude; (अस्), m. (in astronomy) the place of no latitude, i. e. the terrestrial equator. —निरक्ष-देश, अस्, m. a first meridian, as Laṅkā; a place where the sun is always vertical and the days and nights are equal; the equatorial region.
निरग्नि: निरग्नि निर्-अग्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, or निरग्निक, अस्, आ, अम्, having no fire, having lost or neglected the consecrated fire.
निरघ: निरघ निर्-अघ, अस्, आ, अम्, sinless, blame-less, free from fault or imperfection.
निरङ्कुश: निरङ्कुश निर्-अङ्कुश, अस्, आ, अम्, unchecked (lit. not held by a hook), uncontrolled, unruly, self-willed, unfettered, independant, completely free; (अम्), ind. freely. —निरङ्कुश-ता, f. or निरङ्कुश-त्व, अम्, n. unruliness, independance, self-will, wil-fulness.
निरङ्ग: निरङ्ग निर्-अङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having no re-sources, deprived of expedients.
निरज्: निरज् निर्-अज्, cl. 1. P. -अजति, -अजितुम् (Ved. inf. -अजे), Ved. to drive or bring out, extricate, re-move; to issue out.
निरजिन: निरजिन निर्-अजिन, अस्, आ, अम्, without a skin or hide, skinless.
निरञ्छन: निरञ्छन नि-रञ्छन, अम्, n. (fr. रञ्छ् = लञ्छ् with नि), a mark or knot in a measuring line.
निरञ्जन: निरञ्जन 1. निर्-अञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, without collyrium or ointment, unstained, untinged, unblack-ened, unpainted; free from falsehood; artless; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the attendants of Śiva; (आ), f. an epithet of Durgā; the day of full moon.
निरञ्जन 2. नि-रञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, void of passion or emotion, (applied to the Supreme Being.)
निरण्: निरण् नि-रण्, cl. 1. P. -रणति, -रणितुम्, Ved. to rejoice, delight in.
निरत: निरत नि-रत। See नि-रम्, p. 492, col. 2.
नि-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged or interested in; attached or devoted to; pleased, delighted; rested, ceased.
निरतिशय: निरतिशय निर्-अतिशय, अस्, आ, अम्, unsur-passed. —निरतिशय-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being unsurpassed, unsurpassedness.
निरत्यय: निरत्यय निर्-अत्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from danger, dangerless, secure, infallible, completely successful, faultless, unblamable.
निरधिष्ठान: निरधिष्ठान निर्-अधिष्ठान, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing no fixed resting-place, having no solid basis.
निरध्व: निरध्व निर्-अध्व, अस्, आ, अम्, (probably) one who has lost his way.
निरनुक्रोश: निरनुक्रोश निर्-अनुक्रोश, अस्, m. absence of compassion, hard-heartedness, unmercifulness; (अस्, आ, अम्), uncompassionate, without pity, pitiless, merci-less; hard-hearted towards any person or thing (with loc.). —निरनुक्रोश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting without compassion or pitilessly. —निरनुक्रोश-ता, f. piti-lessness, unmercifulness; hard-heartedness, cruelty. —निरनुक्रोश-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, uncompassionate, ruthless, hard-hearted.
निरनुग: निरनुग निर्-अनुग, अस्, आ, अम्, unattended, without retinue or followers.
निरनुग्रह: निरनुग्रह निर्-अनुग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, unfa-vourable, unkind, ungracious.
निरनुनासिक: निरनुनासिक निर्-अनुनासिक, अस्, आ, अम्, not marked with the nasal symbol called Anunāsika (Gram. 7), not nasal.
निरनुमान: निरनुमान निर्-अनुमान, अस्, आ, अम्, without inference, not binding one's self to conclusions or consequences.
निरनुरोध: निरनुरोध निर्-अनुरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unfa-vourable, unfriendly, unkind, ungracious, unamiable.
निरन्तर: निरन्तर निर्-अन्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, without any intermediate space, having no intervening space, granting no room or free space, having no interval, closely contiguous, close; closely connected, conti-nuous; uninterrupted, continual, constant; without interstices, completely filled, compact, dense, coarse, gross; persevering, faithful, true (as a friend); un-concealed, not hidden from view; not other or dif-ferent, similar, identical; (अम्), ind. without inter-vening space, without interval, without interruption, constantly, incessantly, continually; closely, tightly, firmly; immediately. —निरन्तराभ्यास (°र-अभ्°), अस्, m. constant repetition or study, continual reading to one's self; diligent and uninterrupted exercise or practice.
निरन्तराल: निरन्तराल निर्-अन्तराल, अस्, आ, अम्, without an intervening space, without intervals or interstices; close, contracted, narrow. —निरन्तराल-ता, f. close contiguity, closeness, compactness, narrowness.
निरन्धस्: निरन्धस् निर्-अन्धस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, foodless, without food, hungry.
निरन्न: निरन्न निर्-अन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, foodless, want-ing food, hungry, starving; giving no food.
निरन्वय: निरन्वय निर्-अन्वय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no offspring or descendants, childless; unconnected with, unrelated; not agreeing with the context (of a sen-tence); without logical connection, without regular order or sequence, unmethodical; without being seen or observed, out of sight, not visibly committed (Manu VIII. 332).
निरप: निरप निर्-अप, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, desti-tute of water.
निरपत्रप: निरपत्रप निर्-अपत्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, shame-less, impudent; bold, confident.
निरपराध: निरपराध निर्-अपराध, अस्, m. faultless-ness, innocence; (अस्, आ, अम्), unoffending, inoffen-sive, innocent, faultless, guiltless, blameless. —निर्-अपराध-ता, f. faultlessness, innocence. —निरप-राध-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, faultless, innocent.
निरपवर्त: निरपवर्त निर्-अपवर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not re-turning or turning back; (in arithmetic) leaving no common measure, not to be divided by a common divisor, reduced to the lowest terms.
निरपवाद: निरपवाद निर्-अपवाद, अस्, आ, अम्, free from censure, without reproof, blameless.
निरपाय: निरपाय निर्-अपाय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from destruction or decay, imperishable, eternal, free from detriment or loss, free from harm or evil; infallible.
निरपेक्ष: निरपेक्ष निर्-अपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, disregard-ing, not taking notice of (with loc.); careless, negli-gent, without desire, indifferent; not expecting any-thing from another; independant of, unconnected or unconcerned with; (often without any object) re-gardless, indifferent (to praise or blame); without purpose or hope; (आ), f. indifference; disregard, the absence of expectation; (अम्), n. without regard, regardlessly, accidentally. —निरपेक्ष-ता, f. or निरपेक्ष-त्व, अम्, n. disregard, indifference; independance; relationlessness.
निरपेक्षित: निर्-अपेक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, disregarded; regardless.
निरपेक्षिन्: निर्-अपेक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, disregarding, indifferent, not expecting anything.
निरपेक्ष्य: निर्-अपेक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be regarded.
निरभिभव: निरभिभव निर्-अभिभव, अस्, आ, अम्, not subject to defeat or humiliation, not disgraced; not to be surpassed.
निरभिमान: निरभिमान निर्-अभिमान or निर्-अभीमान, अस्, आ, अम्, exempt from pride, free from self-con-ceit, devoid of egotism; unconscious.
निरभिलाष: निरभिलाष निर्-अभिलाष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no desire for, not intent upon, indifferent.
निरभ्र: निरभ्र निर्-अभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, cloudless; (ए), ind. in a cloudless sky, when the sky is unclouded.
निरम्: निरम् नि-रम्, cl. 1. A. -रमते, -रन्तुम्, Ved. to delight in, be delighted; to rest, repose, desist: Caus. -रामयति, -यितुम्, Aor. -अरीरमत्, Ved. to gladden; to cause to rest or abide.
निरति: नि-रति, इस्, f. delighting in; attachment to.
निरमण: नि-रमण, अम्, n. delighting in; resting; (in Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa XIII. 4, 2, 5, नि-रमण is by some separated into निर्-अमण and explained to mean ‘exhausted,’ ‘worn out.’)
निरमर्ष: निरमर्ष निर्-अमर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not im-patient; patient, apathetic, devoid of energy.
निरमित्र: निरमित्र निर्-अमित्र, अस्, आ, अम्, without foes, free from enemies; (अस्), m., N. of several persons; of a son of Nakula; of a king of Tri-garta; of a son of Khaṇḍa-pāṇi or Daṇḍa-pāṇi, (also निर्-आमित्र); of a son of Ayutāyus; of a sage, con-sidered as a son of Śiva, (also निर्-आमित्र।)
निरम्बर: निरम्बर निर्-अम्बर, अस्, आ, अम्, undressed, naked.
निरम्बु: निरम्बु निर्-अम्बु, उस्, उस्, उ, abstaining from water, not drinking; waterless, destitute of water.
निरय: निरय निर्-अय, अस्, m. ‘without happiness,’ hell [cf. तिर्यन्-निरय]; Niraya or Hell personified as a child of fear and death; (according to some निर्-अय, in the sense of ‘hell,’ is fr. निर्-इ and means ‘exit,’ ‘egress from life.’)
निरर्गल: निरर्गल निर्-अर्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, unbarred, without a bolt or hindrance, unobstructed, unrestrained, unimpeded; irresistible; (अम्), ind. without bolt or bar; without restraint or constraint, freely.
निरर्थ: निरर्थ निर्-अर्थ, अस्, m. loss, detriment; nonsense; (अस्, आ, अम्), destitute of wealth, poor; useless; meaningless, unmeaning, nonsensical, pur-poseless, vain; (a consonant is called निर्-अर्थ, not fulfilling its purpose if it is not followed by a vowel.) —निरर्थ-ता, f. senselessness, nonsense.
निरर्थक: निर्-अर्थक, अस्, आ or इका or अकी (?), अम्, not fulfilling one's aim or object, purposeless, useless, vain, unprofitable; having no reasonable sense, unmeaning, nonsensical; a consonant which is not followed by a vowel; (अम्), ind. without a purpose, uselessly, in vain. —निरर्थक-त्व, अम्, n. uselessness, vanity.
निरर्द्: निरर्द् निर्-अर्द्, cl. 1. P. -अर्दति, -अर्दितुम्, Ved. to stream forth, flow out.
निरर्बुद: निरर्बुद निर्-अर्बुद, अस्, m.? (with Bud-dhists) N. of a hell in which the wicked are punished by excessive cold.
निरव: निरव निर्-अव, अस्, आ, अम्? (occurring only in the gen. sing. निर्-अवस्य, which might be the ind. part. of rt. सो with preps. निर् and अव; said by others to be = नि = निस् + रव, अस्, m. loss of voice; but according to Sāy.) Ved. having no protector or uttering praise.
निरवकाश: निरवकाश निर्-अवकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, without free space; having no room for moving freely, wanting an opportunity, without leisure.
निरवग्रह: निरवग्रह निर्-अवग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, without obstruction or obstacle, unrestrained, unchecked, un-controlled; irresistible; free, independant; self-willed, unmanageable, headstrong.
निरवत्त: निरवत्त निर्-अव-त्त, निर्-अव-त्ति। See un-der निर्-अव-दो, col. 3.
निर्-अव-त्त, अस्, आ, अम्, distributed, completely divided or allotted.
निरवदय्: निरवदय् निर्-अव-दय्, cl. 1. A. -दयते, Ved. to distribute, allot a share or shares.
निरवदो: निरवदो निर्-अव-दो [cf. 3. दा], cl. 2. 4. P., Ved. -दाति and -द्यति, -दातुम्, to distribute, allot a share, give any one his share, to satisfy a claim; to divide completely among.
निरवत्ति: निर्-अव-त्ति, इस्, f., Ved. allotment or distribution of shares.
निरवद्य: निरवद्य निर्-अवद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unblamable, blameless, faultless, unobjectionable, unexceptionable; (अम्), n. (or आ?), f. unblamableness, blamelessness, faultlessness; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?), a particular high number. —निरवद्य-त्व, अम्, n. blamelessness, unblamableness, excellence. —निरवद्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, unblamable, blameless.
निरवधि: निरवधि निर्-अवधि, इस्, इस्, इ, without bounds or boundaries, unlimited.
निरवयव: निरवयव निर्-अवयव, अस्, आ, अम्, without limbs or members, without component parts, not consisting of parts, indivisible. —निरवयव-त्व, अम्, n. indivisibility.
निरवरोध: निरवरोध निर्-अवरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unre-strained, unobstructed, unopposed.
निरवलम्ब: निरवलम्ब निर्-अवलम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having no prop or stay; unsupported; not affording support; not depending or relying on.
निरवलम्बन: निर्-अवलम्बन, अम्, n. want of a prop, want of reliance, want of a person or thing to depend upon.
निरवशेष: निरवशेष निर्-अवशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, without a residue, complete, whole; (एण), ind. completely, totally, fully, particularly, circumstantially. —निर्-अवशेष-तस्, ind. completely, &c. (= निरवशे-षेण).
निरवसाद: निरवसाद निर्-अवसाद, अस्, आ, अम्, not cast down, cheerful, good-humoured.
निरवस्कृत: निरवस्कृत निर्-अवस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, clean?; [cf. अवस्-कर, अन्-अवस्कर।]
निरवस्तार: निरवस्तार निर्-अवस्तार, अस्, आ, अम्, without a bed or coverlet; not strewn (with leaves &c.), bare.
निरवहालिका: निरवहालिका निर्-अवहालिका, f. a fence, a hedge, an outer wall; [cf. अवहालिका।]
निरविन्द: निरविन्द निरविन्द, अस्, m., N. of a moun-tain.
निरवेक्ष्: निरवेक्ष् निर्-अवेक्ष् (-अव-ईक्ष्), cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षितुम्, to perceive.
निरवेक्ष्य: निर्-अवेक्ष्य, ind. having perceived or observed.
निरव्यय: निरव्यय निर्-अवयय, अस्, आ, अम्, undecaying, eternal.
निरश्: निरश् निर्-अश्, cl. 9. P. -अश्नाति, &c., Ved. to eat up, consume entirely.
निरशित: निर्-अशित, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten up, completely con-sumed.
निरशन: निरशन निर्-अशन, अस्, आ, अम्, abstaining from food; (अम्), n. going without food, fasting.
निरष्ट: निरष्ट निर्-अष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. अश् or अक्ष् with निस्), Ved. deprived of vigour, exhausted; (Sāy.) = निर्-आकृत, driven away, scattered, dispersed.
निरस्: निरस् निर्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to cast out, throw away, drive away, banish, expel, evict, drive back, send back; to keep off; to turn out (of doors); to reject, repudiate, decline, refuse; to re-move; to tear out, strip off; to stretch out (e. g. हस्तौ निरस्यति or -ते, he stretches out the hands); to annihilate, destroy, subdue.
निरसन: निर्-असन, अस्, ई, अम्, expelling, removing, re-jecting; vomiting, spitting out; (अम्), n. expelling, ejecting; expulsion, removal, rejection, denial, con-tradiction, refusal, disallowance; vomiting forth, spitting out; suppressing, checking; killing, destroy-ing, destruction, extermination.
निरसनीय: निर्-असनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be thrown out, to be driven away or expelled.
निरस्त: निर्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cast out or away, expelled; thrown out or away, cast off; thrown off (as from a horse); driven away, expelled, banished; rejected, repudiated, abandoned, deserted; disallowed; re-futed; sent forth, sent away; deprived of, removed; shot off, discharged (as an arrow); spit out; uttered hurriedly or rapidly (as a speech or word); torn out or away; destroyed; broken (as an agreement); suppressed, checked; (अम्), n. rejecting; dropping or leaving out, not pronouncing (regarded as a fault in pronunciation). —निरस्त-भेद, अस्, आ, अम्, having all difference removed, identical. —निरस्त-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has abandoned worldly desires or has devoted himself to religious penance.
निरस्य: 1. निर्-अस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be expelled or driven out.
2. निरस्य, ind. having cast out, thrown out or ejected, having expelled.
निरस्यत्: निर्-अस्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, ejecting, throwing out; expelling; abandoning, neglecting, scattering, de-stroying, &c.
निरस्यमान: निर्-अस्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being thrown out or expelled; being abandoned; being suppressed, &c.
निरास: निर्-आस, अस्, m. throwing out, casting out, ejection, expulsion, removal, abandonment; dropping (a sound or letter &c.); vomiting; opposing, contradiction, refutation. —निरास-गुटिका, f. a pill to produce vomiting; (also written निराश-गुटिका।)
निरास निर्-आस, अस्, m. See under निर्-अस् at p. 493, col. 1.
निरासन: निर्-आसन, अम्, n. = निर्-असन, p. 492, col. 3.
निरस: निरस नि-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, = नी-रस, without flavour, tasteless, insipid, dry; (अस्), m. want of flavour, insipidity; want of juice, dryness; want of passion or feeling; (आ), f. a species of grass (= निः-श्रेणिका).
निरस्त्र: निरस्त्र निर्-अस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, weaponless, unarmed; (fought) without weapons (as a battle).
निरस्थि: निरस्थि निर्-अस्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, having no bones, boneless.
निरह्: निरह् निर्-अह्, only in perf. निर्-आह, Ved. to utter, pronounce, express.
निरहङ्कार: निरहङ्कार निर्-अहङ्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, free from egotism, devoid of selfishness, free from pride, humble, lowly.
निरहङ्कृत: निर्-अहङ्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, having no self-con-sciousness, without individuality or personality; un-selfish.
निरहङ्कृति: निर्-अहङ्कृति, इस्, इस्, इ, free from egotism or selfishness.
निरहङ्क्रिय: निर्-अहङ्क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no individu-ality or personality, without self-consciousness.
निरहङ्क्रिया: निर्-अहङ्क्रिया, f. absence of egotism or selfishness.
निरहम्: निरहम् निर्-अहम् or निर्-अहम्मति, इस्, इस्, इ, devoid of self-conceit, free from selfishness.
निराक: निराक निराक, अस्, m. cooking; sweat; the recompense of a bad action; (wrong reading for नि-पाक।)
निराकरण: निराकरण निर्-आकरण। See under निर्-आ-कृ, col. 2.

निर्-आकरण, अम्, n. repudiating, expelling, turn-ing out, turning away, throwing off; removing, banishing; repudiation, obstruction, opposition, con-tradiction, rejection; refutation, reply; contempt, disesteem; forgetting; neglecting the chief sacrificial or religious duties.
निराकाङ्क्ष: निराकाङ्क्ष निर्-आकाङ्क्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, expect-ing nothing, wishing nothing, free from desire; wanting nothing to fill up or make complete (as the sense of a sentence or word).
निराकाङ्क्षिन्: निराकाङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, expecting nothing, wish-ing or wanting nothing.
निराकार: निराकार 1. निर्-आकार, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see निर्-आ-कृ, col. 2), devoid of form, deprived of one's natural form; without external appearance; formless, shapeless, deformed; disguised; unassuming; not claiming anything for one's self, modest; (अस्), m. heaven, Viṣṇu; Śiva; the universal Spirit, God.
2. निर्-आकार, अस्, m. rebuke, reproach, censure, blame. (For 1. निर्-आकार see col. 1.)
निराकृति: 1. निर्-आकृति, इस्, इस्, इ, formless, shapeless, de-formed, ugly; (इस्), m. a person who has not duly gone through a course of study, (especially applied however to the religious student who has not duly read the Vedas); one who neglects the five great religious obligations, who does not worship the gods, &c.; a Brāhman who neglects the duties of his caste (आकृति) by not going through a regular course of study.

2. निर्-आकृति, इस्, f. repudiation, rejection; refusal, disallowance; obstruction, obstacle, impediment, in-terruption; contradiction, opposition; (इस्, इस्, इ), impeding, obstructing; annihilating, destroying; (इस्), m., N. of a son of the first Manu Sāvarṇi.
निराकृति 1. and 2. निर्-आकृति। See under 1. निर्-आकार, col. 1, and under निर्-आ-कृ above.
निराकाश: निराकाश निर्-आकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, having no free space, leaving no room, completely filled.
निराकुल: निराकुल निर्-आकुल, अस्, आ, अम्, unconfused, not disordered; unperplexed; unbewildered; clear; steady, calm; perspicuous; (अम्), n. calmness, per-spicuity, clearness.
निराकृ: निराकृ निर्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-रुते, -कर्तुम्, to separate or divide off (Ved.); to push away, turn or drive away, repudiate, keep away, keep off, banish, expel, eject, remove, reject; to refuse; to oppose, obstruct, contradict; to disallow; to omit, intermit; to frustrate; to contemn, spurn.
निराकरिष्णु: निर्-आकरिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, expelling, repudiating, a repudiator; obstructive, obstructing, hindering from (with abl.); spurning, disdaining, despising; seeking to remove from (with abl.), envying any person anything (abl.); forgetful. —निराकरिष्णु-ता, f. the state of being a repudiator; envy, malevolence.
निराकर्तृ: निर्-आकर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a repudiator, repudi-ating; a despiser, contemner (as of the gods).
निराकृत: निर्-आकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, pushed away, driven away, repudiated, expelled, banished, ejected, rejected, re-moved, set aside, turned away, turned out; thrown off; divorced; refused, denied; refuted, replied to; contemned, despised, spurned, made light of; de-prived of. —निराकृतान्योत्तर (°त-अन्य-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, refuting every answer, irrefutable, irrefragable. —निराकृतान्योत्तर-त्व, अम्, n. irrefutableness, irrefragableness.
निराकृतिन्: निर्-आकृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (probably) repudiating, impeding, obstructing; avoiding; making no exertion either to do or avoid.
निराक्रिया: निर्-आक्रिया, f. repudiation, expulsion, removal; contradiction, denial, refutation.
निराक्रन्द: निराक्रन्द निर्-आक्रन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, not com-plaining; a place where no sound can be heard.
निर्-आक्रन्द; add — having no friend or pro-tector, affording no refuge or protection.
निराक्रम्: निराक्रम् निर्-आ-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रान्तुम् and -क्रमितुम्, to come forth, to go out of.
निराक्रोश: निराक्रोश निर्-आक्रोश, अस्, आ, अम्, unaccused, unreviled.
निराग: निराग नि-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, passionless, dis-passionate.
निरागम: निरागम निर्-आगम, अस्, आ, अम्, not founded on revelation, not resting on scripture.
निरागस्: निरागस् निर्-आगस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, sinless, fault-less, innocent.
निराग्रह: निराग्रह निर्-आग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, not insist-ing upon, not peremptory or obstinate.
निराचार: निराचार निर्-आचार, अस्, आ, अम्, without approved usages or customs, lawless, barbarian, (espe-cially applied to those people who have not the ordi-nances of the Vedas or distinction of castes.)
निराजीव्य: निराजीव्य निर्-आजीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not yield-ing subsistence, not granting a livelihood.
निराडम्बर: निराडम्बर निर्-आडम्बर, अस्, आ, अम्, without drums. —निराडम्बर-सुन्दर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, (perhaps) beautiful in itself, not requiring a drum to attract attention or not requiring ornaments.
निरातङ्क: निरातङ्क निर्-आतङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, not feeling pain or uneasiness, without ailment, well, comfort-able; not causing pain or ailment or disagreeable feelings; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva.
निरातप: निरातप निर्-आतप, अस्, आ, अम्, not pene-trated by the sun's rays, shady; (आ), f. the night.
निरात्मक: निरात्मक निर्-आत्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-आत्मन्, आ, आ, अ, or निरात्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having no separate soul or no individual existence.
निरादर: निरादर निर्-आदर, अस्, आ, अम्, showing no respect, disrespectful.
निरादान: निरादान निर्-आदान, अस्, आ, अम्, taking nothing, not taking, one from whom nothing is taken; an epithet of Buddha.
निरादिष्ट: निरादिष्ट निर्-आदिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, paid off (as a debt).
निरादेश: निर्-आदेश, अस्, m. complete payment or discharge of a debt.
निराधा: निराधा निर्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते, &c., Ved. to take out of, take away.
निराधान: निराधान निर्-आधान, अस्, आ, अम्, without a receptacle.
निराधार: निराधार निर्-आधार, अस्, आ, अम्, without a receptacle; without a fulcrum or support.
निराधि: निराधि निर्-आधि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from anxiety, undisturbed by care.
निरानन्द: निरानन्द निर्-आनन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, joyless, sad, sorrowful; not delighting. —निर्-आनन्द-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing no pleasure, causing care or sorrow.
निरान्त्र: निरान्त्र निर्-आन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. evisce-rated, disembowelled; having the entrails hanging out.
निरापद्: निरापद् निर्-आपद्, त्, f. freedom from mis-fortune or calamity, a prosperous condition, security; (त्, त्, त्), free from calamity or misfortune, prosperous, fortunate.
निराबाध: निराबाध निर्-आबाध, अस्, आ, अम्, undis-turbed, unmolested, unvexed, secure from disturb-ance; unobstructed; not disturbing, not molesting, not injuring, not paining; frivolously or not really vexatious. —निर्-आबाध-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, not causing injury or pain.
निरामय: निरामय निर्-आमय, अस्, अम्, m. n. freedom from illness, health, happiness, welfare; (अस्, आ, अम्), free from illness, healthy, well, hale, recovered from sickness, free from disease; free from taint, pure; guileless; free from defects or failings; infallible; not liable to failure or miscarriage; complete, full; (अस्), m. a wild goat; a hog, a boar; N. of a king.
निरामर्द: निरामर्द निर्-आमर्द, अस्, m. ‘not oppress-ing,’ N. of a king.
निरामालु: निरामालु निर्-आमालु, उस्, m. (fr. निराम-आलु?), the wood apple, Feronia Elephantum; [cf. कपित्थ।]
निरामिन्: निरामिन् नि-रामिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. remain-ing, staying in; (Sāy.) delighting in.
निरामिष: निरामिष निर्-आमिष, अस्, आ, अम्, fleshless, without meat or prey; not receiving wages; having no sensual desires, free from covetousness. —निरा-मिषाशिन् (°ष-आश्°), ई, इनी, इ, not feeding on meat; living without meat; free from sensual desires.
निरांय: निरांय निर्-आय, अस्, आ, अम्, having no in-come or revenue, profitless, yielding no income or profit. —निर्-आय-व्यय-वत्, आन्, m. having neither income nor expenditure, an idler who lives by clan-destine means.
निरायत: निरायत 1. निर्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. यम् with आ and निस्), stretched out, extended.
निरायत 2. निर्-आयत, अस्, आ, अम्, unex-tended, contracted, compact.
निरायास: निरायास निर्-आयास, अस्, आ, अम्, not causing trouble, not requiring efforts, not fatiguing; easily attainable, easy.
निरायुध: निरायुध निर्-आयुध, अस्, आ, अम्, weapon-less, disarmed, unarmed, defenceless.
निरारम्भ: निरारम्भ निर्-आरम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, not un-dertaking enterprises, not enterprising, abstaining from all work.
निरालक: निरालक निरालक, अस्, m. a species of fish.
निरालम्ब: निरालम्ब निर्-आलम्ब, अस्, आ, अम्, having no prop or support, not resting or depending on another, independent, self-supported, not relying on another, standing alone, friendless; (अस्), m., N. of a man mentioned in the Śaṅkara-vijaya; (आ), f. spikenard, = आकाश-मांसी; (अम्), ind. without support, in-dependently. —निरालम्बोपनिषद् (°ब-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
निरालम्बन: निर्-आलम्बन, अस्, आ, अम्, having no prop, without support, not resting on another.
निरालस्य: निरालस्य निर्-आलस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not slothful.
निरालोक: निरालोक निर्-आलोक, अस्, आ, अम्, not looking about, not moving the eye, without moving the eyes; deprived of light, dark; invisible, uninvestigable (?); an epithet of Śiva.
निरावर्ष: निरावर्ष निर्-आवर्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, unpene-trated by rain, protecting from rain.
निराश: निराश निर्-आश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + 1. आ-शा; cf. आ-शंस्), without hope, hopeless, despairing of (with loc., dat., or with प्रति and acc., e. g. स्व-जीविते or स्व-जीविताय or स्व-जीवितम् प्रति निर्-आशः, despairing of one's own life); depriving of all hope; [cf. नैराश्य।] —निराश-त्व, अम्, n. hope-lessness, despair. —निराशी-भाव, अस्, m. hopeless-ness, despair. —निराशी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become hopeless; despairing.
निराशक: निर्-आशक, अस्, आ, अम्, desponding, despairing of (with abl.).
निराशिन्: निर्-आशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hopeless. —निराशि-त्व, अम्, n. = निराश-त्व, hopelessness.
निराशङ्क: निराशङ्क निर्-आशङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless; (अम्), ind. fearlessly, without fear or hesitation.
निराशिस्: निराशिस् निर्-आशिस्, ईस्, ईस्, इस् (see आ-शास्), having no wishes or hopes; without a blessing.
निराश्रम: निराश्रम निर्-आश्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-आश्रमिन्; ई, इणी, इ, not being in one of the four periods or orders of a Brāhman's life.
निराश्रय: निराश्रय निर्-आश्रय, अस्, आ, अम्, supportless, without prop or stay, not resting or depending on, unsupported, self-supported, without shelter or refuge, unprotected, destitute; not deep (as a wound?).
निरासित्व: निरासित्व निरासि-त्व incorrect reading for निराशि-त्व।
निरास्पद: निरास्पद निर्-आस्पद, अस्, आ, अम्, restless, having no place of rest, homeless; portionless.
निरास्वाद: निरास्वाद निर्-आस्वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, tasteless, flavourless, unsavoury, yielding no enjoyment.
निरास्वाद्य: निर्-आस्वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unsavoury, giving no enjoyment. —निरास्वाद्य-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most unsavoury.
निराहार: निराहार निर्-आहार, अस्, m. want of food, not eating, fasting; (अस्, आ, अम्), foodless, fasting, abstaining from food, without food, having nothing to eat. —निराहार-ता, f. foodlessness, fasting.
निराहावत्: निराहावत् निर्-आहा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, for निर्-आहाव-वत्, without invocation.
निरि: निरि निर्-इ, cl. 2. P. -एति, &c., -एतुम्, to go out, come forth, go off, depart.
निरिङ्ग: निरिङ्ग निर्-इङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, immovable, not moving to and fro, not flickering.
निरिच्छ: निरिच्छ निर्-इच्छ, अस्, आ, अम्, without wish or desire, indifferent.
निरिन्द्रिय: निरिन्द्रिय निर्-इन्द्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. im-potent, destitute of manly vigour or of strength (in general); barren; having lost the use of a limb; imperfect, mutilated, maimed, infirm, weak, frail; (in Manu IX. 18) without evidence or means of certain knowledge (according to Kullūka = प्रमाण-रहित).
निरिन्धन: निरिन्धन निर्-इन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of fuel.
निरी: निरी नि-री, cl. 9. P. -रिणाति, -रेतुम्, Ved. to attack.
निरीक्ष्: निरीक्ष् निर्-ईक्ष्, cl. 1. A. -ईक्षते, -ईक्षि-तुम्, to look at, look towards, behold, gaze at, look about, regard, observe, view, contemplate, perceive.
निरीक्षक: निर्-ईक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, seeing, view-ing, observing, visiting.
निरीक्षण: निर्-ईक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, regarding; (अम्), ṇ. look; looking at, regarding, seeing; ex-pecting; the aspect of the planets.
निरीक्षत्: निर्-ईक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or निर्-ईक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, looking at, regarding, expecting, hoping.
निरीक्षा: निर्-ईक्षा, f. looking at, regarding; considera-tion; hope, expectation; (अया), ind. in respect of, in relation to, as to (e. g. बलाबल-निरीक्षया, in respect of strength and weakness; cf. दुर्-निरीक्ष).
निरीक्षिन्: निर्-ईक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, seeing, looking, viewing; [cf. नातिदूर-न्°।]
निरीक्ष्य: 1. निर्-ईक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at or regarded; to be considered; [cf. दुर्-न्°।]
2. निर्-ईक्ष्य, ind. having looked at or viewed or scanned.
निरीक्ष्यमाण: निर्-ईक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being looked at or regarded; looking, (Mahā-bh. Ādi-p. 7694.)
निरीति: निरीति निर्-ईति, इस्, इस्, इ, free from calami-ties or afflictions, painless.
निरीतिक: निर्-ईतिक, अस्, आ, अम्, not inauspicious, not prog-nosticating calamity, auspicious.
निरीश्वर: निरीश्वर निर्-ईश्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, godless, atheistic. —निरीश्वर-वाद, अस्, m. godlessness, atheism. —निरीश्वर-वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, atheistical.
निरीष: निरीष निर्-ईष, अम्, n. the body of a plough (without the pole and ploughshare; also read निर्-ईश).
निरीह: निरीह निर्-ईह, अस्, आ, अम्, inactive, effort-less; desireless, not wishful, indifferent, unanxious. —निरीह-ता, f. or निरीह-त्व, अम्, n. or निर्-ईहा, f. indifference, absence of desire or effort. —निरीहा-वस्था (°हा-अव्°), f. a state of indifference.
निरुक्त: निरुक्त निर्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वच् with निस्), uttered, pronounced, expressed, explained, de-fined; loud, distinct; (अम्), n. explanation or ety-mological interpretation of a word; N. of one of the six Vedāṅgas or works considered as connected with the Vedas; glossarial explanation of obscure terms, (especially those occurring in the Vedas); N. of a well-known commentary on the Nighaṇṭus by Yāska; [cf. नैरुक्त, नैरुक्तिक।] —निरुक्त-कार, अस्, m. ‘Nirukta-composer,’ N. or epithet of a com-mentator on Kāli-dāsa's Megha-dūta. —निरुक्त-कृत्, त्, m. epithet of a pupil of Śāka-pūrṇi. —नि-रुक्त-ज, अस्, m., N. of a class of sons enumerated in Mahā-bh. Anuśāsana-p. 2615. —निरुक्त-परि-शिष्ट, अम्, n., N. of a work supplementary to the Nirukta. —निरुक्त-वत्, आन्, m. ‘possessing the Ni-rukta, author of the Nirukta,’ an epithet of Yāska. —निरुक्त-वृत्ति, इस्, f. ‘commentary on the Ni-rukta,’ N. of a commentary on Yāska's Nirukta by Durgācārya.
निरुक्ति: निर्-उक्ति, इस्, f. explanation, etymological inter-pretation of words; (in rhetoric) an artificial or poetical explanation of the derivation of a word (e. g. deriving दोषा-कर, ‘the moon,’ from दोषा + आकर instead of दोषा + कर); = निर्-उक्त, Yāska's commentary on the Nighaṇṭus.
निरुच्यमान: निर्-उच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being uttered or expressed.
निरुक्ष्: निरुक्ष् निर्-उक्ष्, cl. 6. P. -उक्षति, &c., Ved. to remove by sprinkling.
निरुच्छ्वास: निरुच्छ्वास निर्-उच्छ्वास, अस्, m. absence of breath, not breathing; (अस्, आ, अम्), without breath-ing, not breathing, breathless; narrow, contracted, crowded; (अम्), n. (?) a particular hell where the wicked cannot breathe. —निरुच्छ्वास-निपीडित, अस्, आ, अम्, pained by not breathing (?).
निरुज: निरुज नि-रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, for नी-रुज, healthy, q. v.
निरुत्तर: निरुत्तर निर्-उत्तर, अस्, आ, अम्, having no superior; answerless, without a reply, unable to answer, silenced, posed; (अम्), n., N. of a Tantra. —निरुत्तर-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra.
निरुत्पात: निरुत्पात निर्-उत्पात, अस्, आ, अम्, free from portents.
निरुत्सव: निरुत्सव निर्-उत्सव, अस्, आ, अम्, without festivals, having no festivities.
निरुत्साह: निरुत्साह निर्-उत्साह, अस्, m. absence of exertion, want of energy, indolence, pusillanimity; (अस्, आ, अम्), without energy, devoid of energy, un-dertaking nothing, without courage, indolent, indif-ferent. —निरुत्साह-ता, f. want of energy, cowardice.
निरुत्सुक: निरुत्सुक निर्-उत्सुक, अस्, आ, अम्, careless, indifferent, unconcerned; calm, tranquil, unanxious, unregretful, having no vehement desire for; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Manu Raivata; one of the Saptarṣis under the thirteenth Manu.
निरुदक: निरुदक निर्-उदक, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, devoid of water.
निरुद्यम: निरुद्यम निर्-उद्यम, अस्, आ, अम्, effortless, inactive, lazy, at rest.
निरुद्योग: निरुद्योग निर्-उद्योग, अस्, आ, अम्, making no efforts, lazy, listless, idle; disheartened; cause-less (?).
निरुद्विग्न: निरुद्विग्न निर्-उद्विग्न or निर्-उद्वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, unexcited, undisturbed, free from perturbation, fearless, sedate, calm. —निरुद्विग्न-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, undisturbed in mind.
निरुध्: निरुध् नि-रुध्, cl. 7. P. A. -रुणद्धि, -रुन्द्धे, -रोद्धुम्, to shut in, shut, obstruct, stop, hinder, prevent, restrain, check; to confine; to keep off, remove; to accomplish (?): Caus. -रोध-यति, -यितुम्, to cause to be shut or obstructed.
निरुद्ध: नि-रुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, stopped, obstructed, re-strained, checked, hindered, opposed; confined, im-prisoned; (अस्), m., N. of a prince. —निरुद्ध-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the breath obstructed, suffocated. —निरुद्ध-गुद, अस्, m. contraction or obstruction of the rectum. —निरुद्ध-प्रकश, अस्, m. stricture of the urethra. —निरुद्ध-शम-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, ‘whose state of repose is interrupted,’ wearied, tired.
निरुन्धत्: नि-रुन्धत्, अन्, अती, अत्, checking, hindering, suppressing, &c.
निरुन्धान: नि-रुन्धान, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructing, opposing, hindering, preventing; depriving of, &c.
निरोद्धव्य: नि-रोद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be shut in or confined, to be fenced, to be enclosed with a fence or hedge.
निरोध: नि-रोध, अस्, m. shutting in, confinement, locking up, imprisonment; enclosing, covering up; check, restraint, coercion, suppression, hindrance, prevention, obstruction, opposition; annihilation, destruction; (in dramatic language) disappointment, frustration of hope; hurting, injuring (= नि-ग्रह); aversion, disfavour, dislike; (with Buddhists) suppression or annihilation of pain (one of the four principles); N. of a man.
निरोधक: नि-रोधक, अस्, आ, अम्, obstructive, obstructing, confining, hindering.
निरोधन: नि-रोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, confining, obstructing; (अस्), m. (with अवट) N. of a hell; (अम्), n. con-finement, imprisonment; keeping back, restraining, keeping down, coercion; denying; (in dramatic language) disappointment, frustration of hope.
निरोधिन्: नि-रोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, obstructing, hindering.
निरुपक्रम: निरुपक्रम निर्-उपक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, having no beginning, without a commencement.
निरुपद्रव: निरुपद्रव निर्-उपद्रव, अस्, आ, अम्, free from hostile attacks, free from ravages, not visited by calamity or affliction, free from adversity or danger, lucky, happy, undisturbed, unharmed, un-molested; free from national distress, free from tyranny; causing no affliction or adversity; peaceful, secure; not inauspicious (as a star). —निरुपद्रव-ता, f. absence of calamity or danger, security.
निरुपद्रुत: निर्-उपद्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, not visited by calamities; not boding evil (as a star).
निरुपधि: निरुपधि निर्-उपधि, इस्, इस्, इ, without guile, guileless, honest, secure.
निरुपपत्ति: निरुपपत्ति निर्-उपपत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, unfit, un-suitable. —निरुपपत्ति-त्व, अम्, n. unfitness, un-suitableness.
निरुपपद: निरुपपद निर्-उपपद, अस्, आ, अम्, not con-nected with a subordinate word; [cf. उप-पद।]
निरुपप्लव: निरुपप्लव निर्-उपप्लव, अस्, आ, अम्, free from calamity or disturbance, free from trouble or alarm; unharmed; not causing adversity; an epithet of Śiva.
निरुपभोग: निरुपभोग निर्-उपभोग, अस्, आ, अम्, not enjoying, destitute of enjoyment.
निरुपम: निरुपम निर्-उपम, अस्, आ, अम्, peerless, matchless, without a compeer or equal, unequalled, incomparable; (अस्), m. a species of poisonous animal (= गौधेरक).
निरुपल: निरुपल निर्-उपल, अस्, आ, अम्, stoneless, free from stones.
निरुपलेप: निरुपलेप निर्-उपलेप, अस्, आ, अम्, un-smeared, free from ointment.
निरुपसर्ग: निरुपसर्ग निर्-उपसर्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, free from portents, not portentous.
निरुपस्कृत: निरुपस्कृत निर्-उपस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncor-rupted, inartificial, pure.
निरुपहत: निरुपहत निर्-उपहत, अस्, आ, अम्, unhurt, uninjured, not afflicted; auspicious.
निरुपाख्य: निरुपाख्य निर्-उपाख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not perceptible by the eyes, invisible, immaterial; unreal, false, non-existent.
निरुपाधिक: निरुपाधिक निर्-उपाधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, without attributes or qualities.
निरुपाय: निरुपाय निर्-उपाय, अस्, आ, अम्, without expedients, remediless, helpless; unsuccessful.
निरुपेक्ष: निरुपेक्ष निर्-उपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not neg-lectful; free from trick or fraud.
निरुप्ति: निरुप्ति निर्-उप्ति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. वप् with निस्), = 1. निर्-वाप, q. v.
निरुप्य: निर्-उप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be scattered or sprinkled.
निरुब्ज्: निरुब्ज् निर्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, &c., Ved. to press down, cause to flow down, send down, let loose.
निरुष्णीष: निरुष्णीष निर्-उष्णीष, अस्, आ, अम्, without a turban or head-dress, bare-headed.
निरुष्मन्: निरुष्मन् निर्-उष्मन्, आ, आ, अ, devoid of heat, cold. —निरुष्म-त्व, अम्, n. absence of heat, coldness.
निरूढ: निरूढ 1. नि-रूढ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-रुह्), inherent, conventional, accepted (as the familiar meaning of words in opposition to their etymological sense); (अस्), m. (in rhetoric) the force or application of words according to their natural or received meanings; (in logic) the inherence of any property in the term implying it (as of redness in the word red &c.).
निरूढ 2. निर्-ऊढ, आ, f. (fr. rt. वह् with निस्), unmarried.

3. निर्-ऊढ, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn out, purged, eviscerated; (for 2. निर्-ऊढ see above.) —निर्-ऊढ-पशु-प्रयोग, अस्, m., N. of a treatise on particular sacrifices, (see the next.) —निरूढ-पशु-बन्ध, अस्, m. ‘the offering or oblation of an eviscerated animal,’ N. of one of the regular Havir-yajñas.
निरूप्: निरूप् नि-रूप्, cl. 10. P. -रूपयति, -यितुम्, to perform; to represent, enact, act dramatically; to see, perceive, look at, look into; to observe, con-sider, reflect upon; to investigate, examine, look out for, discover, search; to ascertain; to select, choose, appoint; to resolve, determine.
निरूपण: नि-रूपण, अस्, ई, अम्, defining, determining; (अम्), n. form, shape; sight, seeing; looking for, searching; looking into, investigation, determination, definition; ascertaining, defining, (in these senses also नि-रूपणा।)
निरूपणीय: नि-रूपणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked for; to be searched into or examined, to be investigated.
निरूपयत्: नि-रूपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, looking for, investi-gating, considering.
निरूपित: नि-रूपित, अस्, आ, अम्, seen, beheld; discovered, found; appointed, elected, chosen, deputed; consi-dered, weighed; ascertained, determined, resolved.
निरूपिति: नि-रूपिति, इस्, f. definition (of an idea), ascertain-ment.
निरूप्य: 1. नि-रूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be seen or defined or ascertained.
2. नि-रूप्य, ind. having seen or considered. —निरूप्य-ता, f. or निरूप्य-त्व, अम्, n. ascer-taining, determining.
निरूह्: निरूह् निर्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 1. ऊह्], cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, &c., Ved. inf. निर्-ऊहितवै, to push out, draw out, remove: Caus. -ऊहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to draw out or purge.
निरूढि: निर्-ऊढि, इस्, f. (also to be referred to rt. वह् with निस्), fame, celebrity, renown.
निरूह: 1. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. a purging clyster; an enema not of an oily kind, = नि-ग्रह?; (for 2. निर्-ऊह see below.) —निरूह-वस्ति-विधि, इस्, m., N. of the twenty-fifth chapter of the Śārṅga-dhara-saṃ-hitā, a medical work by Śārṅga-dhara. —निरूहा-धिकार (°ह-अध्°), अस्, m., N. of a chapter of a medical work by Vṛnda.
निरूह 2. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 2. ऊह् with निस्), logic, disputation; certainty, ascertainment. (For 1. निर्-ऊह see above; for 3. see next col.)
निरूह 3. निर्-ऊह, अस्, m. (for 1. and 2. see col. 2), a sentence having no ellipsis, a complete sentence.
निरूहण: 1. निर्-ऊहण, अम्, n. causing to purge with a clyster; administering enemas not of an oily kind. (For 2. निर्-ऊहण see below.)
निरृ: निरृ निर्-ऋ, cl. 3. P. -इयर्ति, &c., Ved. to go out from, depart from, liberate one's self from (with abl.); to be excluded, to become deprived of (with abl.); Caus. निर्-अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go to pieces or decay, to dissolve.
निरृत: निर्-ऋत, अस्, आ, अम्, dissolved, decaying; debili-tated; (अस्), m., N. of a Rudra.
निरृति: निर्-ऋति, इस्, f. decay, dissolution, destruction, anni-hilation, calamity, evil, adversity; imprecation, curse; Decay or Destruction personified (goddess of death and corruption; she is described as binding mortals with her cords, and is often associated with Mṛtyu, A-rāti, and similar beings; she is variously regarded as the wife of A-dharma, mother of Bhaya, Mahā-bhaya, and Mṛtyu, or as a daughter of A-dharma and Hiṃsā and mother of Naraka and Bhaya; she is regent of the south-west or south-western quarter and of the asterism Mūla); (इस्), f. the bottom or lower depths of the earth (perhaps regarded as the seat of putrefaction; cf. नैरृत); (इस्, इस्, इ), free from adversity, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निरृथ: निर्-ऋथ, अस्, m. destruction, the Destroyer (i. e. Nirṛtha personified); an epithet of a particular Agni; (according to some) the Sāma-veda.
निरृछ्: निरृछ् निर्-ऋछ्, cl. 6. P. -ऋच्छति, &c., Ved. to go out from, fall from, be excluded from (with abl.); to go or cleave asunder.
निरे: निरे निर्-ए (निर्-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. निर्-ऐति, Ved. to come forth from, to go off, depart, make way for.
निरेक: निरेक नि-रेक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रिच् with नि), Ved. a lasting possession (?), wealth, property; (ए), ind. lastingly, for ever; (Sāy.) in poverty or want; in donation or gifts; (according to Mahī-dhara) not empty.
निरेभ: निरेभ नि-रेभ, अस्, आ, अम्, soundless, noise-less.
निर्गत: निर्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out, come forth, come out, appeared; gone away, departed; disappeared, extinct; freed from. —निर्गत-विशङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from fear, fearless.
निर्गन्ध: निर्गन्ध निर्-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, inodorous, scentless, unfragrant, void of smell. —निर्गन्ध-ता, f. absence of smell, want of fragrance, scentlessness. —निर्गन्ध-पुष्पी, f. the silk-cotton tree (= शाल्मलि), Bombax Heptaphyllum.
निर्गन्धन: निर्गन्धन निर्गन्धन, अम्, n. = निर्ग्रन्-थन, killing, slaughter.
निर्गम्: निर्गम् निर्-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-तुम्, to go out, come forth, depart from (with abl.), set out; to come out or appear (as a bud); to go away, disappear; to be freed from (with abl.); to enter into any state, undergo (with acc.): Desid. -जिगमि-षति, to wish to go out.
निर्ग: निर्-ग, अस्, m. country, region; place or province.
निर्गम: निर्-गम, अस्, m. going forth or out, setting out, going away, receding; departure, vanishing; exit, issue, outlet; a door; [cf. जल-न्°।]
निर्गमन: निर्-गमन, अम्, n. going out or forth.
निर्गर्व: निर्गर्व निर्-गर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pride, humble, lowly.
निर्गल्: निर्गल् निर्-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, &c., to trickle or flow out; to dissolve, melt. —निर्-गलित, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed out, poured forth; dissolved, melted.
निर्गवाक्ष: निर्गवाक्ष निर्-गवाक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, window-less, without windows.
निर्गा: निर्गा निर्-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति (or -जगाति), -गातुम्, Ved. to go out, come forth.
निर्गुण: निर्गुण निर्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, stringless (as a bow); devoid of all qualities or properties; without attributes; having no epithet; devoid of good qualities or virtues, bad, worthless, vicious; (अस्), m. the Supreme Being (as without qualities of any kind). —निर्गुण-ता, f. or निर्गुण-त्व, अम्, n. absence of qualities, want of properties, freedom from all qualities (as an attribute of the Supreme Being); absence or want of good qualities, wickedness, vicious-ness, baseness. —निर्गुणात्मक (°ण-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having no qualities.
निर्गुण्टी: निर्गुण्टी निर्गुण्टी or निर्गुण्डी or निर्गुण्डि, इस्, f. the shrub Vitex Negundo; another plant (= नील-शेफालिका); the root of a lotus.
निर्गुप्: निर्गुप् निर्-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपायति, &c., to guard, protect.
निर्गुल्म: निर्गुल्म निर्-गुल्म, अस्, आ, अम्, free from bushes, destitute of shrubs.
निर्गूढ: निर्गूढ निर्-गूढ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. गुह् with निस्), the hollow of a tree.
निर्गृह: निर्गृह निर्-गृह, अस्, आ, अम्, houseless, homeless.
निर्गॄ: निर्गॄ निर्-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति, &c., to vomit forth. —निर्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited forth.
निर्गौरव: निर्गौरव निर्-गौरव, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of respect; without dignity, undignified, affable; (अम्), ind. without pride, condescendingly, affably.
निर्ग्रन्थ: निर्ग्रन्थ निर्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from all ties or hindrances; a saint, a devotee who has withdrawn from the world and lives either as a hermit or a beggar wandering about naked; pos-sessionless, poor, a pauper, beggar [cf. ग्रन्थ, said to mean ‘riches’]; (अस्), m. an idiot; a fool; a gambler; N. of a man, son of Jñāti. —निर्ग्रन्थ-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work.
निर्ग्रन्थक: निर्-ग्रन्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, unattended, unac-companied; abandoned, deserted; fruitless; clever, expert, conversant; (अस्), m. a religious mendicant; a naked devotee; a gambler; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (?), Buddhism (because the Buddhists appeared as religious mendicants, especially as ascetics).
निर्ग्रन्थि: निर्-ग्रन्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from knots, knotless.
निर्ग्रन्थिक: निर्-ग्रन्थिक, अस्, m. a naked mendicant, an ascetic; (अस्, आ, अम्), clever, conversant; = हीन, destitute (?).
निर्ग्रन्थन: निर्ग्रन्थन निर्-ग्रन्थन, अम्, n. killing, slaughter; [cf. नि-ग्रन्थन, नि-गन्धन।]
निर्ग्राह्य: निर्ग्राह्य निर्-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be traced or found out, perceivable.
निर्घट: निर्घट निर्-घट, अम्, n. a fair or crowded market, a free market, a wharf or ghaut where no toll is levied, a place where there is no quay or stairs, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्घण्ट: निर्घण्ट निर्-घण्ट or निर्-घण्टक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a vocabulary, a collection of words, = नि-घण्टु, (perhaps for निर्-ग्रन्थक, ‘singling out the words of a sentence and writing them down in their independent form.’)
निर्घात: निर्घात निर्-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with निस्), destruction; a violent gust of wind, hurricane, whirlwind; the noise of contending vapours in the sky; an earthquake; a thunder-stroke; any severe stroke.
निर्घातन: निर्-घातन, अम्, n. forcing out, bringing out.
निर्घात्य: निर्-घात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be forced or brought out.
निर्घुष्ट: निर्घुष्ट निर्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. घुष् with निस्), sounded, resounded.
निर्घोष: निर्-घोष, अस्, m. sound in general, noise, a loud noise, rattling, trampling; (अस्, आ, अम्), sound-less, noiseless, (in this sense निर् is a privative.) —निर्घोषाक्षर-विमुक्त (°ष-अक्ष्°), अस्, m., N. of a Samādhi.
निर्घूरिणी: निर्घूरिणी निर्-घूरिणी, f. a river, (perhaps a wrong reading for निर्-झरिणी।)
निर्घृण: निर्घृण निर्-घृण, अस्, आ, अम्, unmerciful, pitiless, cruel; shameless, immodest; (अम्), ind. without pity, pitilessly. —निर्घृण-ता, f. or निर्-घृण-त्व, अम्, n. pitilessness, unmercifulness, hard-heartedness, cruelty.
निर्घृष्: निर्घृष् निर्-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, &c., to rub against or on (with loc.).
निर्घर्षणक: निर्घर्षणक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what rubs, a rubber, rubbing, a rubbing, a dentifrice fit for cleaning the teeth.
निर्घृष्य: निर्-घृष्य, ind. having rubbed, having rubbed on.
निर्जन: निर्जन निर्-जन, अस्, आ, अम्, unpeopled, de-populated, uninhabited, unfrequented, lonely, de-serted, desolate; (अम्), n. a solitude, desert. —निर्-जन-ता, f. or निर्जन-त्व, अम्, n. depopulation, the state of being unpeopled or deserted. —निर्जन-वन, अम्, n. a lonely or unfrequented forest.
निर्जर: निर्जर 1. निर्-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see निर्-जॄ, col. 3), not becoming old, young, fresh; imperishable, immortal, undecaying; (अस्), m. an immortal, a deity, god; (आ), f. the plant Cocculus Cordifolius; Anethum Graveloens, = तत्त्व-भिद्; (अम्), n. ambrosia, the food of the gods. —निर्-जर-सर्षप, अस्, m. a species of mustard (= देव-सर्षप).
2. निर्-जर, अस्, आ, अम्, completely wearing down or destroying. (For 1. निर्-जर see col. 2.)
निर्जरस्: निर्-जरस्, optionally substituted for 1. निर्-जर in certain cases. (See Pāṇ. VII. 2, 101.)
निर्जरायु: निर्जरायु निर्-जरायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. skin-less (as a snake which has cast its skin).
निर्जर्जल्प: निर्जर्जल्प निर्-जर्जल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (ac-cording to Mahī-dhara, probably because of its simi-larity to जर्जर, =) ragged, tattered; (another read-ing has निर्-जाल्मक।)
निर्जल: निर्जल निर्-जल, अस्, आ, अम्, waterless, desti-tute of water, dry, desert; not mixed with water (as buttermilk); (अस्), m. a desert, waste. —निर्जल-तोयदाभ (°द-आभा), अस्, आ, अम्, of the colour of a waterless cloud, i. e. white, of a fair complexion. —निर्जलैकादशी (°ल-एक्°), f., N. of the eleventh day in the light half of month Jyaiṣṭha, on which even the drinking of water is forbidden.
निर्जात: निर्जात निर्-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, come forth, appeared, visible.
निर्जि: निर्जि निर्-जि, cl. 1. P. A. -जयति, -ते, -जेतुम्, to conquer, win, gain, acquire, subdue, vanquish; to overcome in play.
निर्जय: निर्-जय, अस्, m. conquest, complete victory, van-quishing, subduing; [cf. मन्यु-न्°।]
निर्जित: निर्-जित, अस्, आ, अम्, conquered, completely van-quished, thoroughly subdued, overcome; won, ac-quired, gained; claimed; unconquered. —निर्जित-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —निर्जितारि-गणस् (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, one who has conquered hosts of enemies. —निर्जितेन्द्रिय (°त-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued passions or feelings. —निर्जितेन्द्रिय-ग्राम, अस्, m. ‘one who has subdued the whole assemblage of his organs,’ a Muni, a saint.
निर्जिति: निर्-जिति, इस्, f. conquest, complete victory, sub-duing, subjugation.
निर्जित्य: निर्-जित्य, ind. having conquered or won or gained.
निर्जेतृ: निर्-जेतृ, ता, m. a conquerer, vanquisher.
निर्जिह्व: निर्जिह्व निर्-जिह्व, अस्, आ, अम्, tongueless, without a tongue.
निर्जीव: निर्जीव निर्-जीव, अस्, m. lifelessness, death; (अस्, आ, अम्), lifeless, inanimate, dead. —निर्जीव-कारण, अम्, n. a cause of death, a fatal blow.
निर्जीवित: निर्-जीवित, अस्, आ, अम्, lifeless, dead, inanimate.
निर्जुष्ट: निर्जुष्ट निर्-जुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जुष् with prep. निस्), frequented, inhabited.
निर्जॄ: निर्जॄ निर्-जॄ, Caus. -जरयति, -यितुम्, to wear down, wear away, rub to pieces, crush.
निर्ज्ञाति: निर्ज्ञाति निर्-ज्ञाति, इस्, इस्, इ, destitute of relations; having no kinsfolk.
निर्ज्वर: निर्ज्वर निर्-ज्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, feverless, healthy.
निर्झर: निर्झर निर्-झर, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. (perhaps fr. झर् for rt. क्षर् with निस्), a waterfall, cataract, cascade, mountain-torrent, the precipitous descent of water from mountains, &c. [cf. झर]; (अस्), m. burning chaff; an elephant; a horse of the Sun [cf. निर्-णर]; (ई), f. a river [cf. निर्-झरिणी; cf. also निलिम्प-न्°।]
निर्झरिन्: निर्-झरिन्, ई, m. a mountain; (इणी), f. a torrent, river.
निर्णय: निर्णय निर्-णय। See under निर्-णी below.

निर्-णय, अस्, m. removing, removal; deciding, rendering certain, complete ascertainment, decision, certainty, determination, proof, affirmation, precise definition, settlement; (in logic) deduction, inference, conclusion, demonstration; application of a conclu-sive argument; (in law) sentence, verdict; (in rhe-toric) narration of events; discussion, consideration, investigation. —निर्णय-कमलाकर (°ल-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘a lotus-bed of conclusions,’ N. of a Mīmāṃsā work. —निर्णय-दर्पण, अम्, n. ‘mirror of certainty,’ N. of a Vedānta work. —निर्णय-दीप, ‘lamp of certainty,’ N. of a work mentioned in the Śūdra-dharma-tattva by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa. —निर्णय-दीपिका, f., N. of a work written about the middle of the seventeenth century. —निर्णय-पाद, अस्, m. a sentence, decree, verdict in law. —निर्णय-सिन्धु, N. of a Mīmāṃsā work by Kamalākara-bhaṭṭa; (also read निर्णेय-सिन्धु।) —निर्णया-मृत (°य-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar of certainty,’ N. of a work.
निर्णर: निर्णर निर्-णर, अस्, m. one of the horses of the Sun; [cf. निर्-झर।]
निर्णाम: निर्णाम निर्णाम, अस्, m., Ved. the joint of a wing.
निर्णिज्: निर्णिज् 1. निर्-णिज्, cl. 3. P. A. -णेनेक्ति, -णे-निक्ते, Ved. inf. निर्-णिजे, निर्-णिजम्, &c., to wash off, wash, cleanse (A.); to wash one's self; to dress one's self.
2. निर्-णिज्, क्, f., Ved. a shining dress or ornament, any bright garment [cf. अधि-न्°, अश्व-न्°, घृत-न्°]; purification, cleansing; (Sāy.) a form, shape; well nourished (m. f. n.).
निर्णिक्त: निर्-णिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, washed, purified, cleaned, cleansed.
निर्णेक: निर्-णेक, अस्, m. washing, cleansing, cleaning; ablution; expiation, atonement.
निर्णेजक: निर्-णेजक, अस्, m. a washerman, washer.
निर्णेजन: निर्-णेजन, अम्, n. ablution; expiation, atonement for an offence.
निर्णी: निर्णी निर्-णी, cl. 1. P. A. -णयति, -ते, -णे-तुम्, to lead or take away, carry away, carry off; to trace out, investigate, find out, ascertain, educe, elicit, to settle, come to a decision, decide.
निर्णयत्: निर्-णयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, concluding, deciding, ascertaining.
निर्णयन: निर्-णयन, अम्, n. ascertainment, certainty; positive conclusion.
निर्णायक: निर्-णायक, अस्, आ, अम्, causing or leading to certainty, conclusive.
निर्णायन: निर्-णायन, अम्, n. rendering certain; the outer angle of the elephant's eye.
निर्णीत: निर्-णीत, अस्, आ, अम्, deduced, traced out, brought to a conclusion, ascertained, settled, decided, proved.
निर्णेतृ: निर्-णेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, decisive, certifying, veri-fying, leading to certainty, demonstrating, proving; (ता), m. one who pronounces a sentence, a judge; a voucher; a guide. —निर्णेतृ-त्व, अम्, n. proof, verification.
निर्णेय: निर्-णेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ascertained, to be decided or determined.
निर्णुद्: निर्णुद् निर्-णुद्, cl. 6. P. A. (sometimes wrongly निर्-नुद्), -णुदति, -ते, -णोत्तुम्, to push or drive out; to drive away, expel, reject, remove; to repudiate.
निर्दंश्: निर्दंश् निर्-दंश्, cl. 1. P. -दशति or -दं-शति, -दंष्टुम्, to bite through, bite; (with दन्-तान्) to gnash the teeth, grind the teeth.
निर्दंशिन्: निर्-दंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, biting through; not biting, (Ved., in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्दशत्: निर्-दशत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, biting, biting through; consuming.
निर्दशमान: निर्-दशमान, अस्, आ, अम्, biting through, biting; gnashing or grinding (the teeth).
निर्दश्य: निर्-दश्य, ind. having bitten, biting through.
निर्दग्ध: निर्-दग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, burnt, burnt up; un-burnt, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्दड: निर्दड निर्-दड, अस्, आ, अम्, unkind, un-feeling, unmerciful; devoid of pity or charity, re-joicing over the faults of others; envious, slanderous, abusive; useless, unnecessary; mad, intoxicated; vio-lent; (sometimes spelt निर्-दट; cf. निर्-दय।)
निर्दण्ड: निर्दण्ड निर्-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, not punishing.
निर्दय: निर्दय निर्-दय, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiless, un-merciful, unkind, cruel, hard-hearted; passionate; excessive, violent; unpitied by any; (अम्), n. without pity, unmercifully; passionately, violently, exces-sively, much. —निर्दय-त्व, अम्, n. unmercifulness, cruelty.
निर्दर: निर्दर निर्-दर, अस्, or निर्-दरि, इस्, m. = दर or दरि, a cave, cavern; [according to some निर्-दर, अस्, आ, अम्, = निर्-दय, pitiless, hard; shameless; also निर्-दरम्, ind. = excessively, and निर्-दर, अम्, n. = pith, essence.] —निर्दरि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, inhabiting a cave.
निर्दलन: निर्दलन निर्-दलन, अम्, n. splitting, cleaving asunder, breaking.
निर्दश: निर्दश निर्-दश, अस्, आ, अम्, more than ten days old, what happened more than ten days ago; [cf. अ-न्°, नैर्दश्य।] —निर्दशाह (°श-अह), see अ-न्°।
निर्दशन: निर्दशन निर्-दशन, अस्, आ, अम्, toothless. —निर्दशनाक्षि-जिह्व (°न-अक्ष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of teeth, eyes, and tongue.
निर्दस्यु: निर्दस्यु निर्-दस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from robbers or bandits.
निर्दह्: निर्दह् निर्-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्, to burn out, burn up, consume by fire, destroy com-pletely: Caus. -दाहयति, -यितुम्, to cause to burn up or set on fire.
निर्दहन: निर्-दहन, अस्, ई, अम्, burning, burning up, consuming; (अस्), m. the plant Semecarpus Ana-cardium; (ई), f. the plant Sanseviera Roxburghiana; (अम्), n. burning.
निर्दाह: निर्-दाह, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-दाहुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. burning, consuming by fire.
निर्दातृ: निर्दातृ निर्-दातृ, ता, m. (fr. rt. 3. दा or दो with निस्), a weeder, digger up of weeds; a reaper, husbandman; [cf. निर्-यातृ।]
निर्दारित: निर्-दारित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn asunder, rent; split open, opened, unclosed; starting open.
निर्दिग्ध: निर्दिग्ध निर्-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. दिह् with निस्), anointed, smeared; well fed, corpulent, stout, lusty.
निर्दिग्धिका: निर्-दिग्धिका, f. a various reading for निर्-दग्-धिका or नि-दिग्धिका।
निर्दिश्: निर्दिश् निर्-दिश्, cl. 6. P. -दिशति, -देष्टुम्, to point to, point out, show, direct, declare, announce, tell, enjoin, order; to denote, indicate, mark; to assign, destine; to enumerate, specify, particularize, name; to foretel; to define, determine; to describe; to recommend, advise, suggest; to denounce: Desid. -दिदिक्षति, to wish to point out or to define more closely.
निर्दिश्य: निर्-दिश्य, ind. having pointed out, having shown, explained, enjoined, &c.
निर्दिष्ट: निर्-दिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pointed out, shown, specified, particularized; described, depicted; assigned; ordered, directed; asserted, declared; ascertained, determined.
निर्देश: निर्-देश, अस्, m. pointing out, directing, ordering, order, command, direction; instruction; saying, tell-ing, declaring; description, designation; depicting, specifying, particularizing, giving particulars or details, specification, special mention; certainty, ascertain-ment; vicinity, proximity; a particular number; [cf. नि-देश।] —निर्देश-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, executing orders, obedient.
निर्देशक: निर्-देशक, अस्, इका, अम्, pointing out, showing, describing; ordering.
निर्देशनीय: निर्-देशनीय or निर्-देश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be pointed out; assignable; to be determined; to be arranged; to be described, to be defined or particu-larized; to be proclaimed or foretold.
निर्देष्टृ: निर्-देष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, who or what shows, explains, points out, defines, &c.; (टा), m. an authority, a guide.
निर्दी: निर्दी निर्-दी, cl. 4. P. -दीयति, &c., Ved. to fly away.
निर्दुःख: निर्दुःख निर्-दुःख, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pain, painless, not suffering pain; not causing pain. —निर्दुःख-त्व, अम्, n. absence of pain; pain-lessness.
निर्दुह्: निर्दुह् निर्-दुह्, cl. 2. P. A. -दोग्धि, -दुग्-धे, -दोग्धुम्, to milk out, extract, draw out, produce; to withdraw.
निर्दुग्ध: निर्-दुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, milked out, drawn out, extracted.
निर्दॄ: निर्दॄ निर्-दॄ, cl. 9. P. -दृणाति, -दरितुम्, -द-रीतुम्, to tear or rend asunder, tear in pieces, split asunder: Caus. -दारयति, -यितुम्, to tear or split asunder; to root up, cause to be dug up.
निर्देव: निर्देव निर्-देव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. abandoned by the gods, without the gods.
निर्दैन्य: निर्दैन्य निर्-दैन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, free from misery or wretchedness, happy, comfortable, at ease.
निर्दोष: निर्दोष निर्-दोष, अस्, आ, अम्, faultless, with-out defect or blemish; guiltless, innocent.
निर्दोषीकृत: निर्दोषी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleared from guilt.
निर्द्रव्य: निर्द्रव्य निर्-द्रव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, immaterial; without property, poor.
निर्द्रु: निर्द्रु निर्-द्रु, cl. 1. P. -द्रवति, -द्रोतुम्, Ved. to run out, run away.
निर्द्रोह: निर्द्रोह निर्-द्रोह, अस्, आ, अम्, not malevo-lent, not hostile, friendly; well-disposed; innocent.
निर्द्वन्द्व: निर्द्वन्द्व निर्-द्वन्द्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from either of two alternatives or indifferent in regard to opposite pairs of feelings (as pleasure and pain), neither glad nor sorry, &c.; not standing in mutual relation, not dependant upon another, independant; not striving together, free from envy or jealousy; not causing disputes, uncontested, undisputed; not double; not acknowledging two principles.
निर्धन: निर्धन निर्-धन, अस्, आ, अम्, without pro-perty or money; poor, indigent; (अस्), m. an old ox. —निर्धन-ता, f. or निर्धन-त्व, अम्, n. absence of property, poverty, indigence.
निर्धर्म: निर्धर्म निर्-धर्म, अस्, m. unrighteous-ness; (अस्, आ, अम्), unjust, unrighteous, impious, immoral, void of law, irreligious.
निर्धा: निर्धा निर्-धा, cl. 3. P. -दधाति, -धातुम्, Ved. to free from; to find out (?).
निर्धार: निर्-धार, अस्, m. or निर्-धारण, अम्, n. taking out from, separating or specifying one out of many, particularizing individuals according to their degree of merit; determining, defining, settling; certainty, ascertainment.
निर्धार्तराष्ट्र: निर्धार्तराष्ट्र निर्-धार्तराष्ट्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having no descendants of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra, free from them.
निर्धाव्: निर्धाव् 1. निर्-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to stream forth from, spring from; to run out, escape from.
निर्धाव् 2. निर्-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति, -ते, -धावितुम्, to wash off, wash away, cleanse.
निर्धौत: निर्-धौत, अस्, आ, अम्, washed off, cleansed, polished, bright.
निर्धू: निर्धू निर्-धू, cl. 5. P. A. -धूनोति, -धू-नुते (in later language also -धुनोति, -धुनुते), -धोतुम् and -धवितुम्, to shake out, shake off, remove; to drive away, expel, banish, repudiate, disown; to shake, agitate, brandish, move about; to harass, distress, torment, pain.
निर्धूत: निर्-धूत or निर्-धुत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken off, shaken out, thrown out or off; removed; avoided; departed; deserted, rejected; broken, divided; re-futed, destroyed; deprived of, bereft; suffered, un-dergone; (अस्), m. a man abandoned by his relatives or friends. —निर्धूत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose sins are wholly shaken off or removed.
निर्धूम: निर्धूम निर्-धूम, अस्, आ, अम्, smokeless. —निर्धूम-त्व, अम्, n. smokelessness.
निर्धृ: निर्धृ निर्-धृ, cl. 1. P. A. -धरति, -ते, cl. 10. or Caus. -धारयति, -यितुम्, to take out from; to separate one out of many, particularize; to de-termine, define, state accurately; to ascertain.
निर्धारणीय: निर्-धारणीय or निर्-धारितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ascertained; irresistible, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्धारित: निर्-धारित, अस्, आ, अम्, determined, ascertained, settled.
निर्धार्य: निर्-धार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ascertained or determined, ascertainable; not to be restrained, act-ing resolutely or fearlessly, active, energetic, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्धार्यमाण: निर्-धार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being particular-ized; being determined.
निर्धे: निर्धे निर्-धे, cl. 1. P. -धयति, -धातुम्, Ved. to drink up, suck up, absorb.
निर्ध्मा: निर्ध्मा निर्-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मा-तुम्, to blow away, blow out of.
निर्ध्यै: निर्ध्यै निर्-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. -ध्यायति, -ध्या-तुम्, to think of, reflect upon, meditate about.
निर्ध्यात: निर्-ध्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, thought of, reflected upon, meditated.
निर्ध्याय: निर्-ध्याय, ind. having thought of, having re-flected.
निर्नमस्कार: निर्नमस्कार निर्-नमस्कार, अस्, आ, अम्, not respecting any one, uncourteous; unrespected, re-spected by no one, despised by all.
निर्नर: निर्नर निर्-नर, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned by men, deserted, desolate.
निर्नाथ: निर्नाथ निर्-नाथ, अस्, आ, अम्, protectorless, without a guardian or master or superior. —निर्नाथ-ता, f. the being without a master or guardian or pro-tector, want of protection; widowhood; orphanage.
निर्नाभि: निर्नाभि निर्-नाभि, इस्, इस्, इ, without the navel, not reaching to the navel.
निर्नाशन: निर्नाशन निर्-नाशन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. नश् with निस्), removing, expelling, banishing.
निर्नाशिन्: निर्-नाशिन्, ई, इनी, इ (from an unused निर्-नाश), removing, expelling, banishing.
निर्निद्र: निर्निद्र निर्-निद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, sleepless. —निर्निद्र-ता, f. sleeplessness.
निर्निमित्त: निर्निमित्त निर्-निमित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, without reason or motive, causeless, groundless; (अम्), n. causelessly, without cause. —निर्निमित्त-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, produced without a cause, whose cause is invisible.
निर्निमेष: निर्निमेष निर्-निमेष, अस्, आ, अम्, not twinkling.
निर्निरोध: निर्निरोध निर्-निरोध, अस्, आ, अम्, unob-structed.
निर्नीड: निर्नीड निर्-नीड, अस्, आ, अम्, having no nest.
निर्बद्ध: निर्-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed upon, fastened upon; directed on; clung to; pressed hard, urged.
निर्बन्ध्: निर्बन्ध् निर्-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति, -बन्द्धुम्, to fix or fasten upon, attach one's self to, cling to, to insist upon, persist in; press upon; to urge, importune.
निर्बन्ध: निर्-बन्ध, अस्, m. insisting upon (with loc.), persistence, perseverance, pertinacity, intentness; ob-stinacy; importunity, urgency, pressing or urging anything, (निर्बन्धं कृ, to urge); accusing, accusation; contest, dispute; caprice, fancy?; [cf. णि-बन्ध।] —निर्बन्ध-पृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, urgently asked, importuned.
निर्बन्धिन्: निर्-बन्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, insisting upon (with loc.), urgent, persisting in, intent upon.
निर्बन्धु: निर्बन्धु निर्-बन्धु, उस्, उस्, उ, without re-lations, without kindred, friendless.
निर्बर्हण: निर्बर्हण निर्-बर्हण, अम्, n. = नि-वर्हण, slaughter, killing, destroying, annihilation.
निर्बल: निर्बल निर्-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, powerless, with-out strength, impotent, weak, feeble.
निर्बाध्: निर्बाध् निर्-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -बा-धितुम्, Ved. to keep off, ward off, hold back.
निर्बाध: निर्-बाध, अस्, m., Ved. a knob, prominence; (निर्बाधे कृ is perhaps a proverbial expression meaning ‘to put on one side, set aside, remove.’)
निर्बाधिन्: निर्बाधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. furnished with knobs or prominences.
निर्बुद्धि: निर्बुद्धि निर्-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, senseless, witless, unwise, ignorant, stupid, out of one's wits.
निर्बुसीकृत: निर्बुसीकृत निर्बुसी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from chaff, husked.
निर्ब्रू: निर्ब्रू निर्-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. -ब्रवीति, &c., Ved. to speak out, pronounce (loud or clearly); to inter-pret, explain.
निर्भक्त: निर्-भक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, excluded from partici-pation in; taken without eating (as medicine; in this sense निर् is a privative).
निर्भग्न: निर्-भग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken in pieces; broken down; bent. —निर्-भज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken in pieces.
निर्भज्: निर्भज् निर्-भज्, cl. 1. P. A. -भजति, -ते, -भक्तुम्, Ved. to exclude from participation or coparceny (with abl.): Caus. -भाजयति, -यितुम्, to exclude from sharing in, to disinherit.
निर्भाज्य: निर्-भाज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be excluded from participation in, to be debarred from sharing in.
निर्भञ्ज्: निर्भञ्ज् निर्-भञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. -भनक्ति, -भङ्क्तुम्, to break asunder, split asunder; to defeat.
निर्भट: निर्भट निर्-भट, अस्, आ, अम्, hard, firm, compact; (perhaps a wrong reading.)
निर्भय: निर्भय निर्-भय, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, un-daunted; free from danger, secure; (अस्), m., N. of a son of the thirteenth Manu; (अम्), ind. fearlessly, without danger.
निर्भर: निर्भर निर्-भर, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. भर], excessive, exceeding, vehement, violent; deep, sound (as sleep); ardent; beyond measure, much; (at the end of a comp.) full of, filled with; (अस्, अम्), m. n. essence?; (अम्), ind. excessively, exceed-ingly, very much; soundly, deeply.
निर्भर्त्स्: निर्भर्त्स् निर्-भर्त्स्, cl. 10. P. A. -भर्त्स-यति, -ते, -यितुम्, to threaten, menace, abuse, re-buke, reprimand, chide, blame, deride.
निर्भर्त्सन: निर्-भर्त्सन, अम्, आ, n. f. threatening, threat, menace; abuse, reviling, reproach, blame; malignity; red paint, lac. —निर्भर्त्सन-दण्ड-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewildered by the threat of punishment.
निर्भर्त्सित: निर्-भर्त्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, threatened, menaced; reviled, abused.
निर्भर्त्स्य: निर्-भर्त्स्य, ind. having threatened; having reviled or reproached.
निर्भस्: निर्भस् निर्-भस्, cl. 3. P. -बभस्ति, -बप्-सति, &c., Ved. to bite off, chew.
निर्भा: निर्भा निर्-भा, cl. 2. P. -भाति, -भातुम्, to shine forth, appear, arise, proceed.
निर्भात: निर्-भात, अस्, आ, अम्, shone forth, shining forth, appeared, arisen.
निर्भाग्य: निर्भाग्य निर्-भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unlucky, unfortunate.
निर्भासित: निर्-भासित, अस्, आ, अम्, illuminated, illumined.
