निर्भिद्: निर्भिद् निर्-भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. -भिनत्ति, -भिन्त्ते, -भेत्तुम्, to cleave or split asunder, break in two, rend, divide, separate, open; to break through, pierce, penetrate, wound; to put out (the eyes); to break down, destroy; to divulge, betray; to find out, detect, discover; to excavate: Pass. -भिद्यते, to be broken asunder, to cleave or split open (intrans.); to burst asunder.
निर्भिद्य: निर्-भिद्य, ind. having broken through, having pierced or penetrated.
निर्भिन्न: निर्-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, broken asunder, pierced, divided. —निर्भिन्न-तनु, उस्, उस्, उ, having the body pierced through or transfixed.
निर्भेद: निर्-भेद, अस्, m. breaking or splitting asunder, bursting, dividing, a split, rent; the bed or channel of a river; the issue or termination of an affair, event.
निर्भेदिन्: निर्-भेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, splitting asunder, piercing.
निर्भेद्य: निर्-भेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be split asunder; having no rent; missing an aim; disappointed; (in the last three senses निर् is a privative.)
निर्भीति: निर्भीति निर्-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, not afraid.
निर्भुज्: निर्भुज् निर्-भुज्, cl. 6. P. -भुजति, -भोक्-तुम्, to bend on one side, bend awry, distort; (ओष्ठौ निर्भुजति, he distorts his lips, makes a wry face.)
निर्भुग्न: निर्-भुग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, bent awry, distorted; not bent, straight, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्भुज: निर्-भुज, अस्, आ, अम्, a term applied to a kind of Sandhi (or Saṃhitā).
निर्भू: निर्भू निर्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, Ved. to come out, move out, move.
निर्भूति: निर्-भूति, इस्, f., Ved. disappearing, passing away.
निर्भृ: निर्भृ निर्-भृ, cl. 1. 3. P. -भरति, -बि-भर्ति, -भर्तुम्, to take out, draw out.
निर्भृत: निर्-भृत, probably a wrong reading for नि-भृत।
निर्भृति: निर्भृति निर्-भृति, इस्, इस्, इ, without wages, hireless.
निर्भोग: निर्भोग निर्-भोग, अस्, आ, अम्, not devoted to pleasure or enjoyment.
निर्मक्षिक: निर्मक्षिक निर्-मक्षिक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from flies, free from tormentors, untroubled; (अम्), n. the being free from flies; (अम्), ind. without flies.
निर्मज्: निर्मज् निर्-मज्, Ved. (according to Sāy.) completely pure (as cows).
निर्मज्ज: निर्मज्ज निर्-मज्ज्, cl. 1. P. -मज्जति, &c., to sink under, sink into; to inundate, deluge.
निर्मज्ज निर्-मज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, fatless, mar-rowless, meagre.
निर्मग्न: निर्-मग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sunk, sunk into, sunk under, (opposed to उन्-मग्न।)
निर्मण्डूक: निर्मण्डूक निर्-मण्डूक, अस्, आ, अम्, frogless, destitute of frogs.
निर्मत्सर: निर्मत्सर निर्-मत्सर, अस्, आ, अम्, without envy, unenvious, free from envy or passion.
निर्मत्स्य: निर्मत्स्य निर्-मत्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fishless, destitute of fish. —निर्मत्स्य-ता, f. absence of fish, the having no fish.
निर्मथ: निर्मथ निर्-मथ, निर्-मथन। See under निर्-मन्थ् below.
निर्-मथ, अस्, m. stirring, rubbing. —निर्मथ-दारु = निर्मन्थ-दारु।
निर्मद: निर्मद निर्-मद, अस्, आ, अम्, unintoxicated, sober, quiet; not proud, humble; not in rut (as an elephant).
निर्मध्य: निर्मध्य निर्-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having no middle; (आ), f. = नलिका, a fragrant substance; [cf. निर्-मथ्या below.]
निर्मनस्क: निर्मनस्क निर्-मनस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, mindless, having no Manas. —निर्मनस्क-ता, f. the having no Manas.
निर्मनुज: निर्मनुज निर्-मनुज, अस्, आ, अम्, abandoned by men (as a forest), desolate, uninhabited.
निर्मनुष्य: निर्मनुष्य निर्-मनुष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, un-peopled, uninhabited, deserted by men, without a man; (मातङ्गो निर्मनुष्यस्, an elephant with-out riders.)
निर्मन्त्र: निर्मन्त्र निर्-मन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unaccom-panied by holy texts or the recitation of sacred verses (as the Gandharva marriage).
निर्मन्थ्: निर्मन्थ् निर्-मन्थ् or निर्-मथ्, cl. 1. 9. P. -मथति, -मन्थति, -मथ्नाति, &c., to stir about, agitate, churn, shake about, toss about roughly or violently; to rub, elicit fire by rubbing; to strike, beat violently, thresh, bruise, crush, stamp to pieces, grind, break in pieces, destroy.
निर्मथन: निर्-मथन, अम्, n. stirring, churning, rubbing, rubbing two pieces of wood together to light a fire.
निर्मथित: निर्-मथित, अस्, आ, अम्, stirred about, agitated, churned.
निर्मथ्य: 1. निर्-मथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stirred about or rubbed; (आ), f. a kind of fragrant substance, = नलिका; [cf. निर्-मध्या above.]
2. निर्-मथ्य, ind. having churned; having ground; having discriminated or particularized.
निर्मथ्यमान: निर्-मथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being shaken or tossed about roughly.
निर्मन्थ: निर्-मन्थ, अस्, m. rubbing. —निर्मन्थ-दारु, उस्, उ, m. n. or निर्मन्थ-काष्ठ, अम्, n. the wood used for kindling fire by friction; a churning-stick.
निर्मन्थन: निर्-मन्थन, अम्, n. rubbing, churning; sepa-rating, distinguishing, discriminating.
निर्मन्थ्य: निर्-मन्थ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stirred, to be churned; to be excited by friction (as fire); to be distinguished or discriminated.
निर्माथिन्: निर्-माथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, crushing or stamping to pieces, churning, rubbing.
निर्मन्यु: निर्मन्यु निर्-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free from anger or resentment; (उस्), m., N. of a hunter.
निर्मम: निर्मम निर्-मम, अस्, आ, अम्, unselfish, dis-interested; regardless, indifferent to (with loc.); free from all connection with the outer world; an epithet of Śiva; (अस्), m. (with Jainas) N. of the fifteenth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī. —निर्मम-ता, f. or 1. निर्मम-त्व, अम्, n. unselfishness, disregard of worldly interests, indifference towards (with loc.).
निर्ममत्व: 2. निर्-ममत्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from selfishness, indifferent.
निर्मर्याद: निर्मर्याद निर्-मर्याद, अस्, आ, अम्, boundless, having no limits, immeasurable, innumerable; trans-gressing the boundaries of right, unrestrained, unruly, wicked, criminal, sinful, impious; confused; (अम्), n. confusion, disturbance of boundaries or rules; N. of a kind of fight; (अम्), ind. confusedly, topsy-turvy.
निर्मल: निर्मल निर्-मल, अस्, आ, अम्, spotless, free from spots or dirt or impurities, stainless, unsullied, clear, clean, pure, limpid; shining, splendent, bright; virtuous; (अम्), n. talc; the remains of an offering made to a deity. —निर्मल-गद, अस्, आ, अम्, having a bright mace. —निर्मल-ता, f. or निर्मल-त्व, अम्, n. stainlessness, purity, cleanness (physical or moral). —निर्मली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from impurity, cleansed, cleared. —निर्मलोपल (°ल-उप्°), अस्, m. crystal.
निर्माल्य: निर्-माल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, stainless, clean, &c., = निर्-मल; (आ), f. a species of medicinal plant, see पृक्का; (अम्), n. stainlessness, purity, cleanness, clear-ness; the remains of an offering to a deity, flowers left at a sacrificial ceremony; remains in general. —निर्माल्य-ता, f. = निर्मल-ता।
निर्माल्य निर्-माल्य। See under निर्-मल, col. 1.
निर्मशक: निर्मशक निर्-मशक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from gnats or musquitoes.
निर्मा: निर्मा 1. निर्-मा, cl. 2. P., 3. and 4. A., -माति, -मिमीते, -मायते, -मातुम्, to build, make, form, fabricate; to produce, create; to compose; to cause: Caus. -मापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to be made or built.
निर्माण: निर्-माण, अम्, n. measuring or meting out, measure; reach, extent, (एक-निर्माण, अस्, आ, अम्, of the same measure; ककुदोदग्र-निर्माण, as high as the top of a mountain; अव्यक्त-निर्माणो बालस्, a boy who has not yet reached his full growth, not yet full grown); forming, making, pro-ducing, creating, production, fabrication, manufacture, formation, creation, building; composing, composi-tion, work; a building; a part; (with Buddhists) trans-formation; the best of anything, pith, marrow, essence; (आ), f. propriety, decorum, fitness. —निर्-माण-रत, आस्, m. pl. ‘delighting in creating or building,’ N. of a particular class of gods. —निर्-माण-रति, इस्, इस्, इ, delighting in creating; (अयस्), m. pl., N. of a class of deities in the eleventh Manv-antara; (with Buddhists) delighting in transforma-tion; [cf. निर्वाण-रुचि।]
निर्मातृ: निर्-मातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a maker, builder, creator, former, producer; building, fabricating, forming, &c. —निर्मातृ-त्व, अम्, n. creatorship, the condition of a maker or builder or producer.
निर्मित: निर्-मित, अस्, आ, अम्, constructed, manufactured, produced, built, fashioned, fabricated, formed, made; artificial; meted out; (आस्), m. pl. (with Buddhists) N. of a class of deities, ‘the transformed.’
निर्मिति: निर्-मिति, इस्, f. formation, production, creation, fabrication, manufacture, artificial production; making.
निर्मांस: निर्मांस निर्-मांस, अस्, आ, अम्, fleshless, emaciated.
निर्माख्य: निर्माख्य निर्-माख्य, अस्, m., N. of a man; (probably a wrong form, also read तिग्मात्मन् and निर्माद्।)
निर्मान: निर्मान निर्-मान, अस्, आ, अम्, without self-confidence, free from pride.
निर्मानुष: निर्मानुष निर्-मानुष, अस्, आ, अम्, unpeopled, uninhabited, abandoned by men, desolate; (ए), ind. in a solitary place.
निर्मार्ग: निर्मार्ग 1. निर्-मार्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, roadless, pathless. (For 2. निर्-मार्ग see under निर्-मृज्।)
2. निर्-मार्ग, अस्, m. (for 1. see above), rubbing or stripping off, wiping off; that which is stripped or wiped off, refuse.
निर्मुच्: निर्मुच् निर्-मुच्, cl. 6. P. A. -मुञ्चति, -ते, -मोक्तुम्, to loosen, free from, liberate.
निर्मुक्त: निर्-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, loosed, set free, liberated, disjoined, sundered, separated, &c.; (अस्), m. a snake which has lately cast his skin.
निर्मुक्ति: निर्-मुक्ति, इस्, f. liberation, deliverance; [cf. शाप-न्°।]
निर्मोक: निर्-मोक, अस्, m. setting loose or free, liberat-ing; a hide or skin, especially the cast off skin or slough of a snake [cf. सर्प-न्°]; armour, mail; sky, heaven, atmosphere; N. of a son of the eighth Manu; of one of the Saptarṣis under the thirteenth Manu; [cf. निर्-मोह।]
निर्मोक निर्-मोक, निर्-मोक्तृ, &c. See under निर्-मुच्, col. 2.
निर्मोक्तृ: निर्-मोक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who solves or liberates, a liberator, looser, solver (of doubts).
निर्मुट: निर्मुट निर्-मुट, अस्, m. a tree bearing large blossoms (= वनस्-पति); the sun; a rogue; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a large and free market or fair.
निर्मूल: निर्मूल निर्-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, rootless, de-prived of roots (as a tree); baseless, without origin, unfounded; eradicated. —निर्मूल-ता, f. rootless-ness, baselessness.
निर्मूलन: निर्-मूलन, अम्, n. uprooting, eradicating, ex-tirpating.
निर्मूलय: निर्-मूलय, Nom. P. निर्मूलयति, -यितुम्, to uproot, eradicate, extirpate, annihilate.
निर्मृज्: निर्मृज् निर्-मृज्, cl. 2. P. -मार्ष्टि, -मार्-जितुम् and -मार्ष्टुम्, to wipe off, wipe out, rub out, sweep out, strip off.
निर्मार्गुक: निर्-मार्गुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. drawing off, withdrawing, separating.
निर्मार्जन: निर्-मार्जन, अम्, n. wiping off, sweeping, cleaning.
निर्मृष्ट: निर्-मृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed out, wiped off or out, swept.
निर्मेघ: निर्मेघ निर्-मेघ, अस्, आ, अम्, cloudless. —निर्मेघाश्रम (°घ-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of a man.
निर्मेध: निर्मेध निर्-मेध, अस्, आ, अम्, without un-derstanding, stupid, dull. —निर्मेधाश्रम (°ध-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of a man.
निर्मोक्ष: निर्मोक्ष निर्-मोक्ष, अस्, m. (rt. मोक्ष्), liberation from, deliverance.
निर्मोह: निर्मोह निर्-मोह, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘free from illusion,’ an epithet of Śiva; (अस्), m., N. of a son of the fifth Manu; of one of the Saptarṣis under the thirteenth Manu; [cf. निर्-मोक।]
निर्म्रेतुक: निर्म्रेतुक निर्-म्रेतुक, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps fr. म्रै = म्लै with निस्), Ved. fading away, withering; (also read निर्-मेतुक, निर्-मॄतुक।)
निर्यत्: निर्यत् 1. निर्-यत्, अन्, अती, अत् (fr. निर्-इ), going forth, coming out, issuing.
निर्यत् 2. निर्-यत्, cl. 10. P. -यातयति, &c., to give back, restore, make restitution; to forgive, pardon, set free.
निर्यातक: निर्-यातक, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing away, carrying away, removing.
निर्यातन: निर्-यातन, अम्, n. giving back, returning, de-livering, restitution, delivery of a deposit, replacing anything lost; gift, donation; payment of a debt; requital, revenge; killing, slaughter.
निर्यातित: निर्-यातित, अस्, आ, अम्, restored, given back, retaliated, requited; taken away.
निर्यात्य: निर्-यात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given back or restored or delivered (as a deposit &c.).
निर्यत्न: निर्यत्न निर्-यत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, inactive, lazy, listless. —निर्यत्न-ता, f. inactivity.
निर्यन्त्रण: निर्यन्त्रण निर्-यन्त्रण, अस्, आ, अम्, without restraint, unrestrained, unobstructed, uncontrolled, unconfined, unrestricted, self-willed, independant; (अम्), n. absence of restraint, independance; (अम्), ind. without restraint, unrestrainedly. —निर्यन्त्रण-प्रदेशावस्थित (°श-अव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, being at a place where no restraint is needed.
निर्यन्त्रित: निर्-यन्त्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, uncontrolled, unre-strained, self-willed.
निर्यशस्क: निर्यशस्क निर्-यशस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, without fame or reputation, inglorious.
निर्या: निर्या 1. निर्-या, f., Ved. any disturbance of the regular course of a rite, any defect.
निर्या 2. निर्-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go out, issue, set out: Caus. -यापयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go out.
निर्याण: निर्-याण, अम्, n. going forth or out, exit, issue, setting out, departure; vanishing, disappearance; departure from life, dying, death; eternal emanci-pation, final beatitude, (probably confounded with 1. निर्-वाण, q. v.); the outer corner of an elephant's eye [cf. निर्-णायन]; iron; a rope for tying cattle or for binding a calf's feet, a foot-rope.
निर्यात: निर्-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out, gone forth, issued, departed.
निर्याति: निर्-याति, इस्, f. going out, exit, departing, dying.
निर्यापण: निर्-यापण, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), expelling, expulsion, banishing.
निर्याय: निर्-याय, ind. having gone out or departed.
निर्यियासु: निर्-यियासु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), trying or wishing to go out.
निर्यातृ: निर्यातृ निर्-यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a husband-man, reaper, weeder; (wrong reading for निर्-दातृ, q. v.)
निर्यादव: निर्यादव निर्-यादव, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from the Yādavas, without the Yādavas.
निर्याम: निर्याम निर्याम, अस्, m. a sailor, pilot, boatman (= नियामक).
निर्यास: निर्यास निर्-यास, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. यस् with निस्), exudation of trees or plants, juice, gum, resin, milk, &c.; extract, decoction, infusion; any thick fluid substance; [cf. अग्नि-न्°, तन्तु-न्°।]
निर्युक्ति: निर्युक्ति निर्-युक्ति, इस्, f. disunion; want of connection or government (in grammar); unfitness, inappropriateness, impropriety.
निर्युक्तिक: निर्-युक्तिक, अस्, आ, अम्, detached, disunited; unconnected, unmeaning, illogical, not founded on sound reasoning; inappropriate, improper. —निर्-युक्तिक-त्व, अम्, n. inappropriateness; illogicalness.
निर्यूथ: निर्यूथ निर्-यूथ, अस्, आ, अम्, separated from the herd (as an elephant &c.), strayed from the flock.
निर्यूष: निर्यूष निर्-यूष, अस्, m. extract, juice, &c., = निर्-यास = निर्-यूह।
निर्यूह: निर्यूह निर्-यूह, अस्, m. (probably for निर्-व्यूह), a prominence, projection (also अम्, n.), perhaps a kind of turret-like ornament on columns or gates, a pinnacle, turret; a chaplet, crest, head-ornament, the crest of a helmet; a peg or bracket projecting from a wall to hang or place anything upon [cf. नाग-निर्यूह]; wood placed in a wall for doves to build their nests upon; a door, gate (also n.); extract, juice, decoction, &c.; [cf. निर्-यास, निर्-यूष।]
निर्योग: निर्योग निर्-योग, अस्, m. (perhaps) a deco-ration, ornament.
निर्योगक्षेम: निर्योगक्षेम निर्-योगक्षेम, अस्, आ, अम्, free from care or anxiety about property.
निर्लक्षण: निर्लक्षण निर्-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having no special marks, undistinguished, unimportant, insig-nificant; unmarked, unspotted.
निर्लक्ष्य: निर्लक्ष्य निर्-लक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not to be observed or perceived, unobservable.
निर्लज्ज: निर्लज्ज निर्-लज्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless, im-modest, impudent, brazen. —निर्लज्ज-ता, f. shame-lessness, impudence.
निर्लिङ्ग: निर्लिङ्ग निर्-लिङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having no characteristic or distinguishing marks, not to be de-fined (as आत्मन्, ब्रह्मन्).
निर्लिप्त: निर्लिप्त निर्-लिप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. लिप् with निस्), unsmeared, unanointed; undefiled, uncon-taminated; (अस्), m., N. of Kṛṣṇa; a sage.
निर्लेप: निर्-लेप, अस्, आ, अम्, unanointed, unsmeared, free from fatty substances; stainless, spotless, sinless; (अस्), m. a sage.
निर्लुञ्चन: निर्लुञ्चन निर्-लुञ्चन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. लुञ्च् with निस्), pulling out or off, tearing off, peeling.
निर्लुण्ठन: निर्लुण्ठन निर्-लुण्ठन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. लुण्ठ् with निस्), robbing, plundering; pulling out, tearing off, (in the latter sense a wrong reading for निर्-लुञ्चन, q. v.)
निर्लेखन: निर्लेखन निर्-लेखन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. लिख् with निस्), a scraper, instrument for scraping; [cf. जिह्वा-न्°।]
निर्लोभ: निर्लोभ निर्-लोभ, अस्, आ, अम्, free from desire, unavaricious.
निर्लोम: निर्लोम निर्-लोम, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of hair, hairless, smooth.
निर्ल्वयनी: निर्ल्वयनी निर्-ल्वयनी, f. the cast off skin of a snake; (wrong reading for निर्-व्लयनी, q. v.)
निर्वंश: निर्वंश निर्-वंश, अस्, आ, अम्, without lineage or posterity, childless.
निर्वक्तव्य: निर्वक्तव्य निर्-वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वच् with निस्), to be interpreted or explained.
निर्वचन: 1. निर्-वचन, अम्, n. (for 2. see below), pro-nunciation; a proverbial expression, proverb; inter-pretation, etymological explanation, etymology; vo-cabulary, index; [cf. 1. नि-वचन।]
निर्वचन 2. निर्-वचन, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see above), not speaking, silent; unobjectionable, unblamable, blameless; (अम्), ind. silently; [cf. 2. नि-वचन।]
निर्वचनीय: निर्-वचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be defined more closely, to be interpreted or explained, to be described or related.
निर्वाच्य: 1. निर्-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = निर्-वचनीय। (For 2. see under निर्-वाक्य, p. 501, col. 1.)
2. निर्-वाच्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under निर्-वक्तव्य, p. 500, col. 2), improper to be said; unobjectionable, blameless, not to be found fault with or censured.
निर्वण: निर्वण निर्-वण or निर्-वन, अस्, आ, अम्, being out of a wood, ranging in the open country; free from woods; bare, open, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्वत्सशिशुपुङ्गव: निर्वत्सशिशुपुङ्गव निर्-वत्स-शिशुपुङ्गव, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of calves and young bulls.
निर्वद्: निर्वद् निर्-वद्, cl. 1. P. A. -वदति, -ते, -वदितुम्, to speak out, to blame; to deny.
निर्वाद: 1. निर्-वाद, अस्, m. (for 2. निर्-वाद see p. 501, col. 1), obloquy, censure, blame, reproach; rumour, report; asseveration, affirmation, decision of a controversy.
निर्वाद 2. निर्-वाद, अस्, m. (for 1. निर्-वाद see under निर्-वद्, p. 500, col. 2), absence of dispute or railing.
निर्वप्: निर्वप् निर्-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to pour out, sprinkle, drop, scatter; to offer sacrifical food, present funeral oblations or libations to the Manes of deceased ancestors; to present, deliver; to perform.

2. निर्-वाप, अस्, m. (for 1. see under निर्-वप्, p. 500, col. 2), putting out, extinguishing (as a fire).
निर्वाप 1. and 2. निर्-वाप। See p. 500, col. 2, and above.
निर्वापण: 1. निर्-वापण, अम्, n. (for 2. see p. 501, col. 1), scattering, throwing or pouring out, casting in, sow-ing; offering, presenting funeral oblations; gift, giving.

2. निर्-वापण, अम्, n. (for 1. see under निर्-वप्, p. 500, col. 2), putting out (as a fire or light), extinguishing, quenching; extinction, annihilation; slaughter, killing; (in medicine) refrigerant; cooling, refreshing.
निर्वापित: 1. निर्-वापित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see p. 501, col. 1), offered in oblation, scattered, poured out.
2. निर्-वापित, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under निर्-वप्, p. 500, col. 2), extinguished, put out, quenched; allayed, cooled; killed.
निर्वाप्य: 1. निर्-वाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 3. see p. 501, col. 1), to be scattered or offered.
2. निर्-वाप्य, ind. having offered funeral cakes.
3. निर्-वाप्य, ind. (for 1. and 2. see under निर्-वप्, p. 500, col. 2), having extinguished or quenched; having refreshed or delighted.
निर्वयनी: निर्वयनी निर्-वयनी, f. the cast off skin of a snake; (a various reading for निर्-व्लयनी; cf. निर्-ल्वयनी।)
निर्वर: निर्वर निर्-वर, a various reading for निर्-दर।
निर्वरुणता: निर्वरुणता निर्वरुण-ता, f. or निर्वरुण-त्व, अम्, n. deliverance from Varuṇa's power.
निर्वर्ण्: निर्वर्ण् निर्-वर्ण्, cl. 10. P. -वर्णयति, -यितुम्, to look at, contemplate.
निर्वर्णन: निर्-वर्णन, अम्, n. looking at, regarding, sight, seeing.
निर्वर्णनीय: निर्-वर्णनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be looked at or regarded.
निर्वर्ण्य: निर्-वर्ण्य, ind. having looked at, having re-garded.
निर्वर्तक: निर्वर्तक निर्-वर्तक, निर्-वर्तन, &c. See under निर्-वृत्, p. 502, col. 1.
निर्-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), com-pleting, accomplishing, performing, finishing, ending, executing; desisting; [cf. नि-वर्तक।]
निर्वस्: निर्वस् निर्-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to dwell, finish dwelling; to dwell abroad: Caus. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to expel from home, banish.
निर्वास: निर्-वास, अस्, m. leaving or abandoning one's home, residing far from one's native place; expulsion, banishment; killing.
निर्वासन: 1. निर्-वासन, अम्, n. (for 2. निर्-वासन see p. 501, col. 1), expelling or driving from home, banishing, banishment, expulsion; hurting, injuring, killing, slaughter, annihilation; [cf. उद्-वासन, -प्र-वासन।]
निर्वासन 2. निर्-वासन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + वासना; for 1. निर्-वासन see under निर्-वस्, p. 500, col. 2), without fancy or imagination.
निर्वासनीय: निर्-वासनीय or निर्-वास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be expelled or banished.
निर्वासित: निर्-वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, expelled, banished, driven from home.
निर्वसु: निर्वसु निर्-वसु, उस्, उस्, उ, destitute of wealth or property, poor. —निर्वसु-त्व, अम्, n. poverty, destitution.
निर्वह्: निर्वह् निर्-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to bring or carry out, bring one's self out of, extricate one's self: Caus. P. -वाहयति, -यितुम्, to carry out, carry on, perform, accomplish, effect, fulfil, settle; to pass, spend (time &c.).
निर्वहण: निर्-वहण, अम्, n. end, issue, completion; the closing scene or catastrophe of a drama, the con-clusion; carrying on, (for निर्-वाहण।)
निर्वहितृ: निर्-वहितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, separating, dividing.
निर्वाह: निर्-वाह, अस्, m. carrying on, accomplishing, per-forming, managing, accomplishment, management; completion, end; narrating, describing; supporting, maintaining; subsisting on; sufficiency, adequacy, competent provision or means of living; steadfastness; [cf. नैर्वाहिक।]
निर्वाहक: निर्-वाहक, अस्, इका, अम्, accomplishing, per-forming, effecting; (अम्), n. application or connec-tion of cause and effect (?).
निर्वाहण: निर्-वाहण, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying out, effecting; carrying away, removing; (अम्), n. accomplishment, completion; the catastrophe or closing scene of a drama (= निर्-वहण).
निर्वाहिन्: निर्-वाहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, leading out, carrying out; discharging (as a wound).
निर्वाह्य: निर्-वाह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be carried on or accomplished or performed.
निर्वा: निर्वा निर्-वा, cl. 2. P. -वाति, -वातुम्, to cease to blow; (cl. 4. -वायति, &c.), to be extin-guished; to be refreshed: Caus. -वापयति, -यितुम्, to extinguish, put out; to refresh, cool, allay, make happy, delight.
निर्वाण: 1. निर्-वाण, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. निर्-वाण see p. 501, col. 1), blown out, gone out, put out, extinguished (as a fire); lost, disappeared; liberated from exist-ence (lit. having the fire of life extinguished); dead, deceased, defunct; set (as a planet); calmed, quieted, (अ-निर्वाण, an elephant not yet tamed or one just caught and wild); immersed, plunged; (अम्), n. blowing out, extinguishing, extinction, (in this and some of the following senses निर्-वाणम् is not the neut. of the pass. part. but formed fr. निर्-वा with affix अन), becoming extinguished, disappearance, setting, vanishing from sight, (निर्वाणं कृ, to act as if nothing had happened, not to keep one's promise); extinction of the flame of life, dissolution, liberation, eternal bliss, final emancipation from matter and reunion with the deity, union with the Supreme Spirit; (with Buddhists and Jainas) absolute extinction or annihilation, complete extinction of individual existence; perfect and perpetual calm, repose; complete satisfaction or pleasure, highest felicity; desisting, leaving off, cessation; vacuity, vacuum; union, association, blending, confluence; of-fering oblations, (perhaps wrongly for 1. निर्-वापण); bathing of an elephant (because he draws in water with his trunk and then blows it out over his body); instructing in sciences; ‘Deliverance,’ N. of an Upa-niṣad; [cf. अप-न्°, परि-न्°।] —निर्वाण-पुराण, अम्, n. offering oblations to the dead. —निर्वाण-प्रकरण, अम्, n., N. of the fourth chapter of the Vāsiṣṭha-rāmāyaṇa, commonly called Yoga-vāsiṣṭha. —निर्वाण-भूयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, almost all vanished or departed. —निर्वाण-मण्डप, N. of a temple. —निर्वाण-मन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a mystical formula. —निर्वाण-मस्तक, अस्, m. libe-ration, deliverance. —निर्वाण-रुचि, अयस्, m. pl. ‘delighting in final beatitude,’ N. of a class of deities under the eleventh Manu; [cf. निर्माण-रति।] —निर्वाण-लक्षण, अस्, आ, अम्, having complete felicity as its characteristic mark. —निर्वाण-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of certain Buddhist Sūtras.
निर्वाण 2. निर्-वाण, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see under निर्-वा, p. 500, col. 3), having no arrows.
निर्वाणिन्: निर्-वाणिन्, ई, m. (with Jainas) N. of the second Arhat of the past Ut-sarpiṇī.
निर्वात: 1. निर्-वात, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see below), ceased to blow.

निर्वात 2. निर्-वात, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. see above), free from wind, sheltered from wind, not windy, calm, still; (अस्), m. a calm, a place sheltered from wind. —निर्वात-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, standing sheltered from the wind.
निर्वापयितृ: निर्-वापयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, extinguishing, refri-gerant, one who allays.
निर्वाक: निर्वाक निर्वाक, अस्, m. in कर्ण-निर्वाक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
निर्वाक्य: निर्वाक्य निर्-वाक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, speechless.
निर्वाच्: निर्-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, silent, mute, dumb.
निर्वाञ्च्: निर्वाञ्च् निर्वाञ्च्, आङ्, आची, आक् (according to the commentator fr. निर्-अव-अञ्च्), outward, exterior.
निर्वाणी: निर्वाणी निर्-वाणी, f. (with Jainas) N. of a deity who executes the commands of the sixteenth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī.
निर्वानर: निर्वानर निर्-वानर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from monkeys.
निर्वायस: निर्वायस निर्-वायस, अस्, आ, अम्, free from crows.
निर्वार्य: निर्वार्य निर्-वार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, irresistible, not to be opposed or resisted; acting fearlessly or determinedly.
निर्विकल्प: निर्विकल्प निर्-विकल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, not ad-mitting an alternative; recognising no such distinc-tions as that of subject and object; being without determination; (अम्), ind. without hesitation or vacillation, without wavering, without reflection.
निर्विकल्पक: निर्-विकल्पक or निर्-विकल्पन, अस्, आ, अम्, not admitting an alternative, free from differences, having no mutual dependence; not capable of mutual relation; undeliberative; conditioned; (अम्), n. knowledge not depending upon or derived from the senses.
निर्विकार: निर्विकार निर्-विकार, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-विकार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, unchanged, unaltered, un-changeable, immutable, uniform. —निर्विकार-ता, f. unchangeableness, uniformity.
निर्विकास: निर्विकास निर्-विकास, अस्, आ, अम्, not yet opened or expanded (as a blossom), unblown. —निर्-विकास-त्व, अम्, n. the being not yet opened or expanded.
निर्विक्रम्: निर्विक्रम् निर्-वि-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम्, to go out of, come out of.
निर्विघ्न: निर्विघ्न निर्-विघ्न, अस्, आ, अम्, unobstructed, uninterrupted, untroubled, secure from impediments; (अम्), n. absence of obstruction or impediment; (अम् or एन), ind. unobstructedly, freely, securely.
निर्विचार: निर्विचार निर्-विचार, अस्, आ, अम्, not re-flecting or considering; (अम्), ind. without reflection, without consideration, inconsiderately.
निर्विचिकित्स: निर्विचिकित्स निर्-विचिकित्स, अस्, आ, अम्, with-out reflecting much; (अम्), ind. without much or long reflection.
निर्विचेष्ट: निर्विचेष्ट निर्-विचेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, motion-less, insensible, unresisting.
निर्वितर्क: निर्वितर्क निर्-वितर्क, अस्, आ, अम्, unreflect-ing, inconsiderate.
निर्विद्: निर्विद् निर्-विद्, cl. 4. A. -विद्यते, &c., to be disgusted with one's self, to disparage or despise one's self, be ashamed of one's self, to be disgusted, to be despondent.
निर्विण्ण: निर्-विण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, despondent, depressed; disgusted with anything (gen.); loathing; self-dis-paraged, overcome with fear or sorrow; emaciated with grief; decayed, impaired; abused, degraded; humble; known, certain. —निर्विण्ण-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, depressed in mind, broken in spirit, humble-minded, meek, resigned, desponding.

निर्वेद 2. निर्-वेद, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. निर्-वेद see under निर्-विद्, p. 501, col. 2), not having the Vedas, infidel, unscriptural.
निर्विद्य: निर्विद्य निर्-विद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unlearned, destitute of knowledge, uneducated.
निर्विधित्स: निर्विधित्स निर्-विधित्स, अस्, आ, अम्, not wishing to do, having no designs, free from desire.
निर्विनोद: निर्विनोद निर्-विनोद, अस्, आ, अम्, without amusement, without pastime, void of solace or diversion.
निर्विन्ध्य: निर्विन्ध्य निर्-विन्ध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, living on the outside or other side of the Vindhyas; (आ), f., N. of a river rising in the Vindhya hills or of one rising in the Ṛkṣa mountains.
निर्विभास्: निर्विभास् निर्-वि-भास्, Caus. -भासयति, -यितुम्, to illuminate, enlighten.
निर्विमर्श: निर्विमर्श निर्-विमर्श, अस्, आ, अम्, not con-sidering, unreflecting, devoid of reflection; (also written निर्-विमर्ष।)
निर्विवर: निर्विवर निर्-विवर, अस्, आ, अम्, having no opening or rent, without interval or interstice, close, contiguous. —निर्विवर-ता, f. want of interstice, contiguousness (as of the female breasts); want of enmity; agreement, understanding.
निर्विवह्: निर्विवह् निर्-वि-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to carry out, export; to expel.
निर्विवाद: निर्विवाद निर्-विवाद, अस्, आ, अम्, not con-tending or disagreeing, agreeing with each other; (अम्), n. absence of contention or controversy. —निर्-विवादी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made to agree.
निर्विवित्सु: निर्विवित्सु निर्-विवित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid. of rt. विद् with निस्), desirous to find (?).
निर्विवेक: निर्विवेक निर्-विवेक, अस्, आ, अम्, indiscreet, undiscriminating, wanting discrimination or judg-ment, foolish. —निर्विवेक-त्व, अम्, n. want of discrimination or judgment, indiscretion.
निर्विश्: निर्विश् निर्-विश्, cl. 6. P. -विशति, -वेष्टुम्, to enter into, to meet with, enjoy (with acc., e. g. मधुं निर्विविशुः, they enjoyed wine); to ex-perience; to embellish; to reward.

निर्विष्ट: निर्-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, attained, arrived at, met with; obtained, gained, experienced, earned, received; engaged in, occupied by, staying in; married.
निर्वेश: निर्-वेश, अस्, m. entering into, gaining, obtaining; wages, hire, employment; payment, returning pay-ment [cf. नि-वेश्य]; expiation, atonement, (अ-निर्-वेश, one who has not expiated his sins); enjoyment, eating; fainting, swooning, syncope.
निर्वेश निर्-वेश। See under निर्-विश्, p. 501, col. 3.
निर्वेशनीय: निर्-वेशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gained or enjoyed.
निर्वेष्टव्य: निर्-वेष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entered into; to be rewarded, to be paid; to be embellished.
निर्विशङ्क: निर्विशङ्क निर्-विशङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, or निर्-विशङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless, undaunted, confident.

निर्विशेषण: निर्-विशेषण, अस्, आ, अम्, having no attributes.
निर्विष: निर्विष निर्-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, without venom, poisonless (as serpents); (आ and ई), f. a species of grass, Kyllingia Monocephala, used as an antidote.
निर्विषङ्ग: निर्विषङ्ग निर्-विषङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, not attached to anything, indifferent.

निर्विषाण: निर्विषाण निर्-विषाण, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of horns or tusks, tuskless (as an elephant).
निर्विहङ्ग: निर्विहङ्ग निर्-विहङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, without birds, free from birds.
निर्विहार: निर्विहार निर्-विहार, अस्, आ, अम्, having no pleasure, deprived of pleasure.
निर्वीज: निर्वीज निर्-वीज, अस्, आ, अम्, seedless; im-potent; (आ), f. a sort of grape without seeds or stones (= काकली-द्राक्षा, commonly called किष्मिष्). —निर्वीज-त्व, अम्, n. seedlessness, impotence.
निर्वीर: निर्वीर निर्-वीर, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of men or heroes; unheroic, cowardly; (आ), f. a woman whose husband and children are dead, a childless widow; N. of a river; (अम्), n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
निर्वीरुध्: निर्वीरुध् निर्-वीरुध्, त्, त्, त्, deprived of plants.
निर्वीर्य: निर्वीर्य निर्-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, powerless, unmanly, without manly courage, spiritless, tame, feeble, impotent. —निर्वीर्य-ता, f. unmanliness, powerlessness.
निर्वृ: निर्वृ निर्-वृ, apparently only occurring in the derivatives below.
निर्वृत: निर्-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, satisfied, contented, happy, pleased, enraptured, tranquil, at ease, secure, free from cares, free from anxiety and troubles, free from occupation or interest, emancipated; ended, termi-nated, ceased.
निर्वृत निर्-वृत, निर्-वृति। See under निर्-वृ above.
निर्वृति: निर्-वृति, इस्, f. complete satisfaction, contentment, tranquillity, bliss, happiness, gladness, pleasure; final emancipation or liberation from existence; freedom; rest, repose; setting, disappearance, death, destruc-tion; completion, accomplishment (for निर्-वृत्ति); ceasing, abstaining from (for नि-वृत्ति); incivility, impropriety (for निर्-वृत्ति); (इस्), m., N. of a man; of a son of Vṛṣṇi; (the forms निर्-वृति, निर्-वृत्ति, and नि-वृत्ति are often incorrectly confounded together.)
निर्वृक्ष: निर्वृक्ष निर्-वृक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, treeless.
निर्वृत्: निर्वृत् निर्-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut. Cond. and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to be completed or accomplished, to be effected; to draw back, recede, desist, cease, not to be done, not to take place, (in these senses probably for नि-वृत्, q. v.): Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to complete, accomplish, finish, perform, produce, create.
निर्वर्तन: निर्-वर्तन, अम्, n. accomplishment, completion, execution; desisting (for नि-वर्तन).
निर्वर्तनीय: निर्-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be completed or accomplished.
निर्वर्तिन्: निर्-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, accomplishing, performing, executing; behaving rudely or uncivilly, uncivil.
निर्वर्त्य: 1. निर्-वर्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be accomplished, per-formable, to be pronounced or uttered, pronounceable. —निर्वर्त्य-त्व, अम्, n. performableness; pro-nounceableness.
2. निर्-वर्त्य, ind. having accomplished, having performed or finished; having ceased, (for नि-वर्त्य।)
निर्वृत्त: निर्-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completely done, accomplished. —निर्वृत्त-शत्रु, उस्, m., N. of a prince of the Kaliṅgas; (probably wrongly for नि-वृत्त-शत्रु; cf. निनर्त-शत्रु।)
निर्वृत्ति: निर्-वृत्ति, इस्, f. completion, termination, con-clusion; (in grammar) cessation of the influence of one rule over another; result, fruit, reward; impro-priety, incivility [cf. निर्-वर्तिन् above]; final beati-tude (for निर्-वृति); abstaining from action, inac-tivity (for नि-वृत्ति); (इस्, इस्, इ), having no occu-pation, destitute, (in this sense निर् is a privative.)
निर्वृष्: निर्वृष् निर्-वृष्, cl. 1. P. -वर्षति, -वर्-षितुम्, to cease to rain.
निर्वृष्टि: निर्-वृष्टि, इस्, f. cessation of rain, want of rain.
निर्वृष: निर्वृष निर्-वृष, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of bulls.
निर्वेग: निर्वेग निर्-वेग, अस्, आ, अम्, without violent motion or impetuosity, not waving, quiet, calm.
निर्वेतन: निर्वेतन निर्-वेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, not receiv-ing wages, unsalaried.
निर्वेधिम: निर्वेधिम निर्-वेधिम (fr. व्यध् with निस्), with कर्ण, a peculiar deformity of the ear.
निर्वेपन: निर्वेपन निर्-वेपन, अस्, आ, अम्, not trem-bling, not flickering (as the flame of a lamp).
निर्वेष्टन: निर्वेष्टन निर्-वेष्टन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वेष्ट् with निस्), a small reed used as a shuttle, a weaver's shuttle.
निर्वैर: निर्वैर निर्-वैर, अम्, n. absence of enmity; (अस्, आ, अम्), free from enmity, without enmity, living in peace, peaceable; (अस्), m., N. of a hunter; (अम्), ind. peaceably, without enmity. —निर्वैर-ता, f. freedom from enmity, peaceableness, concord.
निर्वैरिण: निर्-वैरिण, अम्, n. absence of enmity, concord.
निर्वोढृ: निर्वोढृ निर्-वोढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ, car-rying or leading away, who or what carries away; separating, dividing; [cf. निर्-वहितृ।]
निर्व्यञ्जन: निर्व्यञ्जन निर्-व्यञ्जन, अस्, आ, अम्, without condiment; straightforward; (ए), ind. in a straight-forward or downright manner; plainly, without verbosity; silently (?).
निर्व्यथ: निर्व्यथ निर्-व्यथ, अस्, आ, अम्, free from pain; quiet, unmoved, calm.
निर्व्यथन: निर्-व्यथन, अम्, n. a hole, chasm (a place of rest); freedom from pain; paining, afflicting, (in this sense निर् is a prep.)
निर्व्यपेक्ष: निर्व्यपेक्ष निर्-व्यपेक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, disre-garding, indifferent to (with loc.).
निर्व्यलीक: निर्व्यलीक निर्-व्यलीक, अस्, आ, अम्, not caus-ing pain, not hurting, not offending; not feeling pain, without pain, pleased, doing willingly or sin-cerely, sincere, genuine, undissembling; (अम्), ind. sincerely, readily. —निर्व्यलीक-तस्, ind. sincerely.
निर्व्याकुल: निर्व्याकुल निर्-व्याकुल, अस्, आ, अम्, not troubled or disquieted, not excited, calm. —निर्-व्याकुल-ता, f. freedom from trouble, calmness; (तया), ind. with complete calmness, quite calmly.
निर्व्याघ्र: निर्व्याघ्र निर्-व्याघ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, free from tigers, not infested by tigers.
निर्व्याज: निर्व्याज निर्-व्याज, अस्, आ, अम्, without de-ceit, candid, upright, straightforward, honest, plain, exact; (अम्), ind. honestly, exactly, plainly. —निर्व्याज-ता, f. honesty, plainness, candour. —निर्व्याजी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made plain, freed from deceit or illusion.
निर्व्याधि: निर्व्याधि निर्-व्याधि, इस्, इस्, इ, free from sickness, healthy, strong.
निर्व्यापार: निर्व्यापार निर्-व्यापार, अस्, आ, अम्, without employment or business, free from occupation, un-occupied, not busy, at leisure.
निर्व्यूह्: निर्व्यूह् निर्-व्य्-ऊह्, cl. 1. P. A. -ऊहति, -ते, &c., to push out, carry out, lead or bring away, re-move; to arrange, put in order, perform, accomplish.
निर्व्यूढ: निर्-व्यूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, finished, completed; abandoned, left, deserted; (अम्), n. various reading for निर्-वाह, completion.
निर्व्यूढि: निर्-व्यूढि, इस्, f. end, completion; the top, highest point or degree.
निर्व्यूह: निर्-व्यूह, अस्, m. a turret; a helmet or its ornament, a crest; a pinnacle (?); a door, gate; a pin or peg in a wall to hang things upon; decoction; [cf. निर्-यूह।]
निर्व्रण: निर्व्रण निर्-व्रण, अस्, आ, अम्, without wounds, unhurt; undamaged; without notches or rents.
निर्व्रत: निर्व्रत निर्-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्, neglecting religious observances, not observing vows.
निर्व्रस्क: निर्व्रस्क निर्-व्रस्क, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. व्रश्च् with निस्), uprooted, extirpated.
निर्व्लयनी: निर्व्लयनी निर्-व्लयनी, f. (fr. rt. व्ली with निस्). See निर्-ल्वयनी, p. 500, col. 1.
निर्हन्: निर्हन् निर्-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, Ved. to strike out, expel.
निर्हस्त: निर्हस्त निर्-हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. handless, without hands; [cf. नैर्हस्त।]
निर्हाद: निर्हाद निर्-हाद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हद् with निस्), evacuation, voiding excrement; [cf. निर्-हार।]
निर्हार: निर्हार निर्-हार। See under निर्-हृ below.

निर्-हार, अस्, m. extracting, drawing out, rooting up, destroying, destruction; putting forth or out; carrying away, carrying out a corpse or dead body to the funeral pile to be burnt; taking away, re-moving, abstracting; setting aside; accumulation of a private store of wealth, a hoard; evacuation of any of the natural excrements of the body, (opposed to आ-हार; cf. निर्-हाद, नी-हार); giving away (?); diffusive fragrance; completion.
निर्हिम: निर्हिम निर्-हिम, अम्, n. cessation of winter.
निर्हृ: निर्हृ निर्-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-तुम्, to draw out from, extract, tear out, pull out, root up; to carry out (a dead body), to carry or take away; to export (goods); to change or mix together (clothes &c.).
निर्हरण: निर्-हरण, अम्, n. taking forth or out, drawing out, extracting, rooting up, taking away, removing, removal; setting aside, carrying away, carrying out dead bodies to be burnt, carrying a corpse to the funeral pyre.
निर्हरणीय: निर्-हरणीय or निर्-हर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be taken away or removed; to be drawn out, &c.
निर्हारक: निर्-हारक, अस्, इका, अम्, carrying out (a dead body to the funeral pile), one who carries out or extracts or removes.
निर्हारण: निर्-हारण, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), causing (a dead body) to be carried out.
निर्हारिन्: निर्-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, taking forth or out, carrying out; diffusively fragrant, spreading wide (as odour); having wealth.
निर्हृत: निर्-हृत, अस्, आ, अम्, extracted, drawn out, taken or carried forth or out.
निर्हृति: निर्-हृति, इस्, f. bringing away, taking out of one's way, removal.
निर्हृत्य: 1. निर्-हृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be taken out; to be left out or omitted.
2. निर्-हृत्य, ind. having taken forth or out, having extracted.
निर्हेति: निर्हेति निर्-हेति, इस्, इस्, इ, weaponless, un-armed.
निर्हेतु: निर्हेतु निर्-हेतु, उस्, उस्, उ, causeless, reason-less, having no cause or reason. —निर्हेतु-त्व, अम्, n. causelessness.
निर्ह्राद: निर्ह्राद निर्-ह्राद or नि-ह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्राद् with निस्), a sound in general. —निर्ह्राद-भीत, अस्, आ, अम्, terrified by a sound or noise.
निर्ह्रादिन्: निर्-ह्रादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding, resounding, roaring.
निर्ह्रास: निर्ह्रास निर्-ह्रास, अस्, m. abbreviation, shortening (of a vowel).
निर्ह्रीक: निर्ह्रीक निर्-ह्रीक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + ह्री), not shy, without shame, bold, daring.
निल्: निल् निल्, cl. 6. P. निलति, &c., to un-derstand with difficulty, to be impassable or impenetrable; [cf. नि-ली below.]
निलय्: निलय् निल्-अय् (= निर्-अय्), cl. 1. A. -अयते, -यितुम्, to go out; [cf. rt. इ and rt. अय्।]
निलयन: 1. निल्-अयन, अम्, n. (for 2. see under नि-ली below), the act of going out.
2. नि-लयन, अम्, n. (for 1. see p. 502, col. 3), settling in a place, alighting; place of refuge, dwelling-place, dwelling, habitation.
निलिम्प: निलिम्प नि-लिम्प, अस्, m. (fr. rt. लिप् with नि), Ved., N. of a particular class of supernatural beings; a troop of Maruts; a god in general; (आ), f. a cow. —निलिम्प-निर्झरी, f. the river of the gods, the Gaṅgā.
निली: निली नि-ली, cl. 4. A. -लीयते, -लेतुम् and -लातुम्, to lie down, settle down, alight; to hide one's self, disappear, conceal one's self from (with abl.); to sink down, perish, (नि-लिल्यिरे, they perished, Mahā-bh. Sauptika-p. 399.)
निलय: नि-लय, अस्, m. hiding one's self; a hiding-place; the lair or den of animals, a nest; dwelling, abode, residence, house, habitation; (often at the end of a comp. in the sense of) having one's residence, living, residing in (e. g. कैलास-निलय, residing in Kailāsa).
निलायिता: निलायि-ता, f. dwelling, residing in, the being domesticated.
निलायिन्: नि-लायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in, inhabiting.
निलीन: नि-लीन, अस्, आ, अम्, fused in or into; involved, en-compassed, surrounded, shut or wrapt up, embraced, destroyed, perished; transformed, changed; full.
निलीनक: निलीनक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), N. of a village in the north country; [cf. नैलीनक।]
निलीयमान: नि-लीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, hiding, lying concealed.
निवक्षस्: निवक्षस् नि-वक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. (pro-bably) an epithet of the sacrificial animal (implying some peculiarity of colour &c.).
निवचन: निवचन 1. नि-वचन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. वच् with नि), Ved. expression, address; a proverbial expression; [cf. 1. निर्-वचन।]

निवचन 2. नि-वचन, अस्, आ, अम् (नि = निस्), (Pāṇ. 1. 4, 76), not speaking; [cf. 2. निर्-वचन।] —निवचने-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to obstruct the speech, to cease to speak. —निवचने-कृत्य or निवचने-कृत्वा, ind. having ceased to speak.
निवत्: निवत् नि-वत्, त्, f. (fr. नि), Ved. a steep place, a valley; (ता), ind. downhill, downwards.
निवध्: निवध् नि-वध्, a defective verb (see वध्), to kill.
निवना: निवना नि-वना, ind., Ved. downwards, downhill; [cf. नि-वता।]
निवप्: निवप् नि-वप्, cl. 1. P. A. -वपति, -ते, -वप्तुम्, to scatter seed, sow; to offer, make offer-ings of cakes &c. to the Manes; to kill.
निवपन: नि-वपन, अम्, n. pouring out, scattering or throwing down; sowing; oblations or gifts in honour of deceased ancestors, an offering to the Manes; [cf. निर्-वपण।]
निवाप: नि-वाप, अस्, m. seed, grain, seed corn; an oblation or offering to the Manes of deceased parents or relatives, a libation or offering of water &c. at the Śrāddha; gift, offering in general.
निवापिन्: निवापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, pouring out, throwing or scat-tering down, sowing.
न्युप्त: न्युप्त न्य्-उप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-वप्, q. v.), offered, presented (to the Manes of deceased ancestors).
निवर: निवर नि-वर। See नि-वृ, p. 504, col. 1.
नि-वर, अस्, m., Ved. covering, protection, a protector; (Sāy.) a preventer, obstructer; (आ), f. a virgin, an unmarried girl, (in this sense probably fr. नि, ‘not,’ + वर, ‘a husband.’)
निवर्त: निवर्त नि-वर्त, नि-वर्तन, &c. See नि-वृत्, p. 504, col. 1.
नि-वर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing to return or turn back.
निवर्हण: नि-वर्हण, अस्, आ, अम्, destroying, extirpating, annihilating, removing; (अम्), n. destruction, eradi-cation, annihilation, killing, removing; [cf. नि-बर्-हण।]
निवस्: निवस् 1. नि-वस्, cl. 1. P. -वसति, -वस्तुम्, to dwell, inhabit, reside, lodge, live in (with loc.); to sojourn, pass time, pass the night; to roost.
निवस् 2. नि-वस्, cl. 2. A. -वस्ते, -वसितुम्, to put on or wear (clothes), dress; to change one's clothes: Caus. or cl. 10. P. -वासयति, -यितुम्, to put on (a garment?).
निवसत्: नि-वसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, dwelling in, inhabiting.
निवसति: नि-वसति, इस्, f. a habitation, abiding, abode, house, residence.
निवसन: 1. नि-वसन, अम्, n. a dwelling, house, a habita-tion. (For 2. see under 2. नि-वस्, col. 2.)
2. नि-वसन, अम्, n. (for 1. see under 1. नि-वस्, col. 1), putting on (a garment), cloth, clothes, raiment; an under garment.
निवस्तव्य: नि-वस्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be lived; to be spent.
निवास: 1. नि-वास, अस्, m. (for 2. see under 2. नि-वस्, col. 2), living, dwelling, residing; passing the night; a place of residence, dwelling-place, abode, house; night-quarters. —निवास-भूमि, इस्, f. place of residence. —निवास-भूय, अम्, n. habitation; in-habiting. —निवास-राजन्, आ, m. the king of the country in which one dwells.
2. नि-वास, अस्, m. (for 1. see under 1. नि-वस्, col. 1), dress (e. g. in चर्म-निवास, dressed in a skin).
निवासन: 1. नि-वासन, अम्, n. (for 2. see under 2. नि-वस् below), living, residing [cf. जगन्-न्°]; sojourn; passing or spending time.
2. नि-वासन, अम्, n. (for 1. see under 1. नि-वस्, above), (with Buddhists) a kind of raiment.
निवासिन्: 1. नि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling, abiding in, inhabit-ing, an inhabitant, resident.
2. नि-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ (at the end of a comp.), dressed in, wearing, clothed, covered.
निवासय: नि-वासय (fr. 2. नि-वास), Nom. P. निवासयति, &c., to put on (a garment), to cover.
निवह्: निवह् नि-वह्, cl. 1. P. A. -वहति, -ते, -वोढुम्, to bring or lead near; to carry, to support.
निवह: नि-वह, अस्, m. a multitude, quantity, heap, (in this sense also आस्, m. pl.); N. of one of the seven winds; one of the seven tongues of fire.
निवाह: नि-वाह, अस्, m., Ved. leading down, (opposed to अभ्य्-अवरोह।)
निवात: निवात 1. नि-वात, अस्, आ, अम् (नि = निस्), protected against or sheltered from the wind, not reached by the wind, not windy, calm [cf. 2. निर्-वात]; (अम्), n. a place sheltered from or inac-cessible to the wind, a sheltered spot, (sometimes used at the end of a comp. of which the first member expresses the sheltering object, see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 8); a calm.

निवात 2. नि-वात, अस्, आ, अम् (नि + वात fr. वन्), unimpeded, unhurt, uninjured; secure, safe (as in an asylum); well armed, accoutred in strong mail; (अस्), m. an asylum, a refuge, a dwelling, &c.; an impenetrable coat of mail; (अम्), n. security, a secure spot; strong armour. —निवात-कवच, अस्, आ, अम्, whose armour or mail is impenetrable, wear-ing an impenetrable coat of mail; (अस्), m., N. of a demon, the grandson of Hiraṇya-kaśipu; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of Dānavas or Daityas.
निवार: निवार नि-वार। See नि-वृ, p. 504, col. 1.
नि-वार, अस्, m. keeping off, warding off, defend-ing, preventing, hindering, opposition, impediment; (आ), f., N. of a river.
निवाश: निवाश नि-वाश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. वाश् with नि), Ved. bellowing, roaring, sounding.
निविड: निविड नि-विड, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. विड = विल, a hole, with नि = निस्), without spaces or interstices, close, contiguous, coarse, large, bulky; gross, thick, impervious, impenetrable, dense, firm; crooked-nosed; (अस्), m., N. of a mountain.
निविडय: निविडय, Nom. P. निविडयति, &c., to make tight.
निविडीस: नि-विडीस, अस्, आ, अम्, compact, close; coarse, gross; crooked-nosed (?).
निविद्: निविद् 1. नि-विद्, cl. 2. P. -वेत्ति, -वेद, -वे-दितुम्, to tell, communicate, proclaim: Caus. -वेद-यति, -यितुम्, to make known, tell, communicate, report, represent, betray, relate (with dat., loc., or gen. of the person); to present, offer, give, deliver.

2. नि-विद्, त्, f., Ved. instruction, information, direc-tion, communication, precept, doctrine; invocation; N. of certain sentences or short formularies inserted in a liturgy and containing epithets or short invoca-tions of the gods (e. g. अग्निः सुषमित्, होता देव-वृतः); (Sāy.) speech, a short text of the Veda. —निविद्-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing the Nivids; (अम्), n. (according to Sāy.) inserting the Nivids. —निविद्धानीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing the Nivids.
निवेदक: नि-वेदक, अस्, आ, अम्, communicating, relating.
निवेदक नि-वेदक, नि-वेदन, &c. See under 1. नि-विद्, p. 503, cols. 2, 3.
निवेदन: नि-वेदन, अस्, आ, अम्, proclaiming, announcing; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n. making known, proclaiming, apprizing, publishing, relating, communicating, announcement, communication; in-formation; representation; delivering, giving, en-trusting; an offering, oblation; dedication.
निवेदयिषु: नि-वेदयिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid. of the Caus. without reduplication), wishing to make known or report, intending to relate about.
निवेदित: नि-वेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, made known, announced, reported, communicated, stated, told; represented; delivered, addressed, entrusted, presented, given.
निवेदिन्: नि-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, communicating, reporting, relating, proclaiming.
निवेद्य: 1. नि-वेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be communicated or related; fit to be reported; (अम्), n. an oblation, offering food to an idol, (probably for नैवेद्य।)
2. नि-वेद्य, ind. having respectfully announced or made known.
निविवृत्सत्: निविवृत्सत् नि-विवृत्सत्, नि-विवृत्सु। See p. 504, col. 2.
नि-विवृत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Desid.), wishing to return or desist.
निविश्: निविश् नि-विश्, cl. 6. A. -विशते (ep. also P. -विशति), -वेष्टुम्, to enter; to alight, descend; to sit down, take a seat; to lie down; to settle down, to encamp; to settle, take a wife; to be fixed or intent on (with loc.): Caus. -वेशयति, -यितुम्, to cause to enter, introduce, place in or on; to cause to sit down; to cause to settle or dwell, cause to lie down or encamp; to cause to marry; to put or place down; to found (a city); to enter (in writing), mark down (letters, lines, &c.), inscribe (on a tablet), depict; (with मनस्) to apply the mind to, fix the mind on (with loc.).
निविष्ट: नि-विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, entered, gone in or into; seated, sitting upon; situated or placed in or on, fixed on, intent upon; arranged.
निविष्टि: नि-विष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. entering (a female), copu-lation.
निवेश: नि-वेश, अस्, m. entering, entrance; settling in a place, encamping, halting; dwelling-place, habita-tion; halting-place, place of lying, camp, palace, the residence of a king or general, (निवेशं कृ, to take up one's residence, settle, encamp); depositing, de-livering; founding (a household), settling, marrying, marriage; founding (a town); impression, mark, copy; military array; ornament, dress, decoration. —निवेश-देश, अस्, m. a dwelling-place. —निवेश-वत्, आन्, अती, अत् (at the end of a comp.), lying in or on, resting on.
निवेशन: नि-वेशन, अस्, ई, अम्, entering; placing or laying down, lodging, providing with a resting-place; (अस्), m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi; (अम्), n. entering, entrance; sitting down, encamping, settling, putting or laying down, (निवेशनं कृ, to settle, encamp); entering (in writing), inscribing; founding (a household), mar-rying, marriage; resting-place, habitation, dwelling-place, abode, dwelling, house; a nest; a camp; a town or city; [cf. अ-न्°।]
निवेशनीय: नि-वेशनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be entered; to be fixed; to be engaged in.
निवेशयत्: नि-वेशयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to enter, intro-ducing, sending in or into.
निवेशित: नि-वेशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to enter, introduced; placed in or upon; turned to or towards, fixed upon, directed on; sent into, entered into, engaged in.
निवेशिन्: नि-वेशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, resting in, being in, situated on, lying near; resting on.
निवेश्य: 1. नि-वेश्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be founded (as a town); to be married (as a man); to be returned or paid.
2. नि-वेश्य, ind. having placed in or on, having made to remain or dwell.
निवेष्टव्य: नि-वेष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be married (applied to a man); (अम्), n. to be married, (used impersonally, e. g. महाकुले निवेष्टव्यं सदृशे वा, one should marry into a high family or an equal).
निविशेष: निविशेष नि-विशेष, अस्, आ, अम्, not differ-ent, alike; (अस्), m. want of difference.
निवीत: निवीत नि-वीत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. व्ये with नि), having the sacred Brāhmanical thread suspended round the neck; (अम्), n. wearing the Brāhmanical thread round the neck; the Brāhmanical thread so worn; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a veil, mantle, a wrapper (= नि-वृत).
निवीतिन्: निवीतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing the sacred thread sus-pended round the neck; (ई), m. a Brāhman with the cord so suspended.
निवीर्य: निवीर्य नि-वीर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, impotent (= निर्-वीर्य, q. v.).
निवृ: निवृ नि-वृ, cl. 5. 9. 1. P. A. -वृणोति, -णुते, -वृणाति, -णीते, -वरति, -ते, -वरितुम्, -व-रीतुम्, to surround, defend, restrain: Caus. -वार-यति, -यितुम्, to surround, protect; to keep off, ward off, prohibit, hinder, prevent, hold back from, stop, withhold, forbid, interdict, exclude, obstruct, oppose: Caus. Pass. -वार्यते, to be interdicted, to be withheld.
निवारक: नि-वारक, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off, defending, able to keep off.
निवारण: नि-वारण, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping off, preventing, defending; (अम्), n. keeping back or off, preventing, defending, hindering, opposing; prohibition, an im-pediment; contemning (?).
निवारणीय: नि-वारणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept off or de-fended, to be checked or hindered, &c.
निवारयत्: नि-वारयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, preventing, opposing, hindering.
निवारित: नि-वारित, अस्, आ, अम्, hindered, forbidden, pre-vented, checked, opposed.
निवार्य: 2. नि-वार्य, ind. having suppressed, having for-bidden.
निवार्यमाण: नि-वार्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being prevented or hindered.
निवृत: नि-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, surrounded, enclosed, en-compassed; (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. (= नि-वीत), a veil, a mantle, a wrapper.
निवृज्: निवृज् नि-वृज्, cl. 7. 1. P. -वृणक्ति, -वर्-जति, -वर्जितुम्, Ved. to immerse, drown; to over-throw; to pour out; to extirpate.
निवृत्: निवृत् 1. नि-वृत्, cl. 1. A. (also P. in Fut. Cond. and Aor.) -वर्तते, -वर्तितुम्, to turn back, return, retreat, retire, go back, turn back or away from (with abl.); to recoil; to escape from (with abl.), run away; to cease from, desist from, abstain or refrain from (with abl.); to refuse, decline; to cease; to come to an end, be accomplished; to be finished, stop, set (as the sun); not to occur; to be withheld; to be forbidden; to be reversed; to be occupied or engaged in: Caus. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to cause to return; to bring back; to turn away, keep back from, restrain; to cause to desist; to drive back, repel; to accomplish, perform, bring to an end, (for निर्-वृत्।)
निवर्तक: नि-वर्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, returning, turning or coming back, flying; desisting from, stopping, ceasing; bringing back, causing to cease, abolishing, expelling, removing. —निवर्तक-त्व, अम्, n. the state of one who turns back, &c.
निवर्तन: नि-वर्तन, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back, ceasing, ceas-ing to exist, disappearing; causing to return; (अम्), n. returning, turning or coming back, return; ceasing, not happening, not occurring; desisting or abstaining from (with abl.); desisting from work, inactivity, (opposed to प्र-वर्तन); repenting, reforming; causing to come back, bringing back; turning back (the hair); a means of returning (Ved.); keeping back from (with abl.); a measure of land, 20 rods or 200 cubits or 40,000 Hastas square. —निवर्तन-स्तूप, अस्, m., N. of a Stūpa erected at the spot where the charioteer of Buddha returned.
निवर्तनीय: नि-वर्तनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought back; to be made to turn back, to be kept back or diverted or hindered.
निवर्तमान: नि-वर्तमान, अस्, आ, अम्, turning back, re-turning.
निवर्तयितव्य: नि-वर्तयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back, to be restrained, to be diverted.
निवर्तित: नि-वर्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, turned back or away, brought back, made to desist. —निवर्तित-पूर्व, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has turned away before.
निवर्तितव्य: नि-वर्तितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought back.
निवर्तिन्: नि-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, turning back, returning, flying, (सङ्ग्रामाद् अ-निवर्तिन्, not turning back from the fight, i. e. not flying); leaving off, abstaining from; allowing to return, causing to turn back.
निवर्त्य: नि-वर्त्य, ind. having turned or brought back, having induced to desist; having desisted or refrained from; having repented; having repaid; [cf. दुर्-न्°।]
निविवृत्सु: नि-विवृत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of turning back, wishing to desist.
निवृत्त: नि-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, returned, returning, turned back; gone, departed; vanished; ceased, refrained from, abstained, stopped, desisted, prohibited; abstain-ing from worldly acts, &c.; abstaining, abstracted or abstained from or independent of worldly acts or motives, abstracted from this world, quiet; desisting from or repenting of any improper conduct; finished, completed, whole; (अम्), n. return; [cf. दुर्-न्°।] —निवृत्त-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, without further cause or motive; (अस्), m. a virtuous man, one uninfluenced by worldly desires. —निवृत्त-कृषि-गोरक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from agriculture and the tending of cattle. —निवृत्त-देव-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from sacrificial rites or offerings to the gods. —निवृत्त-मांस, अस्, आ, अम्, one who abstains from eating meat. —निवृत्त-यज्ञ-स्वाध्याय, अस्, आ, अम्, ceasing from sacrifices and the repetition of prayers. —निवृत्त-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, of subdued appetites or passions. —निवृत्त-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, quitting any practice or occupation. —निवृत्त-हृदय, अस्, आ, अम्, with relenting heart. —निवृत्-तात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, m. ‘one whose spirit is ab-stracted,’ a sage; an epithet of Viṣṇu.
निवृत्ति: नि-वृत्ति, इस्, f. returning, return; disappearing, disappearance, ceasing, cessation, suspension, abstain-ing from action, inactivity, (opposed to प्र-वृत्ति); ceasing to be active, ceasing to be valid or binding (as a rule); leaving off, desisting from (with abl.); resigning, discontinuance of worldly acts, cessation of emotions, separation from the world, abstinence; repose, rest; felicity, bliss, beatitude, (wrongly for निर्-वृत्ति); denial, refusal; abolition, prevention; completion; (इस्), m., N. of a son of Vṛṣṇi; of a son of Dharma, king of Magadha; [cf. निर्-वृत्ति, नि-धृति।]
निवृह्: निवृह् नि-वृह् [cf. नि-बृह्], Caus. -वर्ह-यति, -यितुम्, to throw down; to annihilate; to extirpate.
निवर्हित: नि-वर्हित, अस्, आ, अम्, destroyed, annihilated, eradicated.
निवेष्ट: निवेष्ट नि-वेष्ट, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वेष्ट् with नि), a cover, envelope; वसिष्ठस्य निवेष्टस्, N. of a Sāman.
निवेष्टन: नि-वेष्टन, अम्, n. covering, enveloping, clothing.
निवेष्य: निवेष्य नि-वेष्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. विष् with नि), Ved. a whirlpool, a water-spout; a whirlwind or any similar phenomenon [cf. स्तनयित्नु]; a part of the upper or fore-part of an animal, the vertebra?; (according to Mahī-dhara) eddy or hoar-frost; (अस्, आ, अम्), whirling, belonging to a whirlpool or eddy.
निव्याध: निव्याध नि-व्याध, अस्, m. (fr. rt. व्यध् with नि), Ved. an opening, aperture, a window.
निव्याधिन्: नि-व्याधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. piercing, opening.
निव्यूढ: निव्यूढ नि-व्यूढ, अम्, n. perseverance, resolution.
निश्: निश् 1. निश्, euphonically substituted for निस् before च्, छ्, &c.
निश् 2. निश्, cl. 1. P. -नेशति, &c., to meditate upon, meditate profoundly, to be absorbed in meditation.

निश् 3. निश्, f. (perhaps connected with नक् fr. rt. 2. नश्, or merely a curtailed form of निशा below, which may be connected with नि-शीथ and so derived fr. rt. शी with नि; the form निश् is defective in nom. voc. sing. du. and pl., acc. sing. du., but may be optionally substituted for निशा in acc. pl. and remaining cases, e. g. निशस् or निशास्, निशा or निशया, निड्भ्याम् [according to some also निज्भ्याम्] or निशाभ्याम्, &c.), night; निशि निशि, every night; महा-निशि, at midnight.
निश: निश, अम्, n. (at the end of a comp.) = निशा, night (e. g. अहर्-निशम्, ind. day and night; दिवा-निशम्, ind. day and night; cf. also अ-निश।)
निशा: निशा, f. night; a vision, dream; turmeric, Cur-cuma (of two species, = हरिद्रा and दारु-हरिद्रा, probably C. Zedoaria and C. Longa; a collective N. of the asterisms Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius, and Capricorn; cf. निशा-बल।) —निशा-कर, अस्, m. ‘the night-maker,’ the moon, (regarded with दिवा-कर as a son of Garuḍa); a symbolical expression for the numeral one; a cock. —निशा-कर-कला-मौलि, इस्, m. ‘bearing a crescent as diadem,’ an epithet of Śiva. —निशा-काल, अस्, m. the time of night. —निशा-केतु, उस्, m. ‘night-sign,’ the moon. —निशा-क्षय, अस्, m. the close of night. —निशा-गण, अस्, m. a number of nights. —निशा-गम (°शा-आग्°), अस्, m. the coming on or com-mencement of night. —निशा-गृह, अस्, m. a bed-room, sleeping-room. —निशा-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, going or moving about by night, nocturnal, night-walking; (अस्), m. a Rākṣasa, a fiend, an imp or goblin; an epithet of Śiva [cf. निशाचर-पति]; a jackal; an owl; a snake; the ruddy goose, Cakra-vāka; a thief; a ghost, an evil spirit; (ई), f. a she-devil, a female fiend; a woman who goes to an as-signation, a harlot, whore; a sort of perfume, (see केशिनी।) —निशाचर-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of night-walkers,’ an epithet of Śiva. —निशाचरेश (°र-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of the Rākṣasas,’ an epithet of Rāvaṇa. —निशा-चर्मन्, अ, n. ‘the skin of night,’ darkness. —निशा-छद, अस्, m. a species of plant. —निशा-जल, अम्, n. ‘the water of night,’ hoar-frost, frost, dew. —निशाट (°शा-अट), अस्, m. ‘roving by night,’ an owl; a demon, a ghost. —निशाटक, अस्, m. bdellium (= गुग्गुलु, connected with नि-शाट, an owl; cf. कौशिक, = owl and bdellium, उलूखल, उलूखलक). —निशाटन (°शा-अट्°), अस्, m. ‘night-rover,’ an owl; (ई), f. a species of moth. —निशातिक्रम (°शा-अत्°), अस्, m. the passing away of night. —निशात्यय (°शा-अत्°), अस्, m. the close of night, day-break. —निशा-दर्शिन्, ई, m. ‘seeing at night,’ an owl. —निशादि (°शा-आदि), इस्, f. the begin-ning of night, evening, twilight. —निशाधीश (°शा-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon. —निशा-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon. —निशा-नारायण, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —निशा-निशम्, ind. night by night, every night, always. —१। नि-शान्त (°शा-अन्°), अस्, अम्, m. n. (for 2. नि-शान्त see under नि-शम्, p. 505, col. 1), the end of night, break of day. —निशान्ध (°शा-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blind at night; (आ), f. a species of creeper (= जतुका). —निशा-पति, इस्, m. ‘husband of the night,’ the moon; camphor. —निशा-पुत्र, आस्, m. pl. ‘the sons of night,’ N. of certain demons. —निशा-पुष्प, अस्, m. ‘the flower of night,’ the white water-lily; hoar-frost, dew. —निशा-प्राणे-श्वर, अस्, m. ‘husband of night,’ the moon. —निशा-बल, अस्, m. a collective N. of the signs of the zodiac Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagit-tarius, and Capricorn. —निशा-भङ्गा, f. a species of plant (= दुग्ध-पुच्छी). —निशा-मणि, इस्, m. ‘jewel of the night,’ the moon; [cf. ध्वजाग्र-निशामणि।] —निशा-मुख, अम्, n. the beginning of night. —निशा-मृग, अस्, m. ‘night-animal,’ a jackal. —१। निशा-रण, अम्, n. a nocturnal battle; (for 2. see नि-शरण below.) —निशा-रत्न, अम्, n. (or, according to some, अस् m.), ‘the jewel of the night,’ the moon. —निशार्धकाल (°शा-अर्ध-क्°), अस्, m. the first part of the night (opposed to the following). —निशावसान (°शा-अव्°), अम्, n. the close or end of night, the second part of the night (opposed to the preceding). —निशा-विहार, अस्, m. a night-walker, a nocturnal imp or goblin, a Rākṣasa. —निशा-वृन्द, अम्, n. a number of nights. —निशा-वेदिन्, ई, m. ‘knowing the night,’ a cock. —निशा-हस, अस्, m. ‘night-smiler,’ the white water-lily which opens its petals at night. —निशाह्वा (°शा-आह्°), f. turmeric. —निशि-पाल, अस्, m. a kind of metre consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each. —निशि-पुष्पा or निशि-पुष्पी or निशिपुष्-पिका, f. the tree Nyctanthes Arbor Tristis. —निशेश (°श-ईश), अस्, m. ‘lord of night,’ the moon. —नि-शैत (°श-एत), अस्, m. ‘shining at night,’ the crane, Ardea Nivea. —निशोत्सर्ग (°शा-उत्°), अस्, m. the end of night, day-break. —निशोपशाय (°शा-उप्°), अस्, m. resting at night.
निशठ: निशठ नि-शठ, अस्, आ, अम्, not false, candid, honest; (अस्), m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi, a son of Bala-rāma by Revatī; (also written नि-षठ, नि-सठ, नि-सथ।)
निशद्: निशद् नि-शद्, Caus. -शातयति, -यितुम्, Ved. to kill.
निशब्द: निशब्द नि-शब्द, अस्, आ, अम्, speechless, silent; [cf. निः-शब्द।]
निशम्: निशम् नि-शम्, cl. 4. P. -शाम्यति, -शमितुम्, to observe, see; to hear, listen: Caus. -शामयति, -यितुम्, to observe, perceive, see; to hear, listen.
निशमन: नि-शमन, अम्, n. looking at; seeing, sight; hearing; becoming aware of.
निशम्य: नि-शम्य, ind. having perceived, having heard, hearing.
निशान्त: 2. नि-शान्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. निशान्त see under निशा, p. 504, col. 3), tranquillized, quiet, tranquil, patient; (अम्), n. a house, dwelling, habitation. —निशान्त-नारी, f. a house-wife.
निशान्तीय: निशान्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to a house (?).
निशामन: नि-शामन, अम्, n. sight, seeing; looking at, beholding; looking at repeatedly; observing, hearing; a shadow, reflection.
निशामयत्: नि-शामयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, perceiving, hearing.
निशाम्य: नि-शाम्य, ind. having seen; having heard; having tranquillized; having put out (as a light).
निशरण: निशरण नि-शरण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. शॄ with नि), killing, slaughter.
निशारण: 2. नि-शारण, अम्, n. (fr. शॄ with नि), killing, slaughter, slaying.
निशारुक: नि-शारुक, अस्, m. a kind of Rūpaka (see under दृढ); (अम्), n. an air, a sort of musical compo-sition played as an accompaniment to dancing.
निशात: निशात नि-शात। See under नि-शो, col. 2.
नि-शात, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened, whetted, sharp; polished, burnished, varnished.
निशाद: निशाद नि-शाद, अस्, m. a man of low caste; (see निषाद।) —निशाद-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of a man of low caste. —निशादा-पुत्र, अस्, m. (?), a pestle. —निशादा-शिला, f. a mortar, a slab for grinding.
निशामय: निशामय नि-शामय = शृणु, listen, (impv. of Caus. of नि-शम्, col. 1.)
निशायिन्: निशायिन् नि-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. rt. शी with नि), lying down in, sleeping in (?).
निशावन: निशावन निशावन, अस्, m. hemp. See शण।
निशि: निशि नि-शि [cf. नि-शो], cl. 5. P. A. -शिनोति, -नुते, -शेतुम्, to sharpen; to stimulate, excite; to kill.
निशित: नि-शित, अस्, आ, अम्, sharpened, whetted, pointed, stimulated; (अम्), n. iron.
निशिति: नि-शिति, इस्, f., Ved. excitement, stimulation, en-couragement.
निशिता: निशिता नि-शिता, f., Ved. night; [cf. नि-शीथ।]
निशिथ: निशिथ नि-शिथ, अस्, m. (for नि-शीथ), N. of one of the three sons of Doṣā (Night); (some read this word in Bhāgavata-Purāṇa IV. 13, 14, नि-शीथ।)
निशीथ: निशीथ नि-शीथ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शी with नि), midnight, the time of sleep, night in general.
निशीथिनी: नि-शीथिनी, f. night. —निशीथिनी-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘husband of night,’ the moon.
निशुम्भ: निशुम्भ नि-शुम्भ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. शुम्भ् with नि), killing, slaughter; N. of a Dānava, brother of Śumbha, slain by Durgā; (also written नि-सुम्भ।) —निशुम्भ-मथनी, f. or निशुम्भ-मर्दिनी, f. ‘destroyer of Niśumbha,’ an epithet of Durgā.
निशुम्भन: नि-शुम्भन, अम्, n. killing, slaying, slaughter.
निशुम्भिन्: नि-शुम्भिन्, ई, m. an epithet of Vajra-ṭīka; an inferior deity of the Buddhists.
निशुष्म: निशुष्म नि-शुष्म, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not sparkling (as fire), not coruscating, (opposed to उच्-छुष्म।)
निशृम्भ: निशृम्भ नि-शृम्भ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. श्रम्भ् with नि), Ved. stepping firmly?; (Sāy.) fastened to (a car), harnessed.
निशैत: निशैत निशैत। See under निशा, col. 1.
निशो: निशो नि-शो [cf. नि-शि], cl. 4. P. -श्यति, -शातुम्, to sharpen, whet, polish.
निशान: नि-शान, अम्, n. sharpening; (also read नि-शाण।)
निश्चक्षुस्: निश्चक्षुस् निश्-चक्षुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, eyeless, blind.
निश्चत्: निश्चत् निश्-चत् (निस्-चत्), Caus. A. -चात-यते, -यितुम्, Ved. to scare or drive away.
निश्चत्वारिंश: निश्चत्वारिंश निश्-चत्वारिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, with-out forty.
निश्चप्रच: निश्चप्रच निश्च-प्रच, (perhaps) backwards and forwards; [cf. आच-पराच under 2. आच।]
निश्चर्: निश्चर् निश्-चर् (निस्-चर्), cl. 1. P. -चरति, -चरितुम्, to come forth, issue, go out, arise, pro-ceed, appear, be produced; to rise (as sounds): Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to issue or come forth.
निश्चर: निश्-चर, अस्, m., N. of one of the Saptarṣis in the eleventh Manv-antara.
निश्चारक: निश्-चारक, अम्, n. evacuation by stool; air, wind; obstinacy, wilfulness.
निश्चल: निश्चल निश्-चल, अस्, आ, अम्, immovable, not moving, stock-still, still, fixed, steady; not subject to motion or fluctuation, invariable, un-changeable; (आ), f. the earth; Desmodium Gange-ticum (= शाल-पर्णी). —निश्चल-मति, इस्, इस्, इ, steady-minded, of unshaken mind. —निश्चलाङ्ग (°ल-अङ्°), अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having immovable limbs, firm-bodied, firm; (अस्), m. a species of crane, Ardea Nivea; a rock, mountain.
निश्चि: निश्चि निश्-चि (निस्-चि, see rt. 2. चि), cl. 3. P. -चिकेति, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते, -चेतुम्, Ved. to ascertain, investigate, know thoroughly, arrive at a certain decision, decide, regard as decided, to fix upon, determine, resolve.
निश्चय: निश्-चय, अस्, m. ascertainment, investigation, inquiry, a fixed opinion, a firm conviction, accurate or certain knowledge, certainty, positiveness, positive conclusion, determination, resolution, resolve, decision; settled purpose, fixed intention, design, purpose, aim, (इति निश्चयः, this is a fixed opinion or established conclusion; निश्चयं ज्ञातुम्, to ascertain the cer-tainty; निश्चयं कृ, to decide, come to a deter-mination; cf. पाप-न्°, मरण-न्°, एक-न्°); ‘re-moval of fallacy or deception,’ N. of a figure in rhetoric; (एन or आत्), ind. certainly. —निश्चय-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a merchant. —निश्चय-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, having (only) the appearance of cer-tainty, uncertain, wrong.
निश्चयिन्: निश्-चयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, decided, determined, resolved.
निश्चायक: निश्-चायक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what ascertains or determines, one who is certain about anything, determining, decisive.
निश्चित: निश्-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, ascertained, determined, settled, concluded, decided, established, certain, one who has come to a conclusion or formed a fixed opinion; sentenced, pronounced; (अम्), n. certainty, decision, conclusion; (अम्), ind. decidedly, positively; (आ), f., N. of a river.
निश्चिति: निश्-चिति, इस्, f. ascertainment, fixing, determining, settling.
निश्चित्य: निश्-चित्य, ind. having ascertained, having con-cluded or decided, having made out for certain, having settled or come to a final decision, feeling assured or convinced.
निश्चीयमान: निश्-चीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the course of ascertainment, being under investigation, being con-cluded.
निश्चित्त: निश्चित्त निश्-चित्त, अस्, m., N. of a Samādhi.
निश्चिन्त: निश्चिन्त निश्-चिन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, unthinking, thoughtless, inconsiderate, void of reflection, careless, unconcerned; [cf. नैश्चिन्त्य।]
निश्चुक्कण: निश्चुक्कण निश्-चुक्कण, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. चुक्क्), a sort of tooth-powder prepared from sulphate of iron &c. which destroys the tartar but blackens the teeth; (also written निश्-चुक्वण।)
निश्चृत्: निश्चृत् निश्-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्, Ved. to loosen, untie.
निश्चेतन: निश्चेतन निश्-चेतन, अस्, आ, अम्, without consciousness, unconscious, unreasonable.
निश्चेतस्: निश्चेतस् निश्-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, out of one's mind, not in one's right senses.
निश्चेष्ट: निश्चेष्ट निश्-चेष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, motionless, powerless, helpless; incapable of motion or effort; (अम्), ind. without motion.
निश्चेष्टा: निश्-चेष्टा, f. motionlessness. —निश्चेष्टा-क-रण, अस्, आ, अम्, causing motionlessness; epithet of one of the arrows of the god of love.
निश्चौर: निश्चौर निश्-चौर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from robbers.
निश्च्यवन: निश्च्यवन निश्-च्यवन, अस्, m. ‘unperish-ing,’ a form of fire; N. of one of the Saptarṣis in the second Manv-antara.
निश्छन्दस्: निश्छन्दस् निश्-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, not studying holy writ; निश्छन्दः कुलम्, a family in which the Vedas are not studied.
निश्छिद्र: निश्छिद्र निश्-छिद्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having no rent or openings, without holes, having no holes, without weak points or defects, having no weak side; unhurt, uninterrupted.
निश्छेद: निश्-छेद, अस्, आ, अम्, indivisible, without division.
निश्रथ्य: निश्रथ्य नि-श्रथ्य, ind. having fastened or harnessed.
निश्रम: निश्रम नि-श्रम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्रम् with नि), labour bestowed upon anything, continued practice.
निश्रयणी: निश्रयणी नि-श्रयणी, f. (fr. rt. श्रि with नि), a ladder, staircase; (also written निः-श्रयणी, निः-श्रयिणी, q. v.)
निश्रेणी: नि-श्रेणी, f. a ladder, staircase; (other forms of the word are नि-श्रेणि, f., निः-श्रेणी, and निः-श्रेणि, q. v.)
निश्रीक: निश्रीक नि-श्रीक for निः-श्रीक, q. v.
निश्वस्: निश्वस् नि-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति, -श्वसितुम्, to draw in the breath, inspire; to sigh.
निश्वस्य: नि-श्वस्य, ind. having drawn in the breath, having sighed.
निश्वास: नि-श्वास, अस्, m. inspiration, inhaling, sighing. —निश्वास-प्रश्वास, औ, m. du. inspiration and expiration, respiration.
निष्: निष् 1. निष्, euphonically substituted for निस् before क्, ख्, ट्, &c.
निष् 2. निष् [cf. rt. निक्ष्], cl. 1. P. नेषति, &c., to moisten, sprinkle.
निषङ्ग: निषङ्ग नि-षङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सञ्ज् with नि), clinging to, attachment; union, meeting, associ-ation; a quiver; a sword (?).
निषङ्गथि: नि-षङ्गथि, इस्, इस्, इ, embracing; (इस्), m. embracing, an embrace [cf. स्वञ्ज्]; a bowman; a charioteer; a car; grass; the shoulder. —निषङ्ग-धि, इस्, m., Ved. (according to commentators) the sheath of a sword, a scabbard.
निषङ्गिन्: निषङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a quiver; (ई), m. an archer, bowman; N. of one of the hundred sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
निषञ्ज: निषञ्ज नि-षञ्ज in कु-न्°, q. v.
निषद्: निषद् 1. नि-षद् (नि-सद्), cl. 1. 6. P. -षी-दति, -षत्तुम्, to sit down, lie down, recline; to settle down, sink down; to dwell; to be afflicted, suffer pain: Caus. -षादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sit down.
2. नि-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. sitting inactive; (त्), f. sitting, especially near the altar at a sacrificial rite; N. of a kind of composition mentioned with Upa-niṣad in Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 1613.
निषण्ण: नि-षण्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, seated, sitting, perched, placed in or on, rested, reclined, resting or leaning on, reclining; supported; sunk down, afflicted, dis-tressed; gone to.
निषण्णक: नि-षण्णक, अस्, आ, अम्, sitting, seated; (अम्), n. a seat; a species of pot-herb, Marsilea Dentata.
निषत्ति: नि-षत्ति, इस्, f., Ved. sitting down idly, remaining inactive or indifferent, indolence.
निषत्स्नु: नि-षत्स्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. sitting fast, firmly settled or fixed.
निषद: नि-षद, अस्, m., N. of an ancient king, (probably a wrong reading for निषध); = नि-षाद, a musical note.
निषदन: नि-षदन, अम्, n., Ved. sitting down, reclining; dwelling, residing; a seat.
निषद्या: नि-षद्या, f. a small bed or couch; the hall of a merchant; a market-place.
निषद्वर: नि-षद्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. seated (near the altar), sitting lazily; (अस्), m. mud, mire (in which one sinks); the god of love; (ई), f. ‘the time of rest,’ night.
निषाद: नि-षाद, अस्, m., N. of certain wild aboriginal tribes in India not belonging to the Āryan race, and described as hunters, fishermen, robbers, &c.; (ac-cording to Mahī-dhara) a N. of the Bhillas (a wild mountain tribe whose progenitor is said by a legend to have sprung from the thigh of Vena); a man of a degraded tribe in general, an outcast (especially the son of a Brāhman by a Śūdra woman); the first of the seven musical notes or more properly the last or highest of the scale, corresponding to B of our scale; N. of a Kalpa; [cf. नैषाद, नैषादक, नैषादिका, नैषादि।] —निषाद-कर्षु, उस्, m., N. of a district; [cf. नैषाद-कर्षुक।] —निषाद-वत्, n., N. of a musical note, = B of our scale.
निषादित: नि-षादित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), made to sit down; afflicted.
निषादिन्: नि-षादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sitting down, lying down, re-clining, resting; (ई), m. an elephant-keeper or driver.
निषीदत्: नि-षीदत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sitting down, sitting on; settling or sinking down; resting in or on.
निषेदिवस्: नि-षेदिवस्, वान्, दुषी, वत्, seated in or upon, reclined.
निषध: निषध निषध, अस्, m., N. of a mountain or chain of mountains forming one of the principal ranges of the earth, and described as lying immedi-ately south of Ilāvṛta and north of the Himālaya; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people and their country governed by Nala; the sovereign of the Niṣadhas; N. of a son of Janam-ejaya; of Kuśa the father of Nala; a peculiar position of the closed hand; a musical note [cf. नि-षाद]; (अस्, आ, अम्), hard, solid; (आ), f., N. of Nala's capital, the city of the Niṣadhas; N. of a river rising in the Vindhya mountains. —निषध-वंश, अस्, m. the race of Niṣadha. —निषधाधिप (°ध-अध्°), अस्, m. or निषधाधिपति (°ध-अध्°), इस्, m. or निष-धेश्वर (°ध-ईश्°), अस्, m. ‘lord of Niṣadha,’ epithet of Nala; [cf. नैषध, नैषध्य।] —निषधाश्व (°ध-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a son of Kuru. —निषधेन्द्र-काव्य, अम्, n. ‘the poem of the prince of the Niṣadhas,’ N. of a poem.
निषमम्: निषमम् नि-षमम्, ind. (fr. नि + सम), see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 121, Schol.
निषर्ग: निषर्ग नि-षर्ग, अस्, m. a various reading for नि-षङ्ग, q. v.
निषिच्: निषिच् नि-षिच् (नि-सिच्), cl. 6. P. A. -षिञ्चति, -ते, -षेक्तुम्, to sprinkle, pour upon or into, infuse, instil, irrigate: Caus. -षेचयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sprinkle or irrigate.
निषिक्त: नि-षिक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled upon, poured into, infused, instilled, irrigated. —निषिक्त-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. protecting the infused (semen).
निषेक: नि-षेक, अस्, m. sprinkling, infusion, aspersion; distilling; effusion; seminal infusion, impregnation; the ceremony performed upon impregnation; irriga-tion; water for washing, (but according to others) seminal impurity; what is poured upon the ground, dirty water, swill.
निषेक्तव्य: नि-षेक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sprinkled or poured into, to be watered.
निषेचन: नि-षेचन, अम्, n., Ved. pouring out, sprinkling, watering, irrigation.
निषेचितृ: नि-षेचितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sprinkles or pours into, an instiller, infuser.
निषिध्: निषिध् नि-षिध् (नि-सिध्), cl. 1. P. -षे-धति, -षेद्धुम्, -षेधितुम्, to prohibit, forbid, restrain, keep off, ward off, keep back, prevent, remove: Caus. -षेधयति, -यितुम्, to prohibit, keep off.
निषिद्ध: नि-षिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, prohibited, forbidden, kept back, restrained, warded off, prevented.
निषिद्धि: नि-षिद्धि, इस्, f. prohibition, warding off, keep-ing off, defence.
निषेद्धव्य: नि-षेद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back or obstructed.
निषेद्धृ: नि-षेद्धृ, धा, ध्री, धृ, keeping back, obstructing, who or what restrains or prevents or prohibits.
निषेद्ध्र: नि-षेद्ध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, in अ-निषेद्ध्र, having no impeder or subduer.
निषेध: नि-षेध, अस्, m. warding off, keeping off, hin-dering, stopping, obstructing, prevention, prohibition; negation, denial; discontinuance, contrariety to or deviation from rule, exception; N. of several Sāmans.
निषेधक: नि-षेधक, अस्, आ, अम्, keeping back, obstruct-ing, preventing, prohibiting, forbidding.
निषेधन: नि-षेधन, अम्, n. the act of warding off or defending, prevention.
निषेधिन्: नि-षेधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, defending, keeping back; excelling, surpassing.
निषेध्य: नि-षेध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be kept back or pro-hibited or hindered.
निषिध: निषिध नि-षिध, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people; (various reading for निषध; cf. नै-षिध।)
निषूद्: निषूद् नि-षूद् (नि-सूद्), Caus. -षूदयति, -यितुम्, to kill, slay.
निषूदन: नि-षूदन, अम्, n. killing, slaughter; [cf. नि-सूदन।]
निषेव्: निषेव् नि-षेव् (नि-सेव्), cl. 1. A. -षेवते, -षेवितुम्, to wait upon, serve, attend, follow; attach or devote one's self to; to honour, worship, adore; to pursue, practise, perform, observe, cultivate; to frequent, inhabit, visit; to enjoy; to employ.
निषेव: नि-षेव, अस्, आ, अम्, practising, exercising, fol-lowing, devoted to [cf. ह्री-न्°]; (आ), f. exercising, practice, service; worship, adoration.
नि-षेव; add — (अस्), m. honouring, honour, worship, respect, esteem.
निषेवक: नि-षेवक, अस्, आ, अम्, practising, following, devoted to; frequenting, inhabiting; enjoying.
निषेवण: नि-षेवण, अम्, n. waiting on, serving, service, attaching one's self to, worshipping, worship, adora-tion; practice, performance, adherence to; living in, inhabiting, enjoying, using, use, familiarity with.
निषेवणीय: नि-षेवणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be served or attended to, to be followed or observed; to be obeyed.
निषेवित: नि-षेवित, अस्, आ, अम्, visited, frequented; ob-served, practised; served, honoured, obeyed.
