निषेवितव्य: नि-षेवितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be practised or observed; to be used or enjoyed; (also read नि-सेवितव्य।)
निषेवितृ: नि-षेवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who attaches or devotes himself to anything, an observer, practiser, cultivator, &c.
निषेविन्: नि-षेविन्, ई, इणी, इ, practising, observing, enjoying.
निषेव्य: नि-षेव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be observed, to be honoured, to be visited or frequented; to be enjoyed.
निष्क्: निष्क् निष्क् (probably a Nominal verb artificially formed fr. निष्क below), cl. 10. A. निष्कयते, &c., to measure, weigh.
निष्क: निष्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. सद् with preposition नि and affix क), a golden ornament for the neck or breast; a golden ornament of a certain weight, used as money; a weight of gold varying in value at different times, = 1 Dīnāra of 32 small or 16 large Rettis, = 1 Karṣa or Su-varṇa of 16 Māṣas, = 1 Pāla of 4 or 5 Su-varṇas, = 1 larger Pāla or Dīnāra variously reckoned at 108 or 150 Su-varṇas, = 4 Māṣas, = 16 Drammas; a weight of silver of 4 Su-varṇas; gold in general, a golden vessel; (अस्), m. a Cāṇḍāla; (आ), f. a measure of length; [cf. नैष्किक, नैष्कशतिक, नैष्क-सहस्रिक।] —निष्क-कण्ठ, अस्, ई, अम्, wearing a golden ornament round the neck; (अम्), n. a golden ornament of the neck. —निष्क-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wearing a gold ornament round the neck.
निष्किन्: निष्किन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. having an ornament round the neck.
निष्कण्टक: निष्कण्टक निष्-कण्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, = अ-कण्टक, thornless, free from thorns or enemies; free from danger or trouble.
निष्कण्ठ: निष्कण्ठ निष्-कण्ठ, अस्, m. a species of tree, Capparis Trifoliata.
निष्कनिष्ठ: निष्कनिष्ठ निष्-कनिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, or निष्कनिष्ठक, अस्, आ, अम्, having the little finger stretched out.
निष्कन्द: निष्कन्द निष्-कन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, without edible or esculent roots, having no bulbous roots.
निष्कपट: निष्कपट निष्-कपट, अस्, आ, अम्, guileless, free from deceit or fraud.
निष्कम्प: निष्कम्प निष्-कम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, not shaking, not tremulous, motionless, immovable. —निष्कम्-प-ता, f. motionlessness, immovableness.
निष्कम्भ: निष्कम्भ नि-ष्कम्भ in वज्र-निष्कम्भ, अस्, m., N. of one of the sons of Garuḍa.
निष्कम्भु: नि-ष्कम्भु, उस्, m., N. of a particular divine being (= Viśva).
निष्करुण: निष्करुण निष्-करुण, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiless, unmerciful, merciless, cruel. —निष्करुणी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, rendered pitiless, made or become heart-less or cruel.
निष्करूष: निष्करूष निष्-करूष, अस्, आ, अम्, not dirty, free from dirt.
निष्कर्तृ: निष्कर्तृ निष्-कर्तृ, ता, m., Ved. = इष्-कर्तृ, p. 143, col. 1.
निष्कर्मन्: निष्कर्मन् निष्-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, inactive; exempt from or neglecting religious or worldly acts, &c.
निष्कर्ष: निष्कर्ष निष्-कर्ष, &c. See under निष्-कृष्, col. 3.
निष्-कर्ष, अस्, m. drawing out, extracting; the essence of anything, chief point, main point; measur-ing; certainty, ascertainment; (आत्), ind. succinctly.
निष्कल: निष्कल निष्-कल, अस्, आ, अम्, without parts, undivided, indivisible; waned, diminished, decayed; impotent, seedless, barren; maimed, in-firm; (अस्), m. a receptacle; pudendum muliebre; N. of Brahmā; a fancied personification of Brahmā for religious ceremonies; (आ or ई), f. an elderly woman past childbearing or in whom menstruation has ceased. —निष्कल-त्व, अम्, n. undividedness, indi-visibility, the state of the absolute Brahma.
निष्कलङ्क: निष्कलङ्क निष्-कलङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, stainless, spotless, sinless, immaculate, unblemished. —निष्क-लङ्क-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place.
निष्कल्मष: निष्कल्मष निष्-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, spot-less, sinless. —निष्कल्मषी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become spotless or sinless.
निष्कषाय: निष्कषाय निष्-कषाय, अस्, आ, अम्, free from dirt or impure passions; (अस्), m., N. of the thirteenth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī.
निष्कस्: निष्कस् निष्-कस् (निस्-कस्; sometimes in-correctly spelt निष्-कश्), Caus. -कासयति, -यितुम्, to drive out, expel, turn out.
निष्कास: निष्-कास, अस्, m. exit, egress; a portico, veranda, (wrongly spelt निष्-काश); the day-break; waning, disappearance; (also a wrong reading for निष्-काष, q. v.)
निष्कासित: निष्-कासित, अस्, आ, अम्, expelled, dismissed, turned out; gone forth or out, issued; placed, de-posited; placed over, appointed, stationed; reviled, reproached; opened out, blown, expanded.
निष्कासिन्: निष्-कासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, who or what expels; (इनी), f. a female slave not restrained by her master.
निष्काम: निष्काम निष्-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, desireless, free from wish or desire, disinterested, unselfish; (अम्), ind. without wish or desire; unwillingly. —निष्काम-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, acting disinterestedly or without desire, unselfish in one's conduct.
निष्कारण: निष्कारण निष्-कारण, अस्, आ, अम्, cause-less, needless, unnecessary; free from motive, disinter-ested, groundless, without a reason, not proceeding from any cause; (अम्), ind. without any special motive, without a reason, causelessly, without any secondary view; [cf. नि-कारण।] —निष्कारण-वैरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, groundlessly hostile.
निष्-कारण, अम्, n. removing, taking away, doing away; killing, slaughter.
निष्कारुष: निष्कारुष निष्-कारुष, अस्, आ, अम्, of a noble race, not degraded (?).
निष्कालक: निष्कालक निष्-कालक, अस्, m. a penitent shaven and smeared with ghee or clarified butter.
निष्कालन: निष्कालन निष्-कालन, अस्, m. (fr. कल् with निस्), driving away (cattle).
निष्कालिक: निष्कालिक निष्-कालिक, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has no more time (to live), one whose time is over or whose term of life is elapsed; (अम्), ind. without delay.
निष्काश: निष्काश निष्-काश, अस्, m. issue, egress; a portico, veranda; [cf. निष्-कास।]
निष्काशित: निष्-काशित, अस्, आ, अम्। See निष्-कासित, col. 1.
निष्काष: निष्काष निष्-काष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. कष् with निस्), Ved. the scrapings from a caldron or pan; (also written निष्-कास।)
निष्किञ्चन: निष्किञ्चन निष्-किञ्चन, अस्, आ, अम्, having nothing, very poor. —निष्किञ्चन-त्व, अम्, n. poverty, indigence.
निष्किरीय: निष्किरीय निष्-किरीय, आस्, m. pl. (fr. निष्-किर, which is fr. rt. 1. कॄ with निस्), N. of a race.
निष्किल्विष: निष्किल्विष निष्-किल्विष, अस्, आ, अम्, sin-less, faultless; [cf. नि-किल्बिष।]
निष्कुट: निष्कुट निष्-कुट, अस्, m. a pleasure-grove near a house, (in this sense also अम्, n.); a field; the hollow of a tree [cf. निष्-कुह]; a door; the female apartments, Zenana; N. of a country (?); (अम्), n., N. of a hole of a peculiar form in the frame of a bedstead; (also read निः-कुह।)
निष्कुटि: निष्-कुटि, इस्, ई, f. large cardamoms; [cf. निस्-त्रुटी।]
निष्कुटिका: निष्कुटिका, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Śiva.
निष्कुतूहल: निष्कुतूहल निष्-कुतूहल, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing no curiosity, incurious.
निष्कुम्भ: निष्कुम्भ निष्-कुम्भ, अस्, m. = नि-कुम्भ, Croton Polyandrum; (आ), f., N. of the mother of the Magas.
निष्कुल: निष्कुल निष्-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, having no family or kindred, left alone in the world; निष्-कुलं कृ, to make (any one) without family, cut off entirely, exterminate. —निष्कुल-ता, f. loss of family, dying out, perishing. —निष्कुला-कृ or निष्कुली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to extir-minate one's family; to strip off the husk, to husk, shell. —निष्कुला-कृत्य, ind. having stripped off the husk; (also read निःकुला-कृत्य।) —निष्कुली-कृत्य, ind. having husked or shelled; (also read निःकुली-कृत्य।)
निष्कुलीन: निष्-कुलीन, अस्, आ, अम्, of low family, plebeian.
निष्कुष्: निष्कुष् निष्-कुष् (निस्-कुष्), cl. 9. P. -कुष्णाति, -कोषितुम् and -कोष्टुम्, to pull off or out, strip off, tear off or out, extract; to injure or hurt by tearing; to husk, shell.
निष्कुषित: निष्-कुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn off, stripped off, extracted, forced or drawn out, torn, lacerated; ex-pelled; (अस्), m., N. of a Marut; (also read निष्-कर्षिन्।)
निष्कोष: निष्-कोष, अस्, m. tearing out, stripping off the husk, shelling.
निष्कोषण: निष्-कोषण, अम्, n. tearing off or out, strip-ping off, drawing out, extracting, extirpating; taking away, husking, shelling.
निष्कोषणक: निष्-कोषणक, अस्, आ, अम्, fit for picking, used as a picker, serving for a tooth-pick.
निष्कोषितव्य: निष्-कोषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be stripped off or extracted, to be forced or drawn out; to be taken away; to be expelled.
निष्कुह: निष्कुह निष्-कुह, अस्, m. = निष्-कुट, the hollow of a tree.
निष्कूज: निष्कूज निष्-कूज, अस्, आ, अम्, noiseless, soundless.
निष्कूट: निष्कूट निष्-कूट, अस्, आ, अम्, free from deceit or fraud, guileless.
निष्कृ: निष्कृ निष्-कृ (निस्-कृ), cl. 8. P. A. -क-रोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to bring out, extract (Ved.); to take away, do away, remove, expel, exclude, drive away; to break in pieces, destroy; to prepare, equip, arrange, accomplish, finish; to absolve, acquit; to restore, cure.
निष्कृत: निष्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done away, taken away, removed, expelled; absolved, pardoned, acquitted; disregarded; (अम्), n. expiation, atonement; a fixed place, place of rendezvous.
निष्कृति: निष्-कृति, इस्, f. expiation, atonement; absolution, pardon; acquittance, compensation, discharge of a debt or obligation; removal, doing away; restoration, cure; escaping from, avoiding; disregarding, neglect-ing; (Niṣkṛti personified is a sister of Lobha and daughter of Dambha by Māyā); bad conduct, roguery, (various reading for नि-कृति); (इस्), m. a form of Agni.
निष्कृत्: निष्कृत् निष्-कृत् (निस्-कृत्), cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्, to cut off, to cut out; to divide, separate; to cut through, hew asunder, massacre; to loosen.
निष्कृप: निष्कृप निष्-कृप, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiless, mer-ciless, cruel.
निष्कृष्: निष्कृष् निष्-कृष् (निस्-कृष्), cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्ष्टुम् and -क्रष्टुम्, to draw out, extract; to tear out, tear in pieces, rend asunder; Caus. -कर्षयति, -यितुम्, to tear in pieces, destroy, annihilate.
निष्कर्षण: निष्-कर्षण, अम्, n. drawing out, extracting; pulling off, drawing off, taking off; deducting.
निष्कर्षिन्: निष्-कर्षिन्, ई, m., N. of one of the Maruts.
निष्कृष्ट: निष्-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn forth, pulled out, extracted.
निष्केवल: निष्केवल निष्-केवल, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging exclusively.
निष्केवल्य: निष्-केवल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging exclusively; N. of a particular Uktha (q. v.) connected with the midday oblation and belonging to Indra exclusively.
निष्कैवल्य: निष्कैवल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, mere, pure, absolute.
निष्कौरव: निष्कौरव निष्-कौरव, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of or freed from the Kauravas.
निष्कौशाम्बि: निष्कौशाम्बि निष्-कौशाम्बि, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has left Kauśāmbī.
निष्क्रम्: निष्क्रम् निष्-क्रम् (निस्-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, -क्रमितुम् or -क्रामितुम्, to go out, come forth, go from home, depart; to make an exit from the stage: Caus. -क्रामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go out or depart, to drive out, expel, to deliver.
निष्क्रम: निष्-क्रम, अस्, m. going out, coming forth; departing from (with abl.); exit; degradation, loss of caste, inferiority of tribe, family, &c.; any intel-lectual faculty (as intelligence, attention, comprehen-sion, &c.).
निष्क्रमण: निष्-क्रमण, अम्, n. going forth or out; taking a child for the first time out of the house in the fourth month after birth to see the sun, (considered as an essential ceremony, Manu II. 34.)
निष्क्रमणिका: निष्-क्रमणिका, f. the ceremony of taking a child out of the house for the first time in its fourth month to see the sun.
निष्क्रमणित: निष्-क्रमणित, अस्, आ, अम्, a child taken out for the first time in the fourth month after birth.
निष्क्रम्य: निष्-क्रम्य, ind. having gone out, going forth.
निष्क्रान्त: निष्-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone out, departed, come forth; (in dramatic language) exit, exeunt.
निष्क्रय: निष्-क्रय, अस्, m. redemption, ransom; reward; price, hire, wages; acquittance.
निष्क्रिय: निष्क्रिय निष्-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, inactive; abstaining from ceremonial rites, not performing religious ceremonies; (अम्), n. a term for Brahma or the Supreme Spirit. —निष्क्रिय-ता, f. inactivity, idleness, negligence. —निष्क्रियात्म-ता (°य-आत्°), f. non-performance of appointed acts, habitual neglect of prescribed duties, inactivity, laziness, idleness.
निष्क्री: निष्क्री निष्-क्री (निस्-क्री), cl. 9. P. A. -क्री-णाति, -णीते, -क्रेतुम्, P. to buy off, to redeem or ransom from (with abl.); A. to redeem or ransom one's self.
निष्क्रयण: निष्-क्रयण, अस्, ई, अम्, redeeming, ransoming; (अम्), n. redemption, ransom.
निष्क्रीति: निष्-क्रीति, इस्, f., Ved. redeeming, redemption.
निष्क्रोध: निष्क्रोध निष्-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्, free from wrath, not angry, not angry with (with gen.).
निष्क्लेश: निष्क्लेश निष्-क्लेश, अस्, आ, अम्, (with Bud-dhists) free from (ten) moral faults. —निष्क्लेश-लेश, अस्, आ, अम्, not suffering the least pain, quite happy.
निष्क्वथ्: निष्क्वथ् निष्-क्वथ् (निस्-क्वथ्), Caus. -क्वा-थयति, -यितुम्, to boil down, thicken by boiling.
निष्क्वाथ: निष्-क्वाथ, अस्, m. a decoction, broth, soup.
निष्खन्: निष्खन् निष्-खन् (निस्-खन्), cl. 1. P. A. -खनति, -ते, -खनितुम्, to dig out.
निष्खिदम्: निष्खिदम् निष्-खिदम्, Ved. probably for नि-खिदम्, an inf. form of नि-खिद्।
निष्टक्वन्: निष्टक्वन् निष्-टक्वन्, आ, अरी, अ (fr. rt. तक् with निस्), Ved. escaping (?).
निष्टप्: निष्टप् निष्-टप् (निस्-तप्), cl. 1. P. -टपति, -टप्तुम्, to singe, scorch; to heat thoroughly, anneal, to purify by heat, free from impurities; to roast; to fry; to toast.
निष्टप्त: निष्-टप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, burnished, made bright; well cooked, well dressed or done.
निष्टर्क्य: निष्टर्क्य निष्-टर्क्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तर्क् with निस्), Ved. to be opened by unscrewing, to be loosened by untwisting.
निष्टवैश्य: निष्टवैश्य निष्ट-वैश्य, अस्, m., N. of a man.
निष्टानक: निष्टानक नि-ष्टानक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्तन् with नि = निस्), roar, murmur, murmuring, rustling; (अस्, आ, अम्), speaking loud; causing to cry.
निष्टिग्री: निष्टिग्री निष्टिग्री, f., Ved., N. of the mother of Indra.
निष्टुर्: निष्टुर् निष्-टुर्, ऊर्, ऊर्, ऊर् (fr. rt. तॄ with निस्), Ved. one who has no conqueror, unconquered; (Sāy.) an overcomer of enemies.
निष्ट्य: निष्ट्य निष्ट्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस्), Ved. ex-ternal, foreign, strange; exotic, coming from abroad; (अस्), m. a man of one of the outcast or barbarous tribes, a Cāṇḍāla, a Mleccha; (आ), f. a particular Nakṣatra also called Svātī.
निष्ठ: निष्ठ नि-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्था with नि or in some senses with निस्), staying or being in or on, situated on, grounded on; depending on, resting on, referring to, relating to; intent on, de-voted to, attached to, practising; versed in, skilled in; believing in; (1. नि-ष्ठा), f. position, condition, state, stand-point, basis, foundation; devotion or attachment to, uniform practice or profession; ex-celling in, conversancy with, skill, eminence, excel-lence, perfection; believing in, faith; conclusion, end, termination, (sometimes at the end of adj. comp., e. g. अपभ्रंश-निष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, ending in a fall); the end or catastrophe of a drama, conclusion of a fable, accomplishment, completion; culminating point; disappearance, destruction, death, fixed time of life; fixed or certain knowledge, ascertainment, certainty; a technical term for the past participle affixes त and तवत् (or with their indicatory letters क्त and क्तवतु); asking, begging; suffering, trouble, distress, anxiety. —निष्ठा-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to perfection, attaining perfection, (a term applied to a class of Buddhist deities.) —निष्ठान्त (°ठा-अन्°), अस्, m. end, conclusion. —निष्ठा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of complete knowledge, per-fect, complete, consummate, fulfilling all religious duties.
निष्ठा: 2. नि-ष्ठा, आस्, आस्, अम् (नि for निस्), Ved. excel-ling, eminent, leading; staying or being in (= नि-ष्ठ); (आस्), m. a leader, guide; (Sāy.) station, position.
निष्ठानक: निष्ठानक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
निष्ठाव: नि-ष्ठाव, अस्, आ, अम् (नि for निस्), Ved. con-cluding, deciding.
निष्ठित: नि-ष्ठित, अस्, आ, अम् (नि may be for निस्), staying in, being in or on; engaged in, attached to, devoted to; versed in, skilled in, conversant with; firm, fixed; certain, ascertained.
निष्ठिव्: निष्ठिव् नि-ष्ठिव् or -ष्ठीव्, cl. 1. and 4. P. -ष्ठीवति, -ष्ठीव्यति, -ष्ठेवितुम्, to spit, spit out, eject from the mouth.
निष्ठीव: नि-ष्ठीव, अस्, अम्, m. n. spitting, spitting out.
निष्ठीवन: नि-ष्ठीवन or नि-ष्ठीवित, अम्, n. spitting, spitting out, ejecting anything from the mouth. —निष्ठीवन-शराव, अस्, अम्, m. n. a spitting-box, spittoon.
निष्ठेव: नि-ष्ठेव, अस्, आ, अम्, m. f. n. or निष्ठेवन, अम्, n. spitting, spitting out, ejecting anything from the mouth.
निष्ठ्यूत: नि-ष्ठ्यूत, अस्, आ, अम्, spit out, ejected from the mouth, cast or thrown out; uttered; directed, despatched (?).
निष्ठ्यूति: नि-ष्ठ्यूति, इस्, f. spitting, spitting out; (less correctly written नि-ष्ठूति।)
निष्ठुर: निष्ठुर नि-ष्ठुर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. स्था), hard, rough, rugged; harsh, coarse, gruff, cruel, severe, austere; contumelious (as speech). —निष्ठुर-ता, f. or निष्ठुर-त्व, अम्, n. harshness of speech, coarseness, reviling, abuse.
निष्ठुरक: निष्ठुरक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
निष्ठुरिक: निष्ठुरिक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
निष्ठूरिन्: निष्ठूरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, rough, coarse; [cf. स्थूरिन्, स्थूल।]
निष्ण: निष्ण नि-ष्ण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्ना with नि), clever, skilful, experienced; [cf. नि-श्न, नदी-ष्ण।]
निष्णात: नि-ष्णात, अस्, आ, अम्, deeply versed in, skilful, clever, conversant, learned; perfect, superior; (in law) agreed upon.
निष्पक्व: निष्पक्व निष्-पक्व, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. पच् with निस्), decocted, infused, boiled.
निष्पङ्क: निष्पङ्क निष्-पङ्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from mud or filth, pure.
निष्पत्: निष्पत् निष्-पत्, cl. 1. P. -पतति, -पतितुम्, to fly out of (with abl.), rush out, jump out, hasten out, come forth, issue, depart; to fall out; to fly away; to spring from: Caus. -पातयति, &c., to cause to fall out or fly out; to ruin; to destroy.
निष्पतत्: निष्-पतत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, issuing, going forth or out.
निष्पतन: निष्-पतन, अम्, n. going quickly forth, rushing out; issuing quickly.
निष्पतिष्णु: निष्-पतिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, rushing or running out, hastening out.
निष्पताक: निष्पताक निष्-पताक, अस्, आ, अम्, having no flag or banner. —निष्पताक-ध्वज, अस्, m. a flag-staff without a banner.
निष्पतिसुता: निष्पतिसुता निष्-पति-सुता, f. having no husband and no sons.
निष्पत्ति: निष्-पत्ति, इस्, f. going forth or out, birth, pro-duction; completion, conclusion, termination, con-summation.
निष्पत्त्र: निष्पत्त्र निष्-पत्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having no leaves, leafless; without feathers, unfeathered; [cf. अ-निष्पत्त्रम्]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (?), the clove tree.
निष्पत्त्रक: निष्-पत्त्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, leafless; (इका), f. the plant Capparis Aphylla (see करीर).
निष्पत्त्रय: निष्-पत्त्रय, Nom. P. -पत्त्रयति, &c., to deprive of leaves, make leafless.
निष्पत्त्राकृ: निष्पत्त्रा-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to pierce with an arrow so that the feathers come through on the other side. —निष्पत्त्रा-कृति, इस्, f. causing excessive bodily pain.
निष्पद्: निष्पद् 1. निष्-पद् or निष्पाद्, -पात्, -पदी, पात्, footless, having no feet.

निष्पद् 2. निष्-पद्, cl. 4. A. -पद्यते, -पत्तुम्, to come forth from, issue, spring from, spring up, arise, be produced, be accomplished, be brought about or effected; to be prepared; to become ripe, ripen: Caus. -पादयति, -यितुम्, to produce, bring about, accomplish, effect, perform; to make ripe, cause to ripen.
3. निष्-पद्, त्, f., Ved. excrement; (according to Sāy. = निर्-गच्छत्।)
निष्पद: निष्-पद, अस्, आ, अम्, having no feet. —निष्-पद-यान, अम्, n. a vehicle moving without feet (as a ship &c.).
निष्पन्न: निष्-पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, gone forth or out, sprung up, arisen, born, descended, produced, brought about, effected, completed, concluded, accomplished, done, finished, ready.
निष्पादक: निष्-पादक, अस्, इका, अम्, performing, accom-plishing, effective. —निष्पादक-त्व, अम्, n. effec-tiveness, power of achieving.
निष्पादक निष्-पादक, &c. See under 2. निष्-पद्, p. 508, col. 3.
निष्पादन: निष्-पादन, अम्, n. doing, effecting, accom-plishing; concluding; producing, causing, engen-dering.
निष्पादित: निष्-पादित, अस्, आ, अम्, done, effected, made, produced, prepared, achieved.
निष्पाद्य: निष्-पाद्य or निष्-पादनीय or निष्-पादि-तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be effected or accomplished, capable of being performed, achievable.
निष्पाद्यमान: निष्-पाद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being effected or done, being in the course of accomplishment or completion.
निष्पन्द: निष्पन्द नि-ष्पन्द, अस्, आ, अम् (नि for निस् + स्पन्द), motionless, immovable.
निष्पराक्रम: निष्पराक्रम निष्-पराक्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, des-titute of power or prowess, powerless, weak.
निष्परिकर: निष्परिकर निष्-परिकर, अस्, आ, अम्, with-out preparations.
निष्परिग्रह: निष्परिग्रह निष्-परिग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, with-out property, having no property; (अस्), m. an ascetic without family or dependants.
निष्परिच्छद: निष्परिच्छद निष्-परिच्छद, अस्, आ, अम्, hav-ing no retinue or train, without a court.
निष्परिदाह: निष्परिदाह निष्-परिदाह, अस्, आ, अम्, not liable to be burnt, incombustible.
निष्परीक्ष: निष्परीक्ष निष्-परीक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, not examining or testing accurately.
निष्परीहार: निष्परीहार निष्-परीहार, अस्, आ, अम्, not avoiding; not observing caution; (अम्), ind. not so as to avoid.
निष्पर्यन्त: निष्पर्यन्त निष्-पर्यन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having no limits, boundless, unbounded.
निष्पा: निष्पा 1. निष्-पा (निस्-पा, see rt. 1. पा), cl. 1. 2. P. -पिबति or -पिवति, -पाति, -पातुम्, Ved. to drink out, drink up, drink from (with abl.), to empty by drinking, exhaust.
निष्पा 2. निष्-पा (निस्-पा, see rt. 3. पा), cl. 2. P. -पाति, -पातुम्, to defend from (with abl.).
निष्पान: निष्-पान, अम्, n. drinking out, drinking up.
निष्पीत: निष्-पीत, अस्, आ, अम्, drunk up, dried up, sucked up, exhausted.
निष्पाप: निष्पाप निष्-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, free from sin, sinless, guiltless.
निष्पार: निष्पार निष्-पार, अस्, आ, अम्, without boun-daries, boundless, unlimited.
निष्पालक: निष्पालक निष्-पालक, अस्, आ, अम्, without protector or guardian, unprotected.
निष्पिश्: निष्पिश् निष्-पिश् (निस्-पिश्), cl. 6. P. A. -पिंशति, -ते, -पेशितुम्, Ved. to tear the flesh of an animal from the skin.
निष्पिष्: निष्पिष् निष्-पिष् (निस्-पिष्), cl. 7. P. -पि-नष्टि, -पेष्टुम्, to grind, crush, pound, bruise, triturate; to rub, rub the hands; to gnash the teeth: Caus. -पेषयति, -यितुम्, to destroy.
निष्पिष्ट: निष्-पिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, ground, pounded, pul-verized, bruised, crushed, reduced to dust or powder; beaten, oppressed.
निष्पेष: निष्-पेष, अस्, m. or निष्-पेषण, अम्, n. rubbing together, grinding, pulverizing, bruising; striking, clashing, hitting or throwing against; the noise or sound produced by striking or clashing; [cf. नैष्पेषिक।]
निष्पीड: निष्पीड निष्-पीड, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed out ? (probably incorrect for निष्-पीत), sucked out.
निष्पुड्गल: निष्पुड्गल निष्-पुड्गल or निष्-पुङ्गल, अस्, आ, अम्, without personality (?); [cf. पुङ्गल, पुड्-गल।]
निष्पुत्र: निष्पुत्र निष्-पुत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, sonless, childless.
निष्पुराण: निष्पुराण निष्-पुराण, अस्, आ, अम्, not existing before, new.
निष्पुरुष: निष्पुरुष निष्-पुरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of men, without males, unpeopled, desolate; not having produced male children; not male, feminine, neuter; (अस्), m. a eunuch or impotent man; a coward; [cf. नैष्पुरुष्य।]
निष्पुलाक: निष्पुलाक निष्-पुलाक, अस्, आ, अम्, free from chaff or rather from bad or useless grain; (अस्), m., N. of the fourteenth Arhat of the future Ut-sarpiṇī. —निष्पुलाकी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from chaff.
निष्पू: निष्पू निष्-पू (निस्-पू), cl. 9. P. A. -पुनाति, -पुनीते, -पवितुम्, to cleanse, purify; to winnow, fan.
निष्पाव: निष्-पाव, अस्, m. fanning, winnowing, cleaning corn, &c.; the wind caused by the winnowing sieve or basket; wind, air; straw, chaff (?) = कडङ्गक or कडङ्ग; a legume, a pod; a species of pulse, Phaseolus Radiatus; Dolichos Sinensis or a similar kind, = राज-माष, = वल्ल, = सितशिम्बिक, = शिम्-बिका, = श्वेत-शिम्बी, = बोल, = शिमी, i. e. शिम्बी; (ई or इस्), f. a species of pulse, commonly वाडा, of which there are two kinds, a green and a white one; (अस्, आ, अम्), indubitable, certain.
निष्पावक: निष्-पावक, अस्, m. a species of pulse, = वल्ल or श्वेत-शिम्बी; (इका), f., cf. नख-न्°, वृत्त-न्°।
निष्पावल: निष्-पावल, an adj. formed fr. निष्-पाव, Pāṇini V. 2, 97.
निष्पॄ: निष्पॄ निष्-पॄ or निष्-पृ (निस्-पॄ), cl. 3. 9. P. -पिपर्ति, -पृणाति, -परितुम् or -परीतुम्, to bring out, help out, extricate; to fill: Caus. -पार-यति, -यितुम्, to lead or bring out, help out, extricate.
निष्पूर्त: निष्-पूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, poured out; filled.
निष्पौरुष: निष्पौरुष निष्-पौरुष, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of manhood, unmanly; (also written निः-पौरुष।)
निष्प्रकम्प: निष्प्रकम्प निष्-प्रकम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, im-movable, motionless; (अस्), m., N. of one of the Saptarṣis in the thirteenth Manv-antara.
निष्प्रकारक: निष्प्रकारक निष्-प्रकारक, अस्, आ, अम्, without distinction of species or kind, without speci-fication.
निष्प्रकाश: निष्प्रकाश निष्-प्रकाश, अस्, आ, अम्, not transparent, not clear, lightless, dark.
निष्प्रचार: निष्प्रचार निष्-प्रचार, अस्, आ, अम्, not going or moving away, remaining in one's place; concentrated or fixed upon one point (as mind).
निष्प्रणय: निष्प्रणय निष्-प्रणय, अस्, आ, अम्, without affection, cold.
निष्प्रताप: निष्प्रताप निष्-प्रताप, अस्, आ, अम्, void of dignity, mean, base.
निष्प्रतिक्रिय: निष्प्रतिक्रिय निष्-प्रतिक्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, in-curable, irremediable, what cannot be remedied.
निष्प्रतिग्रह: निष्प्रतिग्रह निष्-प्रतिग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, not accepting gifts. —निष्प्रतिग्रह-ता, f. the state of not accepting gifts, not taking presents.
निष्प्रतिघ: निष्प्रतिघ निष्-प्रतिघ, अस्, आ, अम्, not impeded by obstacles, unhindered, unimpeded.
निष्प्रतिद्वन्द्व: निष्प्रतिद्वन्द्व निष्-प्रतिद्वन्द्व, अस्, आ, अम्, without adversaries or enemies, unopposed; having no match, matchless, unequalled.
निष्प्रतिपक्ष: निष्प्रतिपक्ष निष्-प्रतिपक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, having no adversary, without an opponent. —निष्-प्रतिपक्ष-ता, f. the state of having no adversary.
निष्प्रतिभ: निष्प्रतिभ निष्-प्रतिभ, अस्, आ, अम्, having no splendor, deprived of splendor; stupid, frigid, dull, apathetic, ignorant.
निष्प्रतिभान: निष्प्रतिभान निष्-प्रतिभान, अस्, आ, अम्, not bold, cowardly, pusillanimous.
निष्प्रतीकार: निष्प्रतीकार निष्-प्रतीकार, अस्, आ, अम्, with-out obstacles, unobstructed, uninterrupted; (अम्), ind. unobstructedly, uninterruptedly.
निष्प्रतीप: निष्प्रतीप निष्-प्रतीप, अस्, आ, अम्, not turned backwards, directed forwards, looking straight-forwards; निष्प्रतीपं दर्शनम्, an untroubled or unconcerned look.
निष्प्रत्यूह: निष्प्रत्यूह निष्-प्रत्यूह, अस्, आ, अम्, unob-structed, unimpeded, irremediable; (अम्), ind. with-out hindrance or obstacle, freely.
निष्प्रधान: निष्प्रधान निष्-प्रधान, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of a chief, destitute of leaders.
निष्प्रपञ्च: निष्प्रपञ्च निष्-प्रपञ्च, अस्, आ, अम्, without extension or diffusion; without deceit, pure, honest. —निष्प्रपञ्चात्मन् (°च-आत्°), आ, m. an epithet of Śiva.
निष्प्रपतन: निष्प्रपतन निष्-प्रपतन in दुर्-न्°, q. v.
निष्प्रभ: निष्प्रभ निष्-प्रभ, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived of light or radiance, lustreless; gloomy, dark, obscure; (अस्), m., N. of a Dānava. —निष्प्रभ-ता, f. or निष्प्रभ-त्व, अम्, n. obscurity, gloominess, darkness.
निष्प्रभाव: निष्प्रभाव निष्-प्रभाव, अस्, आ, अम्, power-less. —निष्प्रभाव-ता, f. or निष्प्रभाव-त्व, अम्, n. powerlessness.
निष्प्रमाणक: निष्प्रमाणक निष्-प्रमाणक, अस्, इका, अम्, wanting authority, without authority.
निष्प्रयत्न: निष्प्रयत्न निष्-प्रयत्न, अस्, आ, अम्, abstain-ing from exertion or effort, inactive, inert.
निष्प्रयोजन: निष्प्रयोजन निष्-प्रयोजन, अस्, आ, अम्, without motives, not influenced by any motive; causeless, groundless, reasonless; useless, without an object; needless, unnecessary, uncalled for; (अम्), ind. causelessly, unnecessarily, without reason; (also written निः-प्रयोजन।) —निष्प्रयोजन-ता, f. or निष्प्रयोजन-त्व, अम्, n. uselessness.
निष्प्रवणि: निष्प्रवणि निष्-प्रवणि, इस्, इस्, इ, or निष्-प्रवाणि, इस्, इस्, इ, or निष्-प्रवाण, अस्, ई, अम्, fresh from the loom, quite new and unbleached (as cloth or linen).
निष्प्राण: निष्प्राण निष्-प्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose breath has departed, breathless, lifeless, dead, quite exhausted. —निष्प्राण-ता, f. lifelessness.
निष्प्रीति: निष्प्रीति निष्-प्रीति, इस्, इस्, इ, joyless, feeling no pleasure.
निष्प्लाव: निष्प्लाव निष्-प्लाव in कटु-न्°, incorrectly for निष्-पाव under निष्-पू, col. 1.
निष्फल: निष्फल निष्-फल, अस्, आ, अम्, bearing no fruit, fruitless, unfruitful, barren, useless, unprofitable, vain; meaningless; unproductive, seedless, impotent; (आ or ई), f. a woman past childbearing or in whom menstruation has ceased, (also read निष्कला); (आ), f. a species of Momordica. —निष्फल-त्व, अम्, n. unfruitfulness, unproductiveness. —निष्फली-कृत्य, ind. having made unfruitful.
निष्फलय: निष्-फलय, Nom. P. निष्फलयति, &c., to make unfruitful, to render fruitless.
निष्फेन: निष्फेन निष्-फेन, अस्, आ, अम्, foamless, without foam; (also written निः-फेन।)
निष्यन्द: निष्यन्द नि-ष्यन्द, नि-ष्यन्दिन्। See नि-स्यन्द, नि-स्यन्दिन्, p. 510, col. 3.
निष्यूत: निष्यूत नि-ष्यूत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. सिव् with नि), sewn on.
निष्षपिन्: निष्षपिन् निष्षपिन्, ई, इणी, इ (according to the Nirukta fr. निस् + सप = पस), Ved. libidinous, lustful.
निष्षह्: निष्षह् निष्-षह् or निष्-षाह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. overpowering, expelling; (Sāy. = निःसारयितृ।)
निस्: निस् निस्, ind. (as a preposition or prefix to verbs and their derivative nouns, expressing) out, forth, outward, out of, out from, away, away from; (निस् is used as an independent and separable adverb in Atharva-veda VI. 18, 3; VII. 115, 3; XVI. 2, 1.) निस् is also prefixed to nouns, not immediately con-nected with verbs, in the sense ‘out of,’ ‘away from’ [cf. निर्-वन], but more commonly in the sense of a privative or negative adverb = 3. अ, ‘no,’ ‘not,’ ‘without.’ In this latter signification it may form either negative substantives (e. g. fr. अर्थ, ad-vantage, निर्-अर्थ, disadvantage) or more frequently adjectives (e. g. fr. मल, a stain, निर्-मल, stain-less). निस् is liable to be euphonically changed to निर्, निः, निश्, निष् or नी [cf. नी-रस, &c.] accord-ing to the letter which follows it.
निसञ्ज्ञ: निसञ्ज्ञ नि-सञ्ज्ञ for निः-सञ्ज्ञ, q. v.
निसम्पात: निसम्पात नि-सम्पात, अस्, m. midnight; (also निः-सम्पात।)
निसर: निसर नि-सर, अस्, m., Ved. (according to Mahī-dhara) a noun of agency fr. rt. सृ with नि।
निसर्ग: निसर्ग नि-सर्ग। See under नि-सृज्, p. 510.

नि-सर्ग, अस्, m. evacuation, voiding excrement; giving away, presenting, bestowing, granting, showing a favour; a grant; relinquishment, abandoning, set-ting free; creation; the natural state, nature, natural character, natural condition or form; exchange, barter; निसर्गेण or निसर्गात् or निसर्ग-तस्, by nature, naturally, from one's natural state or condition. —निसर्ग-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, innate; inborn, produced at creation, natural. —निसर्ग-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, naturally distinct. —निसर्ग-विनीत, अस्, आ, अम्, naturally discreet. —निसर्ग-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, effected by nature, natural.
निसर्प: निसर्प नि-सर्प, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सृप् with नि). See नैसर्प, p. 518, col. 2.
निसिन्धु: निसिन्धु नि-सिन्धु, उस्, or निसिन्धुक, अस्, m. a species of shrub, Vitex Negundo (= निर्गुण्डी); [cf. सिन्धु, सिन्धुक, सिन्धु-वार।]
निसुन्द: निसुन्द नि-सुन्द, अस्, m., N. of an Asura slain by Kṛṣṇa; [cf. सुन्द, उप-सुन्द।]
निसुसूष्: निसुसूष् नि-सुसूष्, ऊस्, ऊस्, ऊस् (fr. the Desid. of rt. सु with नि). See Pāṇini VIII. 3, 117, and cf. अभि-सुसूष्।
निसूदक: निसूदक नि-सूदक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. सूद् with नि), one who kills, a killer, destroyer.
निसूदन: नि-सूदन, अस्, आ, अम्, killing, destroying, a destroyer, (at the end of a comp.); (अम्), n. killing, destroying, slaughter; (often incorrectly नि-षूदन।)
निसृ: निसृ नि-सृ, cl. 1. P. -सरति, -सर्तुम्, to go forth, (apparently only occurring in the derivative below.)
निसृत: नि-सृत, अस्, आ, अम्, = निः-सृत, q. v., gone forth, gone away, disappeared; (आ), f. the plant Ipomœa Turpethum (= त्रि-वृता); N. of a river; (a various reading for निश्-चिता।)
निसृज्: निसृज् नि-सृज्, cl. 6. P. -सृजति, -स्रष्टुम्, to let go, set free, dismiss, (apparently only used in the derivatives below.)
निसृष्ट: नि-सृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, dismissed, delivered, de-posited, given, bestowed, emancipated; allowed, per-mitted; central, middle. —निसृष्टार्थ (°ट-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, any one to whom the management of an affair is intrusted; (अस्), m. a chargé d'affaires, envoy, ambassador; messenger, agent, manager.
निसेवितव्य: निसेवितव्य नि-सेवितव्य for नि-षेवितव्य, q. v.
निस्तक्ष्: निस्तक्ष् निस्-तक्ष्, cl. 1. P. -तक्षति, &c., to form, create.
निस्-तक्ष्; add — to carve out; to cut up, wound (by insults &c.).
निस्तत्त्व: निस्तत्त्व निस्-तत्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, not com-prehended in the twenty-four Tattvas or principles, (see तत्त्व।)
निस्तनी: निस्तनी नि-स्तनी, f. (according to some fr. नि + स्तनी, a small breast), a pill, bolus, a sort of force-meat ball.
निस्तन्तु: निस्तन्तु निस्-तन्तु, उस्, उस्, उ, having no off-spring, childless.
निस्तन्द्र: निस्तन्द्र निस्-तन्द्र, अस्, आ, अम्, or निस्-तन्द्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, not lazy or listless, fresh, healthy.
निस्तब्ध: निस्तब्ध नि-स्तब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, paralyzed, numbed, stiffened; stopped, fixed.
निस्तमस्क: निस्तमस्क निस्-तमस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from darkness, not gloomy, light.
निस्तरण: निस्तरण निस्-तरण, निस्-तार, &c. See under निस्-तॄ, col. 2.
निस्-तरण, अम्, n. going out or forth, coming out (of danger); crossing over or passing; rescue, releasing, deliverance, getting rid of or free from; means of success or rescue, an expedient, a plan.
निस्तर्क्य: निस्तर्क्य निस्-तर्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unimagin-able, inconceivable.
निस्तर्हण: निस्तर्हण निस्-तर्हण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. तृह् with निस्), crushing, destroying, killing, slaughter.
निस्तल: निस्तल निस्-तल, अस्, आ, अम्, not flat, round, globular; trembling, shaking, moving; down, below.
निस्तिमिर: निस्तिमिर निस्-तिमिर, अस्, आ, अम्, free from darkness, clear, light.
निस्तुति: निस्तुति नि-स्तुति। See under निः-स्तुति, p. 482.
निस्तुद्: निस्तुद् निस्-तुद्, cl. 6. P. A. -तुदति, -ते, -तोत्तुम्, to pierce, prick, sting.
निस्तोद: निस्-तोद, अस्, m. or निस्तोदन, अम्, n. pricking, piercing, stinging.
निस्तुष: निस्तुष निस्-तुष, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from chaff or husk; (metaphorically) purified, cleansed; simplified. —निस्तुष-क्षीर, अस्, m. wheat. —निस्-तुष-रत्न, अम्, n. crystal.
निस्तुषित: निस्-तुषित, अस्, आ, अम्, skinned, peeled, shelled, husked, made thin, pared; left, abandoned, deserted.
निस्तृणकण्टक: निस्तृणकण्टक निस्-तृण-कण्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, cleared or freed from grass and thorns.
निस्तॄ: निस्तॄ निस्-तॄ, cl. 1. P. -तरति, -तरितुम्, -तरीतुम्, to come forth from, to rescue or free one's self from, get out of, get clear of, escape, be saved; to pass over, pass, cross; to pass through; to pass or spend time; to accomplish, perform, fulfil, settle; to overcome, overpower, master; to expiate; अभियोगं निस्-तॄ, to clear one's self from an accusation: Caus. -तारयति, -यितुम्, to cause to pass over; to rescue, save, release, deliver, liberate; to overcome, overpower: Desid. -तितीर्-षति, -तितरिषति, -तितरीषति, to wish to cross or pass over.
निस्तर्तव्य: निस्-तर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be overcome or conquered or overpowered.
निस्तार: निस्-तार, अस्, m. crossing or passing over or across, getting rid of or away from, release, escape, rescue, preservation; final emancipation, salvation; means, expedient; payment, discharge of a debt, acquittance, requital. —निस्तार-वीज, अम्, n. a means of crossing (the ocean of life), a cause of final liberation.
निस्तारक: निस्-तारक, अस्, इका, अम्, rescuing, delivering; a saviour.
निस्तारण: निस्-तारण, अम्, n. passing or transporting over or across, overcoming, conquering; liberating.
निस्तितीर्षत्: निस्-तितीर्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, desirous or anxious to cross (the ocean of life); wishing for salvation or liberation.
निस्तीर्ण: निस्-तीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, rescued, delivered, saved.
निस्तेजस्: निस्तेजस् निस्-तेजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, deprived of strength or energy, destitute of fire or heat, powerless, impotent; spiritless, dull; obscure.
निस्तोय: निस्तोय निस्-तोय, अस्, आ, अम्, deprived or destitute of water, waterless.
निस्त्यज्: निस्त्यज् निस्-त्यज्, cl. 1. P. -त्यजति, -त्यक्-तुम्, to drive away, expel.
निस्त्रंश: निस्त्रंश निस्-त्रंश, अस्, आ, अम्, fearless; (probably incorrect for निस्-त्रिंश below.)
निस्त्रप: निस्त्रप निस्-त्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless.
निस्त्रिंश: निस्त्रिंश निस्-त्रिंश, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + त्रिंशत्), more than thirty; merciless, unfeeling, unpitying, cruel (as a sword); (अस्), m. a sword, a scimitar, falchion, a sacrificial knife, (so called because more than thirty fingers in length.) —निस्त्रिंश-धारिन्, ई, m. a sword-bearer, a swordsman or soldier armed with a sword. —निस्त्रिंश-पत्त्रक, अस्, इका, m. f. a thorny species of Euphorbia, (An-tiquorum or Tortilis). —निस्त्रिंश-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, a sword-bearer.
निस्त्रिंशिन्: निस्त्रिंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, bearing a sword, armed with a sword.
निस्त्रुटी: निस्त्रुटी निस्-त्रुटी, f. cardamoms; [cf. त्रुटि, निष्-कुटि।]
निस्त्रैगुण्य: निस्त्रैगुण्य निस्-त्रैगुण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, desti-tute of the three qualities (viz. सत्त्व, रजस्, and तमस्; see गुण).
निस्त्रैणपुष्पक: निस्त्रैणपुष्पक निस्त्रैणपुष्पक, अस्, m. (fr. निस् + स्त्रैण + पुष्प?), a species of thorn-apple.
निस्नाव: निस्नाव नि-स्नाव, अस्, m. (fr. नि-स्नु?), residue of articles &c. after a sale or market.
निस्नेहफला: निस्नेहफला निस्नेह-फला। See निःस्नेह-फला under निः-स्नेह, p. 482, col. 2.
निस्पन्द: निस्पन्द 1. नि-स्पन्द, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्पन्द् with नि), throbbing, trembling motion.
निस्पन्द 2. नि-स्पन्द, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि for निस् + स्पन्द), immovable, still, steady; [cf. नि-ष्पन्द।] —निस्पन्द-त्व, अम्, n. immovableness.
निस्पृश्: निस्पृश् नि-स्पृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. confiding; caressing, fondling.
निस्यन्द: निस्यन्द नि-स्यन्द or नि-ष्यन्द, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. स्यन्द् with नि, or नि for निस्), flowing or trickling down, dripping, dropping; (अस्), m. a trickling or flowing down, oozing, issuing, streaming, dropping, distilling; a discharge (of any fluid), a flux; a stream, any fluid that trickles down or drops; trickling forth from, flowing out, flowing from; necessary consequence or result; uttering.
निस्यन्दमान: नि-स्यन्दमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trickling, flowing, oozing, issuing.
निस्यन्दिन्: नि-स्यन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, flowing or streaming or trickling down or out.
निस्रव: निस्रव नि-स्रव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्रु with नि), flowing down, a stream, torrent; (perhaps for निः-स्रव, flowing forth, streaming out.)
निस्राव: नि-स्राव, अस्, m. flowing down, a stream, torrent; the scum of boiled rice; [cf. निः-स्राव।]
निस्राविन्: नि-स्राविन्, ई, इणी, इ, flowing down.
निस्वन: निस्वन 1. नि-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., various reading for नि-स्वर, q. v.

निस्वन 2. नि-स्वन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. स्वन् with नि), noise, sound, voice, (often at the end of comps. when the fem. is निस्वना; cf. रथ-न्°, उद्धतार्णव-न्°); (अम्), ind. with noise or sound; [cf. निः-स्वन।]
निस्वनित: नि-स्वनित, अम्, n. a noise, sound, crying, a cry.
निस्वान: नि-स्वान, अस्, m. noise, sound; the whistling sound of an arrow.
निस्वर: निस्वर नि-स्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. soundless, noiseless; (अस्), m. an epithet of Agni.
निह्: निह् निह्, Ved. = नि-हन्तृ (according to Mahī-dhara).
निहन्: निहन् 1. नि-हन्, cl. 2. P. -हन्ति, -हन्तुम्, to strike down, strike, kill, destroy; to strike in, fix in, infix; to disregard, neglect: Caus. -घात-यति, -यितुम्, to kill, destroy.
2. नि-हन्, आ, m. a killer, destroyer.
निहत: नि-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, struck down, stricken, smitten, killed, slain, overcome; struck into, infixed; attached, devoted. —निहत-भूयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, having the greater number killed. —निहत-सेन, अस्, आ, अम्, having (their) armies smitten or destroyed. —निहतोष्ट्र (°त-उष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the camels killed, whose camels have been slain.
निहनन: नि-हनन, अम्, n. killing, slaughter, murder.
निहन्तव्य: नि-हन्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be struck down, to be killed or destroyed.
निहन्तृ: नि-हन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what kills or destroys, a killer; destructive, murderous; one who removes or dispels or hinders.
निहन्यमान: नि-हन्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being struck down or killed.
निहव: निहव नि-हव। See नि-ह्वे, p. 511, col. 1.
नि-हव, अस्, m. invocation, calling, summoning, calling near; N. of a Sāman, (वसिष्ठस्य नि-हवस् or वसिष्ठ-निहवस्।)
निहा: निहा नि-हा, Pass. -हीयते, &c., to be de-prived of.
निहाका: निहाका, f., Ved. a storm, whirlwind, &c.; (Sāy.) an iguana, the Gangetic alligator.
निहीन: नि-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, low, vile, of low origin; (अस्), m. a low man, an outcast.
निहीन नि-हीन। See under नि-हा, p. 510, col. 3.
निहिंसन: निहिंसन नि-हिंसन, अम्, n. killing, slaughter.
निहृ: निहृ नि-हृ, cl. 1. P. A. -हरति, -ते, -हर्-तुम्, Ved. to offer, give.
निहार: नि-हार, अस्, m. = नी-हार, q. v.
निहारिन्: नि-हारिन्। See निर्-हारिन् under निर्-हृ, p. 502, col. 3.
निह्नु: निह्नु नि-ह्नु, cl. 2. A. -ह्नुते, -ह्नोतुम्, to disown, deny, dissimulate, conceal, evade.
निह्नव: नि-ह्नव, अस्, m. denial, concealment, hushing up, dissimulation; concealment in general, secrecy; mistrust, doubt, suspicion; a secret; wickedness; atonement, expiation; excuse, exculpation, depre-cation; N. of a ceremony; N. of a Sāman. —नि-ह्नव-वादिन्, ई, m. a defendant or witness who prevaricates or tries to hide the truth. —निह्नवोत्-तर (°व-उत्°), अम्, n. an evasive reply or defence.
निह्नुत: नि-ह्नुत, अस्, आ, अम्, denied, disowned, evaded; concealed, secreted.
निह्नुति: नि-ह्नुति, इस्, f. denial or concealment of know-ledge; dissimulation, reserve, secrecy; hiding, con-cealment.
निह्नुवन: नि-ह्नुवन, अम्, n. denial or concealment of knowledge; excuse, exculpation.
निह्नुवान: नि-ह्नुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, dissimulating, prevari-cating, insinuating, using double entendre.
निह्राद: निह्राद नि-ह्राद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. ह्राद् with नि), sound; (also read निर्-ह्राद।) —निह्राद-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, sounding, making a noise.
निह्रादिन्: नि-ह्रादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding, pealing.
निह्वे: निह्वे नि-ह्वे, cl. 1. P. A. -ह्वयति, -ते, -ह्वातुम्, to invoke, call.
नी: नी 1. नी, cl. 1. P. A. नयति, -ते, अनयत् (ep. also अनयीत्), नयेत (ep. also नयीत), निनाय (3rd pl. निन्युस्, anomalous form of Perf. नयाम्-आस), निन्ये, नेता (ep. also नयिता), नेष्यति, -ते (ep. also नयिष्यति), अनैषीत्, अनेष्ट (Ved. forms नेषत्, नेषति, नेषि, नैष्ट, नेष्ट), नेतुम् (ep. also नयितुम्), to lead, guide, conduct, (व्यव-हारं नी, to conduct a process); to direct, govern; to lead or bring away, carry away, to lead or bring away to (with acc., dat., or loc.); to carry off for one's self (A.); to marry; to bring a person (acc.) into any state or condition (acc. or loc., e. g. नृ-पतीन् वशम् अनयत्, he brought the kings into subjection; तां दुहितृत्वे नयति, he brings her into the state of a daughter: sometimes used with a substantive in the same way as 1. कृ, q. v., e. g. विनाशं नी, to destroy; परितोषं नी, to gratify; विक्रयं नी, to sell; दुःखं नी, to pain; साक्ष्यं नी, to admit as a witness; आधानं नी, to give in pledge; शूद्रतां नी, to reduce to a Śūdra: or with an adverb ending in सात्, e. g. भस्-मसाद् नी, to reduce to ashes); to lead away from, exclude from; to draw (a line &c.); to trace, track; to ascertain, investigate; to settle; to pass or spend (time); to carry, bear; (with दण्डम्) to bear the rod, inflict punishment; to guide in learning, instruct (A.): Pass. नीयते, to be led, &c.: Caus. नाययति, &c., to cause to lead, &c.; to cause to be carried away: Desid. निनीषति, -ते (Ved. निने-षति), to wish to lead, &c.; to wish to take away; to wish to bring to a state; to wish to exclude from (with abl.); to wish to trace or ascertain, investigate [cf. निनीषा, निनीषु]: Intens. नेनीयते, to lead as a captive, have in one's power, rule; [cf. Gr. νέ-ο-μαι, νίσσομαι, νῑσομαι; Lith. neṣù; Slav. ne-sun, ‘I bear.’]
2. नी, ईस्, m. a leader, a guide, (used at the end of a comp.; cf. अग्र-णी, अग्रे-णी, ऋत-नी, गाथा-नी, ग्राम-णी, पद-नी, &c.)
नी 3. नी (नि इ), cl. 2. P. न्य्-एति, न्य्-एतुम्, Ved. to go into, enter, come or fall into, change to; [cf. न्य्-आय।]
नीक: नीक, अस्, m. a species of tree; (आ), f. a channel for irrigation.
नीत: 1. नीत, अस्, आ, अम्, led, guided, conducted; brought, reduced; gained, obtained; well-behaved, correct, modest; (अम्), n. wealth; corn, grain; [cf. असु-न्°, दुर्-न्°, &c.]
2. नीत, अस्, आ, अम्, entered, gone to; (Sāy.) = नितराम् प्राप्त।
नीत नीत, नीति, &c. See p. 511, col. 2.
नीति: नीति, इस्, f. guiding, guidance, directing, direction, management; manner of conducting one's self, con-duct, propriety; right or moral or prudent behaviour, prudent counsel, policy, political wisdom or science, political economy, state policy, statesmanship, the administration of government; moral philosophy, ethics, precepts for prudent and moral behaviour, prudence, Prudence or Polity personified [cf. नय]; leading or bringing to, obtaining, acquirement, acqui-sition; presenting, offering; relation, support; [cf. अग्र-णीति, अदब्ध-न्°, असु-न्°, ऋजु-न्°, &c.] —नीति-कथा, f. any work on moral or political science, a discourse on political economy. —नीति-कुशल, अस्, आ, अम्, conversant with political science, skilful in human affairs, a good statesman. —नीति-घोष, अस्, m., N. of the car of Bṛhas-pati. —नीति-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing what is right especially in government, sagacious, politic, prudent; (अस्), m. a prudent statesman or soldier, a politician. —नीति-दोष, अस्, m. error of conduct, mistake in policy. —नीति-निष्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, versed in political or moral science. —नीति-प्रदीप, अस्, m. ‘the light of pru-dent behaviour,’ N. of a collection of verses attributed to Vetāla-bhaṭṭa. —नीति-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a work on morality or right behaviour. —नीति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, knowing the rules of moral or prudent behaviour, moral, prudent, eminent for political wisdom. —नीति-रत्न, अम्, n. ‘the jewel of mora-lity,’ N. of a collection of verses attributed to Vara-ruci. —नीति-वाक्यामृत (°य-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar of discourse on morality or prudent behaviour,’ N. of a work. —नीति-विद्, त्, m. a politician, any one versed in political science, a statesman. —नीति-विद्या, f. moral or political science, political economy; [cf. नीति-शास्त्र।] —नीति-विषय, अस्, m. the sphere of morality or prudent conduct. —नीति-वीज, अम्, n. a germ or source of intrigue. —नीति-वेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, knowing policy, a politician. —नीति-व्यतिक्रम, अस्, m. error of conduct, transgression of the rules of moral or political science. —नीति-शतक, अम्, n. the hundred verses on morality by Bhartṛ-hari. —नीति-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the science of ethics or politics, any work on political ethics or morals. —नीति-सङ्क-लन, अम्, n. ‘collection of rules for moral conduct or prudent behaviour,’ N. of a modern work. —नीति-सार, अस्, m. or अम्, n. the essence of political or moral science; (अम्), n. a special work on this subject by Ghaṭa-karpara.
नीत्वा: नीत्वा, ind. having led or conducted or guided; having taken; having passed or spent (as time).
नीथ: नीथ, अस्, m. (Ved. also n.) leading, guiding; a leader, a guider; N. of a man; (आ), f., Ved. way, trick; evasion, subterfuge; a mode in music; water; [cf. दीर्घ-न्°, देव-न्°।] —नीथा-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. knowing ways, knowing the musical modes, skilled in sacred song.
नीथ; after ‘subterfuge’ insert (अम्), n. a hymn.
नीयमान: नीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being led or conducted or conveyed, being carried or brought, being taken or taken away; being traced or sought or obtained.
नेतव्य: नेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be led or guided or con-ducted, to be led away, to be taken, to be carried.
नेतव्य नेतव्य, नेतृ, &c. See p. 511, col. 2.
नेतृ: नेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, leading, conducting, guiding, one who brings or leads to; (ता), m. a leader, guide, conductor; a chief, master, owner; (with दण्डस्य) an inflicter of punishment [cf. दण्ड-न्°]; the hero of a drama or play; the plant Azadirachta Indica (= निम्ब); the numeral two; (त्री), f. a female leader; a river; a vein; an epithet of Lakṣmī. —नेतृ-त्व, अम्, n. the office or business of a leader &c., leadership. —नेतृ-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word नेतृ।
नेत्र: नेत्र, अस्, ई, अम्, one who guides or leads, a leader, guide; a substitute for नेतृ at the end of a comp. (e. g. भवन्-नेत्र, having thee as com-mander); (अस्), m., N. of a son of Dharma and father of Kunti; also a son of Su-mati; (अम्), n. leading, conducting; the eye (as the instrument of leading or guiding); symbolic expression for the number two; the string with which a churning-stick is whirled round; an enema-pipe; the root of a tree; bleached or wove silk; a carriage. —नेत्र-कनी-निका, f. the pupil of the eye. —नेत्र-कोष, अस्, m. the eyeball; the bud of a flower. —नेत्र-गो-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, within the range of the sight, visible. —नेत्र-च्छद, अस्, m. the eyelid. —नेत्र-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘eye-born,’ coming from the eyes; (अम्), n. a tear. —नेत्र-जल, अम्, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears. —नेत्र-ता, f. the state of being an eye; नेत्रतां या, to become an eye. —नेत्र-त्रिभाग-ब्रह्म-यशस्विन्, ई, m., N. of an author. —नेत्र-पर्यन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, as far as to the eye, up to the eye; (अस्), m. the outer angle of the eye. —नेत्र-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a cat (‘having full eyes’); the eyeball. —नेत्र-पुष्करा, f. a species of plant; [cf. रुद्र-जटा।] —नेत्र-मनः-स्वभावास्, m. pl. eyes, mind, and soul. —नेत्र-मीना, f. a species of plant (= यव-तिक्ता). —नेत्र-मुष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, stealing or cap-tivating the eye. —नेत्र-योनि, इस्, m. an epithet of Indra (as covered with marks resembling the female organ, through the curse of Gautama, whose wife Ahalyā he had attempted to seduce; the sage after-wards relenting, changed these disgraceful marks on the body of the deity to as many eyes); the moon (as produced from the eye of Atri). —नेत्र-रञ्जन, अम्, n. ‘eye-colouring,’ collyrium. —नेत्र-रुज्, क्, f. disease of the eyes. —नेत्र-रोग, अस्, m. disease of the eyes, ophthalmia; (अस्, आ, अम्), afflicted with disease of the eyes. —नेत्ररोग-ता, f. disease of the eyes. —नेत्ररोग-हन्, आ, m. a particular plant used for diseases of the eyes, Tragia Involucrata. —नेत्र-रोमन्, अ, n. the eyelash. —नेत्र-वस्ति, इस्, m. f. a clyster-pipe with a bag. —नेत्र-वस्त्र, अम्, n. a veil over the eye. —नेत्र-वारि, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears. —नेत्र-विष्, ट्, f. excretion of the eyes. —नेत्र-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, having poison in the eyes. —नेत्र-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. rigidity of the eyes. —नेत्राञ्जन (°र-अञ्°), अम्, n. ‘eye-ointment,’ collyrium. —नेत्रान्त (°र-अन्°), अस्, m. the outer corner of the eye. —नेत्राभिष्यन्द (°र-अभ्°), अस्, m. running of the eyes. —नेत्रामय (°र-आम्°), अस्, m. ophthalmia. —नेत्राम्बु (°र-अम्°) or नेत्राम्भस् (°र-अम्°), अस्, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears. —नेत्रारि (°र-अरि), इस्, m. a species of plant (= सीहुण्ड). —नेत्रोत्सव (°र-उत्°), अम्, n. ‘eye-feast,’ any pleasing or beautiful object. —नेत्रोपम (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. the almond fruit (as resembling eyes). —नेत्रोपम-फल, अस्, m. the almond tree. —नेत्रौषध (°र-औष्°), अम्, n. medi-cine for the eyes, collyrium, green sulphate of iron used as collyrium; (ई), f. Odina Pinnata (= अज-शृङ्गी).
नेत्र नेत्र, नेत्रिक, &c. See p. 511, col. 3.
नेत्रिक: नेत्रिक, अम्, n. a pipe, a clyster-pipe; a ladle.
नेय: नेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guided or led; to be governed; to be passed or spent (as time); to be led away; to be inflicted (e. g. नेयो दण्डस्, punishment must be inflicted). —नेय-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
नीकर्षिन्: नीकर्षिन् नी-कर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. rt. कृष् with नि), spreading the tail (as a peacock ?).
नीकार: नीकार नी-कार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. कृ with नि), disrespect, contempt, vilifying, degrading.
नीकाश: नीकाश नी-काश, अस्, m. (fr. rt. काश् with नि), appearance, look, air, mien; certainty, ascertainment; (अस्, आ, अम्), like, resembling, (at the end of comps.)
नीकुलक: नीकुलक नीकुलक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
नीक्लेद: नीक्लेद नी-क्लेद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. क्लिद् with नि), moistening, bedewing (?), Pāṇ. VI. 3, 122, Schol.
नीक्षण: नीक्षण नीक्षण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. ईक्ष् with नि or rt. निक्ष्?), Ved. a stick for stirring up a caldron, a kind of ladle, (Sāy. = पाक-परीक्षा-साधनं काष्ठम्); [cf. नेक्षण।]
नीच: नीच नीच, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि + अञ्च्, cf. उच्च; said to be fr. rt. चि with नि), low, not high, short, little, small, dwarfish; deep, lowered (as the voice), pronounced without an accent; situated below, being in a low position; low, vile, insignificant, inferior, base, mean (as a man or action); (अस्), m. a kind of perfume (= चोरक); (अम्), n. (in astrology) the lowest point of a planet (= ταπείνωμα), the seventh house from the highest point; (आत्), ind. from below, from beneath; [cf. नीचैस्, उच्च-नीच, न्य्-अञ्च्।] —नी-च-कदम्ब, अस्, m., N. of a plant (= मण्डीरी)। —नीच-कुल, अम्, n. a low family. —नीच-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going low or downwards, descending (as a river); being in or belonging to a low man or to a low class of men; low, vile, base; (आ), f. a river; (अम्), n. water. —नीच-गत, अस्, आ, अम् being at the lowest point (as a planet). —नीच-गृह, अम्, n. (in astrology) the house or station of the heavens in which a planet stands at its lowest point. —नीच-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of low birth. —निच-ता, f. or नीच-त्व, अम्, n. (opposed to उच्च-ता), lowness, meanness, vileness, baseness, humbleness, inferiority, a low situation. —नीच-भोज्य, अस्, m. ‘the food of low men,’ an onion. —नीच-मेढ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose penis hangs low. —नीच-योनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being of low origin, low-born. —नीच-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, delighting in mean things. —नीचर्क्ष (°च-ऋक्°), अम्, n. (?) = नीच-गृह, q. v. —नीच-वज्र, अम्, n. an inferior diamond, a sort of gem (= वैक्रान्त). —नीचा-वयस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. one whose strength has failed; (Sāy.) bending down the body. —नीचोक्ति (°च-उक्°), इस्, f. a low or vulgar expression. —नीचोच्च-वृत्त (°च-उच्°), अम्, n. an epicycle. —नीचोपगत (°च-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, situ-ated low in the sky.
नीचक: नीचक, अस्, इका, अम्, low, short, dwarfish; (low as the voice), soft; vile, mean; (अका), f. an excel-lent cow; (अकी), f. the head of an ox.
नीचकिन्: नीचकिन्, ई, m. the head or top of anything, the head of an ox; the owner of a good cow; [cf. नैचिक।]
नीचकैस्: नीचकैस्, ind. (diminutive of नीचैस्), low, below, little, &c.
नीचा: नीचा, ind. low, below, down, downwards, (this word may be regarded as the inst. c. of न्य्-अञ्च्, q. v.)
नीचात्: नीचात्, ind. from below. See नीच।
नीचायमान: नीचायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. descending, flying down (as a falcon).
नीचीकृ: नीची-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to lower, to pronounce without an accent.
नीचीन: नीचीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being low or below, low, directed downwards or underneath, hanging down, flowing down, cast down. —नीचीन-बार, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having its opening below (as a cloud).
नीचैस्: नीचैस्, ind. low, below, down, downwards, under-neath, beneath, deeply, deep, in the depths, in a bent or inclined position, bowing low, humbly, modestly; with a low or depressed or deep tone of voice, in a low tone (i. e. अन्-उदात्त, q. v.), softly; short, small, little, dwarfish; N. of a mountain, also called वामन-गिरि and खर्व (Dwarfish); [cf. उच्चैस्, निम्नैस्, शनैस्।] —नीचैः-कर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing a low or deep tone, giving depth of voice. —नीचैर्-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, with down-cast countenance. —नीचैस्-तराम्, ind. in a low tone, softly.
नीच्य: 1. नीच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, living below; Ved. an epithet of some nations in the West.
2. नीच्य, Nom. P. नीच्यति, &c., to be in a low situation, be a slave.
नीड: नीड नीड (Ved. नीऌअ), अस्, अम्, m. n. (per-haps fr. rt. सद् with नि, whence नि-षद = निष्ड = निड्ड = नीड, or fr. rt. इल् with नि), a resting-place, a place for lying down, a bird's nest; a bed, couch; a lair, den; the interior or seat of a carriage or chariot; a place, abode in general; [cf. Lat. nīdus; Hib. nead; Cambro-Brit. nyth; Germ. and Angl. Sax. nest.] —नीड-ज, अस्, m. ‘nest-born,’ a bird. —नीडजेन्द्र (°ज-इन्°), अस्, m. ‘chief of the birds,’ an epithet of Garuḍa. —नीडोद्भव (°ड-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘nest-born,’ a bird.
नीडक: नीडक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the nest of a bird.
नीडय: नीडय or नीऌअय, Nom. P. नीडयति or नीऌअ-यति, -यितुम्, Ved. (according to Sāy.) to bring together, join together, cause to come to close fight-ing; to bring to rest (?).
नीडि: नीडि or नीऌइ, इस्, m., Ved. one who lives in the same house (?).
नीतमिश्र: नीतमिश्र नीत-मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम् (नीत = नव-नीत), Ved. not yet become butter, (said of दधि।)
नीत्त: नीत्त नी-त्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for नि-दत्त fr. rt. 1. दा with नि), Ved. given.
नीध्र: नीध्र नीध्र, अम्, n. the edge of thatch, edge of a roof; a wood; the circumference of a wheel; the moon; the constellation Revatī; (consi-dered by some as a various reading for नीव्र, q. v.)
नीनाह: नीनाह नीनाह, अस्, m., Ved. anything which encircles another (?).
नीप: नीप नीप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. नि-अप्, but said to be fr. rt. 1. नी), situated low, deep; (अस्), m. the foot of a mountain; N. of a son of Kṛtin; the tree Nauclea Cadamba (= कदम्ब = धारा-क-दम्बक = धरा-कदम्ब = धूली-कदम्ब); the plant Ixora Bandhuca (= बन्धूक); a species of Aśoka (= नीलाशोक); (अम्), n. the fruit of the above plants; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a regal family descended from Nīpa, son of Pāra. —नीप-राज, अम्, n. (?), the fruit (?) of the Nīpa. —नीपातिथि (°प-अत्°), इस्, m., N. of a descendant of Kaṇva and author of a hymn of the Ṛg-veda (VIII. 34).
नीप्य: नीप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being low or on the ground.
नीमानुय: नीमानुय नीमानुय, अस्, m., N. of a Vaiṣ-ṇava teacher.
नीर्: नीर् नीर् (नि-ईर्), Caus. P. नीरयति, -यितुम्, to drive or impel into, urge forwards (to an aim); to send forth, appoint (to a business).
नीर: नीर नीर, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. नी), water; juice, liquor, (sometimes written for नीड, नीऌअ, q. v.); (अस्), m., N. of a prince; [cf. क्षीर-नीर, नार; Gr. νηπός, Νηρεύς.] —नीर-ग्रह, अस्, m. taking up water in a ladle; see under ग्रह। — 1. नीर-ज, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see below), ‘water-born,’ being in water, aquatic; (अस्), m. an otter; a species of grass, = उशीरी; (अस्, अम्), m. n. (according to the lexicographers only n.), a lotus in general, the water-lily; (अम्), n. a species of Costus, Costus Speciosus (= कुष्ठ); a pearl. —नीर-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘water-born,’ produced from water, aquatic. —१। नीर-द, अस्, m. (for 2. see col. 3), ‘giving water,’ a cloud; a species of Cyperus. —नीरदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, cloudy. —नीर-धि or नीर-निधि, इस्, m. ‘the receptacle of waters,’ the ocean; [cf. अब्-धि, तोय-धि, &c.] —नीर-प्रिय, अस्, m. a species of reed (जल-वेतस). —नीर-रुह, अम्, n. the water-lily, lotus. —नीराखु (°र-आखु), उस्, m. ‘water-rat,’ an otter.
नीरक्त: नीरक्त नी-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रक्त), colourless, faded, having the colour gone.
नीरज: नीरज 2. नी-रज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रज for रजस्), free from dust; devoid of passion; (with वि-रज) an epithet of Śiva. (For 1. नीर-ज see under नीर, col. 2.)
नीरजस्: नी-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (fr. निस् + रजस्), free from dust, having no pollen (as a flower); free from passion; (आस्), f. a woman not menstruating. —नी-रजस्-तमसा, f. absence of passion and darkness.
नीरजस्क: नी-रजस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, free from dust, not accompanied by dust (as wind); free from passion, pure.
नीरजस्व: नी-रजस्व, अस्, आ, अम्, free from dust.
नीरजीकृ: नीरजी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make free from dust. —नीरजी-कारित, अस्, आ, अम्, made free from dust, cleansed.
नीरत: नीरत नी-रत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रत), not delighting in, not attached to, indifferent.
नीरद: नीरद 2. नी-रद, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रद), toothless. (For 1. नीर-द see under नीर, col. 2.)
नीरन्ध्र: नीरन्ध्र नी-रन्ध्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रन्ध्र), having no holes or openings, without apertures or interstices, imperforate, close, uninter-rupted; coarse, thick, gross. —नीरन्ध्र-त्व, अम्, n. closeness, close connection.
नीरव: नीरव नी-रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रव), soundless.
नीरस: नीरस नी-रस, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रस), without juice, sapless, dried up, withered; flavourless, unsavoury, tasteless, devoid of taste, flat, dry; insipid; vain; (अस्), m. the pomegranate. —नीरस-ता, f. the state of being devoid of taste, tastelessness.
नीरसन: नीरसन नी-रसन, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + र-सना), having no girdle.
नीराजन: नीराजन नी-राजन, अम्, आ, n. f. (fr. rt. राज् with नि), lustration of arms (lustratio exercitus), a military and religious ceremony held by kings or generals on the nineteenth of Aśvin before taking the field, (it consists in purifying the Puro-hita or chaplain, the king's ministers, and various component parts of the army during the recitation of sacred texts); waving lights before an idol as an act of adoration, (this may also be performed with a lotus, clean cloth, or the leaves of various sacred plants; pros-tration is considered as a fifth kind of adoration.)
नीरिन्दु: नीरिन्दु नीरिन्दु, उस्, m. a species of plant (= अश्व-शाखोट), Trophis Aspera.
नीरुच्: नीरुच् नी-रुच्, क्, क्, क् (fr. निस् + रुच्), lustre-less, dull, dim, faded.
नीरुज्: नीरुज् नी-रुज्, क्, क्, क् (fr. निस् + रुज्), free from sickness; convalescent, well, in health; painless.
नीरुज: नी-रुज, अस्, आ, अम्, = नी-रुज्, healthy, in health, well, (sometimes written नि-रुज); (अम्), n. a species of Costus, Costus Speciosus (= कुष्ठ).
नीरूप: नीरूप नी-रूप, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रूप), formless, shapeless, mis-shapen; (अस्), m. air, wind; a god; (अम्), n. heaven, ether.
नीरेणुक: नीरेणुक नी-रेणुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रेणु), dustless, free from dust.
नीरोग: नीरोग नी-रोग, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + रोग), free from sickness, healthy, well. —नीरोग-ता, f. health.
नीरोग्यता: नीरोग्य-ता, f. health, freedom from sickness, (perhaps an error for नीरोग-ता।)
नीरोह: नीरोह नी-रोह, अस्, m. (fr. निस् + रुह्), Ved. shooting out, growing.
नील्: नील् नील् (rather a Nom. derived fr. नील below), cl. 1. P. नीलति, &c., to be of a dark colour; to dye dark, make or dye blue.
नील: नील, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (probably fr. निश् + ल = निश्ल = निल्ल = नील; according to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 42, the fem. form नीला is used in relation to clothes &c., and नीली in relation to plants, animals, &c.; in proper names either form is allowed), of a dark colour, (especially dark-blue or black); dyed with indigo; (अस्), m. dark-blue or black (the colour); a gem, the sapphire; the Indian fig-tree (= वट); a species of bird, the blue or hill Maina; an ox or bull of a dark colour; one of the nine Nidhis or divine treasures of Kuvera; N. of a man, the prince of Māhiṣmatī; of a son of Yadu; of a historian of Kaśmīra; an epithet of Mañju-śrī; N. of a Nāga; of one of the monkey-chiefs attending on Rāma, (said to be a son of Agni); the blue mountain, one of the principal ranges of mountains dividing the world into nine portions and lying immediately north of Ilāvṛta or the central division [cf. नीलाद्रि]; (आ), f. the indigo plant, Indigofera Tinctoria [cf. नीली]; a species of Boerhavia with blue blossoms (= नील-पुनर्-नवा); a species of blue fly [cf. नीली]; the two arteries in front of the neck, (in this sense नीले, f. du.); a black and blue mark on the skin (either from a bruise or a disease?); a Rāgiṇī or mode of music, personified as the wife of Rāga Mallāra; (ई), f. the indigo plant; another plant, Blyxa Saivala (= शैवल; cf. जल-नीली); a species of blue fly; a kind of disease (= नीली-रोग, नीलिका); N. of the wife of Aja-mīḍha [cf. नीलिनी, नलिनी]; (अम्), n. darkness (Ved.); indigo, the dye; black salt (= काच-लवण); blue vitriol (= तुत्थ); antimony (= सौवीराञ्जन); poison (= तालीश-पत्त्र); a peculiar position in dancing; a kind of metre con-sisting of four times sixteen syllables; [cf. Lat. niger for nigro = निश्-र।] —नील-कणा, f. a species of cumin. —नील-कण्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-necked; (अस्), m. a peacock; a species of gallinule or water-hen (= दात्यूह); a wag-tail; a sparrow; a blue-necked jay; the plant Hyperanthera Moringa (= पीत-सार); an epithet of Śiva (as having a black throat, so stained by the acrimony of the poison which he swallowed on its production at the churn-ing of the ocean); N. of several authors and com-mentators; (अम्), n. a radish; [cf. काल-कण्ठ।] —नीलकण्ठ-चम्पू, ऊस्, f., N. of a work by Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita. —नीलकण्ठ-तीर्थ, अम्, n. ‘the bathing-place of Śiva,’ N. of a sacred Tīrtha. —नीलकण्ठ-भारती, m., N. of an author men-tioned in the Sarva-darśana-saṅgraha of Mādhavā-cārya. —नीलकण्ठ-स्तव, अस्, m. ‘the praise of Śiva,’ N. of the fifty-first chapter of the Jñāna-khaṇḍa of the Śiva-Purāṇa. —नीलकण्ठाक्ष (°ठ-अक्°), अम्, n. the berry or seed of Elæocarpus Ganitrus. —नील-कन्द, अस्, m. a species of bulbous plant (= महिष-कन्द-भेद). —नील-कमल, अम्, n. the blue water-lily. —नील-कायिक, आस्, m. pl. (with Buddhists) ‘blue-bodied’ or ‘dark-bodied,’ epithet of a class of deities. —नील-कुन्तला, f., N. of a female friend of Durgā. —नील-कुरण्टक, अस्, m. or नील-कुसुमा, f. or नील-कुरुण्टक, a species of Barleria with blue blossoms (B. Cœrulea, = नील-झिण्टी). —नील-केशी, f. the indigo plant. —नील-क्रान्ता, f. a species of plant (= विष्णु-क्रान्ता). —नील-क्रौञ्च, अस्, m. a species of curlew or heron. —नील-गङ्गा, f., N. of a river. —नील-गणेश, अस्, m. the blue Gaṇeśa. —नील-गर्भ, a young blue water-lily (?). —नील-गिरि-कर्णिका, f. a blue variety of Clitoria Ternatea. —नील-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, blue-necked; (अस्), m. an epithet of Rudra-Śiva or Mahā-deva, (see नील-कण्ठ); N. of a king. —नील-घोर, a various reading for नील-पोर, q. v. —नील-चर्मन्, अ, n. the tree Xylo-carpus Granatum. —नील-च्छद, अस्, m. ‘dark-leaved,’ the date tree; ‘blue-winged,’ an epithet of Garuḍa. —नील-च्छवी, a species of bird (= कुकु; the right form is probably नील-च्छविन्, ई, m.). —नील-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced in the blue mountains; (अम्), n. blue steel; (आ), f. the river Vitastā. —नील-झिण्टी, f. blue Barleria (= नील-कुरण्टक). —नील-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Tantra. —नील-तरु, उस्, m. the cocoa-nut tree. —नील-ता, f. blueness, blackness, a blue or dark colour. —नील-ताल, अस्, m. नु: नु 1. नु, ind. (perhaps related to 1. नव; cf. नूतन), written नू in Ved. at the beginning of a verse and frequently in other places. (As an adverb of time in Ved.), now, still (e. g. नू-च पुरा-च, both now and heretofore; अस्ति स्विन् नु वीर्यं तत् -ते, hast thou still that power?). (As an inferential particle in Ved. often beginning the last sentence of a hymn), now therefore, now then, therefore, then (e. g. नू नो रास्व, do thou therefore give us): (as an introductory particle, or in encouraging, in-voking, inviting, summoning), now, then, pray, come then (e. g. अभि नु मा चक्षमीथाः, pray now [Sāy. quickly] have compassion upon me). नु is often employed in questions, both in Vedic and classical Sanskrit, to strengthen an interrogative pro-noun or adverb (e. g. कदा नु, when indeed? कथं नु, how indeed? क्व नु, where indeed? कं नु पृच्छामि, whom can I possibly ask? किं नु स्यात्, what can that possibly be? किं नु खलु, why in the world?). नु is also used inter-rogatively in classical Sanskrit, without an interro-gative pronoun, in sentences of two or more clauses (e. g. स्वप्नो नु माया नु मति-भ्रमो नु, was it a dream? or an illusion of magic? or a mental delusion?). नु also serves as a particle of affirma-tion, to express ‘indeed,’ ‘certainly,’ ‘surely’ (e. g. अहं नु अकार्षम्, Yes, I certainly did so), and often gives emphasis to the word it follows without being itself translateable, in which way it is frequently connected in the Veda with other particles (e. g. with चिद् in चिन् नु; with इद् in इन् नु; with अध in अध नु; with घ in घा नु, &c.); but in the Veda नु sometimes means ‘never’ (especially in the construction नू चित् = never, nevermore; in other passages it is said to = ‘from this time forward,’ ‘for ever’). In classical Sanskrit नु is sometimes found in connection with वा, ‘or;’ and in Rāmāyaṇa II. 72, 27, नु — नु may be translated ‘either’ — ‘or.’ According to native commentators on the Veda नु often = क्षिप्रम्, quickly. According to native lexicographers नु is used in the following senses: पृच्छा, विकल्प, वितर्क, अनुनय, अतीत, अप-मान, हेतु, अपदेश; [cf. नू-नम्, नू-तन; Zend नू, ‘just now;’ Gr. νύ, νῡ-νί, νῦν; Lat. num, nun-c; Goth. nu-h; Old Germ. nu; Slav. nyne, ‘at present.’]

नैर्देशिक: नैर्देशिक नैर्देशिक, अस्, ई, अम्, servant, servile.
नैर्बाध्य: नैर्बाध्य नैर्बाध्य (fr. निर्-बाध), Ved. (with हविस्) a sort of oblation.

नैविद: नैविद नैविद, अस्, ई, अम्, having a Ni-vid (q. v.).

नैषदिक: नैषदिक नैषदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-षद्), sitting, (not lying down.)
नैषध: नैषध नैषध, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Niṣadha; (अस्), m. a prince of the Niṣadhas, especially an epithet of Nala; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the people of Niṣadha; a species of plant used as food; (अम्), n. or नैषध-चरित, अम्, n., N. of an artificial epic poem by Śrī-harṣa, treating of Nala's adventures. —नैषधचरित-भाव-द्योतनिका, f. ‘an explanation of the meaning of the Naiṣadha-carita,’ N. of a commentary on the preceding poem. —नैषधान्वेषण (°ध-अन्°), अम्, n. the seeking or searching for Naiṣadha, i. e. Nala.

नैषध्य: नैषध्य, अस्, ई, अम्, peculiar or belonging to the Niṣadhas; (अस्), m. a prince of the Ni-ṣadhas.
नैषिध: नैषिध, अस्, m. an epithet of Naḍa, (an earlier form of नैषध above.)
नैषाद: नैषाद नैषाद, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the Niṣādas; (अस्), m. a Niṣāda; (आस्), m. pl. the Niṣāda people.
नैषादि: नैषादि, इस्, m. a prince of the Niṣādas.

नैष्कशतिक: नैष्कशतिक नैष्कशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्क-शत), worth a hundred Niṣkas, bought with them, &c.
नैष्कसहस्रिक: नैष्कसहस्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्क-स-हस्र), worth a thousand Niṣkas, bought with them, &c.
नैष्किक: नैष्किक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्क), bought with a Niṣka, made of a Niṣka, &c.; (अस्), m. a Mint-master, superintendent of a Mint.
नैष्किञ्चन्य: नैष्किञ्चन्य नैष्किञ्चन्य, अम्, n. (fr. निष्-किञ्चन), absence of property, poverty, destitution.
नैष्कृतिक: नैष्कृतिक नैष्कृतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, acting wickedly, wicked, malignant, (probably incorrect for नैकृतिक); free from occupation, disengaged.
नैष्क्रमण: नैष्क्रमण नैष्क्रमण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. निष्-क्रमण), any oblation offered or rite performed when a new-born child is taken out of the house for the first time.
नैष्ठिक: नैष्ठिक नैष्ठिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-ष्ठा), forming the end or conclusion, final, last; conclusive, definitive, decided, accomplished, fixed, firm, con-stant; highest, perfect, complete; completely versed in or familiar with conversant; vowing perpetual abstinence and chastity; belonging to the character or office of a perpetual student; (अस्), m. a perpetual religious student or Brāhman who continues with his spiritual preceptor even after the prescribed term of study is expired and observes the vow of chastity.
नैष्ठ्य: नैष्ठ्य, अम्, n. constancy, steady adherence to rule, firm belief.

नैष्फल्य: नैष्फल्य नैष्फल्य, अम्, n. (fr. निष्-फल), unfruitfulness, fruitlessness, absence of fruit or effect, barrenness, unprofitableness.
नैसर्गिक: नैसर्गिक नैसर्गिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-सर्ग), natural, innate, inherent, constitutional, original; (with Buddhists) cast off, put off.
नैसर्प: नैसर्प नैसर्प, अस्, m. (fr. an unused form नि-सर्प), N. of one of the nine treasures (with Jainas).
नैस्त्रिंशिक: नैस्त्रिंशिक नैस्त्रिंशिक, अस्, m. (fr. निस्-त्रिंश), a swordsman, a soldier armed with a sword.

नोत्: नोत् नोत् or नोद्, ind., Ved. almost, nearly.

नोद्य: नोद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be impelled or driven away or removed.
नोधस्: नोधस् नोधस्, आस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 4. नु), N. of a Ṛṣi with the epithet Gautama.
नोधा: नोधा नोधा, ind. (contracted fr. नव-धा), ninefold, in nine parts.

नौ 2. नौ, नौस्, f. (fr. rt. 4. नु), Ved. speech; [cf. नविष्टि।]

नौ 3. नौ, नौस्, f. (probably fr. rt. स्नु, but said to be fr. rt. 1. नुद्; in Ṛg-veda 1. 97, 8, नावया is Vedic inst. for नावा), a ship, a boat, a vessel; (in astrology) N. of a peculiar appearance on the moon; N. of a constellation; [cf. Gr. ναῦς, ναύ-τη-ς, ναυ-τίλο-ς, ναυ-τίλλο-μαι, ναῦ-λο-ν, ναῦ-σθ-λο-ν, ναυ-τία, ναυ-σία, ναυ-τιά-ω, ναυ-σιά-ω; Lat. nāvis, nau-ta, nāvita, nāv-igare, nav-ig-iu-m; Old Germ. nacho; Angl. Sax. naca; Bavarian naue, ‘a ship;’ Old Iceland. nau-st, ‘a ship station,’ Nōa-tūn; Hib. naoi, noi.] —नाव्-आकार, अस्, आ, अम्, boat-shaped, cymbiform. —नाव्-आरोह, अस्, m. a passenger on board ship, a sailor. —नौ-कर्णधार, अस्, m. the steersman of a ship, a helmsman, pilot. —नौ-कर्णी, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda. —नौ-कर्मन्, अ, n. ‘boat-business,’ the occupation or business of a sailor. —नौ-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, going in a ship, a sailor. —नौ-जीविक, अस्, m. ‘living in ships or boats,’ a sailor, boatman. —नौ-तार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘passable in a boat,’ navigable, to be traversed in a vessel. —नौ-दण्ड, अस्, m. ‘boat-pole,’ an oar. —नौ-बन्धन, अम्, n. ‘ship-binding,’ N. of the highest peak of the Himālayas to which in the great flood Manu fastened his ship. —नौ-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to be a ship, to have been made a ship. —नौ-यान, अम्, n. going in a ship, navigation. —नौ-यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going in a boat or vessel, a passenger; freight. —नौ-वाह, अस्, m. ‘ship-conductor,’ a steersman, pilot, captain. —नौ-व्यसन, अम्, n. ship-wreck, naufrage.
नौक: नौक (at the end of an adj. comp.) = 3. नौ; (आ), f. a small boat or ship; N. of a commentary on the Mantra-mahodadhi by Mahī-dhara. —नौकाकृष्ट (°का-आक्°), अम्, n., N. of a favourable position of the pieces in the game Catur-aṅga; [cf. नृपा-कृष्ट।] —नौका-दण्ड, अस्, m. ‘boat-pole,’ an oar, a paddle.
नौधस: नौधस नौधस, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
न्यग्रोध: न्यग्रोध न्यग्-रोध। See under 2. न्य्-अञ्च्, col. 3.
न्यच्छ: न्यच्छ न्यच्छ, अम्, n. a mole or spot upon the body.
न्यञ्च्: न्यञ्च् 1. न्य्-अञ्च्, cl. 1. P. A. -अचति or -अञ्-चति, -अञ्चितुम्, Ved. to bend down, curve down.

2. न्य्-अञ्च्, न्यङ्, नीची, न्यक् [cf. नीच, p. 512], going downwards, turned or directed downwards, bent down; lying on the face; low, vile, contemptible, base; whole, entire; slow, lazy; नीचा, inst. c. on the ground, (see p. 512, col. 1); (न्यक्), ind. downwards, down, humbly. —न्यग्-जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, of a low or inferior race, low born. —न्यग्-रोध, अस्, m. (= न्यक्-रोह, growing downwards), the Indian fig-tree, Ficus Indica; another tree [cf. शमी]; a fathom, measured by the arms extended; N. of a son of Ugra-sena; of a Brāhman, of a monastery, of a village; (ई or आ), f. Salvinia Cucculata; a medicinal plant (commonly Mohānā). —न्यग्रोध-परिमण्डल, अस्, आ, अम्, being a fathom in circumference; (आ), f. an elegant woman. —न्यग्रोध-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a man.
न्यक्कृ: न्यक्-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make low, lower, humble, humiliate, degrade, treat with dis-respect or contempt, slight. —न्यक्-करण, अम्, n. the act of lowering or degrading, treating with disrespect or contempt. —न्यक्-कार, अस्, m. making low, humiliation, humbling, contempt, disregard, dis-respect. —न्यक्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, humbled, treated with contempt or contumely.
न्यक्न: न्य्-अक्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. bent down. —न्यक्-नाङ्गुलि (°न-अङ्°), इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having the fingers bent.
न्यक्ष: न्य्-अक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् [cf. rt. अक्ष्, which may be connected with rt. अच् = अञ्च्], low, inferior; whole, entire; (अस्), m. a buffalo; an epithet of Paraśu-rāma; (अम्), n. the whole; grass.
न्यग्भू: न्यग्-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, &c., to become low or humble, to humble one's self: Caus. न्यग्-भाव-यति, to cause to become low, humiliate, treat with disrespect. —न्यग्-भाव, अस्, m. humiliation, degra-dation, debasement, contempt. —न्यग्-भावन, अम्, n. humbling, degrading, treating with contempt, defiling. —न्यग्-भावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who lowers or humbles; humbling.
न्यङ्क: न्य्-अङ्क, अस्, m. a particular part of a carriage.

न्यक्त: न्य्-अक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, anointed, smeared; mixed up.

न्यञ्जलिका: न्यञ्जलिका न्य्-अञ्जलिका, f. an Añjali which is directed downwards.
