न्यर्बुद: न्यर्बुद न्य्-अर्बुद, अम्, n., Ved. one hundred millions.
न्यर्बुदि: न्यर्बुदि न्य्-अर्बुदि, इस्, m., N. of a divine being described as taking an active part in war.
न्यवग्रह: न्यवग्रह न्य्-अवग्रह, अस्, m. the accentless vowel at the end of a Pūrva-pada.
न्यवचर्: न्यवचर् न्य्-अव-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -च-रितुम्, to enter into, penetrate.
न्यस्: न्यस् न्य्-अस्, cl. 4. P. -अस्यति, -असितुम्, to throw down, cast down, lay down, set or put down (with loc., e. g. भूमौ, on the ground); to lay down, resign, give up (e. g. जीवितं न्य्-अस्, to lay down one's life); to bring forward, adduce, pro-pound (as an argument &c.); to lay or put down or place upon anything (with loc., e. g. चित्रे न्य्-अस्, to place in a picture, paint, depict; पथि न्य्-अस्, to lay down on the road, give up an occupation, &c.; शिरस्य् आज्ञां न्य्-अस्, to place a command on one's head, i. e. receive a command with due reverence; शापम् मयि न्यस्यति, he lays a curse upon me); to put in, place within (with loc.), to deposit with any one (loc.); to give into any one's keeping, make a de-posit, intrust, deliver, consign, commit; to settle, fix, appoint; to support: Caus. न्य्-आसयति, to cause to put or lay down, &c.
न्यसन: न्य्-असन, अम्, n. casting or laying down, de-positing; delivering, giving up.
न्यस्त: न्य्-अस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thrown or cast down, laid down, placed in or upon, put in, inserted, applied; delivered, deposited, consigned; depicted (e. g. चित्र-न्यस्त, committed to a picture, painted); rested on, leaning, resting; given up, resigned, set aside. —न्यस्त-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘laying down the rod,’ giving up all means of punishment. —न्यस्त-देह, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has laid down the body, dead. —न्यस्त-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has laid down or resigned his weapons, laying down arms; unarmed, defenceless; harmless; epithet of the Manes or deified progenitors.
न्यस्य: 1. न्य्-अस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be deposited; to be ap-pointed to any office (with loc.); to be delivered.
2. न्य्-अस्य, ind. having put down, having laid down, having deposited, having given up, &c.
न्यास: न्य्-आस, अस्, m. putting down, placing, settling, planting or putting down (the feet), stepping, a step; depositing; a deposit, pledge; delivering, intrusting, committing, delivery; putting on colour &c., painting; writing down, writing, impress, stamp, mark; giving up, putting off or away, laying aside; deserting, abandoning; lowering the tone of the voice; bringing forward, adducing; striking or digging in (the claws &c.), seizing (with the claws); con-signing or intrusting anything to the mind; mental appropriation or assignment of various parts of the body to tutelary divinities (accompanied with certain prayers and gesticulations); N. of a commentary on the Kāśikā-vṛtti by Jinendra. —न्यास-धारिन्, ई, m. the holder of a deposit, a mortgagee. —न्यासा-पह्नव (°स-अप्°), अस्, m. repudiation of a deposit. —न्यासी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to make a deposit, deposit anything with a person. —न्यासोद्द्योत (°स-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of a grammatical work.
न्यास न्य्-आस। See under न्य्-अस्, col. 1.
न्यासिन्: न्य्-आसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has abandoned all worldly concerns; (ई), m. a Sannyāsī.
न्यह्न: न्यह्न न्य्-अह्न (?), Ved. the closing day.
न्याकृ: न्याकृ न्य्-आ-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, Ved. to keep back, hold back.
न्याक्य: न्याक्य न्याक्य, अम्, n. fried rice.
न्याग्रोधमूल: न्याग्रोधमूल न्याग्रोधमूल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. न्यग्रोध-मूल), being or situated at the roots of the Ficus Indica.
न्याद: न्याद न्याद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. अद् with नि), eating, feeding.
न्याधा: न्याधा न्य्-आ-धा, cl. 3. P. -दधाति, -धा-तुम्, to fix in, place in, appoint; to put down.
न्याय: न्याय न्य्-आय, अस्, m. (fr. 3. नी, i. e. rt. 5. इ with नि), method, way, rule (lit. that to which any-thing goes back or in which anything goes), model, manner, system, plan, doctrine, right or fit or suitable manner, that which is fitting, fitness, propriety, right, justice, virtue, equity, law, a lawful act; (in gram.) a general or universal rule, an axiom which precedes and must be kept in view in the explanation of special rules; a lawsuit, policy, good government; decision in a lawsuit, judicial sentence, judgment; a celebrated system of Hindū philosophy delivered by Gautama or Gotama in a set of aphorisms divided into five lectures; the proper way of stating an argu-ment, logic, logical philosophy; a logical argument, a complete argument or syllogism (consisting of five members with the Naiyāyikas, viz. प्रतिज्ञा, हेतु, उदाहरण, उपनय, निगमन, and of three members with the Vedāntins); likeness, analogy, apposite illustration; न्यायेन, in the way of, after the manner of (e. g. लीला-न्यायेन, by way of sport, as if in sport; cf. न्याय-तस् below). Placed after a finite verb न्यायम् is said by Pāṇini (VIII. 1, 27, 57) to express either censure or repetition. —न्याय-कल्पलतिका, f., N. of a commentary. —न्याय-कुसु-माञ्जलि, इस्, m., N. of the aphorisms of Udayana; [cf. कुसुमाञ्जलि।] —न्याय-कोकिल (?), अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist teacher. —न्याय-कौस्तुभ, अम्, n., N. of a general work on the Nyāya philosophy. —न्याय-चूडा-मणि, N. of a confuta-tion of the Nyāya system of philosophy in favour of the Vedānta by Mādhava Sarasvatī. —न्याय-चूडामणि-प्रभा, f., N. of a commentary on the preceding work by Caṇḍīśvara. —न्याय-तस्, ind. in a fitting manner, as is fitting; suitably, justly, fitly, according to right or justice. —न्याय-ता, f. or न्याय-त्व, अम्, n. fitness, propriety. —न्याय-द्वार-तार-क-शास्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work. —न्याय-पञ्चानन, अस्, m. an epithet of Jaya-rāma; [cf. पञ्चानन।] —न्याय-बिन्दु, N. of a commentary on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtras by Vaidya-nātha. —न्याय-बोधिनी, f., N. of a commentary on the Tarka-saṅgraha by Go-vardhana Miśra. —न्याय-भाष्य, अम्, n., N. of a commentary on the Nyāya-sūtras by the Ṛṣi Vātsyāyana. —न्याय-भास्कर, N. of a philosophical work. —न्याय-भूषण, अम्, n., N. of a work. —न्याय-मकरन्द, N. of a work on the Nyāya system controverted from the stand-point of the Vedānta. —न्याय-माला-विस्तर, अस्, m., N. of an introduction to the study of the Mīmāṃsā philosophy. —न्याय-रत्नमाला, f., N. of a work on the Mīmāṃsā. —न्याय-लीलावती, N. of an elementary treatise on the Nyāya philosophy. —न्याय-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, acting rightly, behaving properly. —न्याय-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, well behaved, acting with propriety. —न्याय-वागीश, अस्, m. an epithet of Śrī-kṛṣṇa; of Dīkṣita-śrī-kaṇṭha-śarman. —न्याय-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्, prescribed by rule. —न्याय-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the philosophical system of the Nyāya school; logic (as connected with this school). —न्याय-सङ्क्षेप, अस्, m. or न्याय-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. or न्याय-सार, अस् or अम्, m. or n., N. of certain compendious works on the Nyāya philosophy. —न्याय-सारिणी, f. right or fit behaviour; a woman acting or judging rightly. —न्याय-सिद्-धान्त-पञ्चानन, अस्, m. an epithet of Viśva-nātha. —न्यायसिद्धान्त-मञ्जरी, f., N. of a work. —न्याय-सूत्र, अम्, n. the aphorisms of the Nyāya philosophy by Gautama. —न्यायाचार (°य-आच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, acting justly, virtuous. —न्याया-धार (°य-आध्°), अस्, m. ‘receptacle of justice,’ a term applied to any one who is a model of virtue or propriety. —न्यायानुसार-शास्त्र (°य-अन्°), अम्, n., N. of a Buddhist work. —न्यायामृत (°य-अम्°), अम्, n. ‘nectar of Nyāya,’ N. of a Vedānta work by Vyāsa Tīrtha Bindu. —न्यायामृत-त-रङ्गिनी, f., N. of a commentary on the Nyāyāmṛta by Rāma Ācārya. —न्यायार्जित (°य-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, obtained in a regular way. —न्यायालङ्कार-भट्ट (°य-अल्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Śrī-govinda; also of Śrī-maheśvara. —न्यायावली-दी-धिति (°य-आव्°), इस्, f., N. of a commentary on Jaimini. —न्यायोपेत (°य-उप्°), अस्, आ, अम्, accord-ing to rule, right, admitted.
न्यायिन्: न्यायिन्, ई, इनी, ई, right, fit; logical, rational.
न्याय्य: न्याय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, regular, proper, just, right, equitable, fit, suitable, adapted, (sometimes giving a passive sense to the infin.); usual, customary. —न्याय्-य-त्व, अम्, n. fitness, suitableness, propriety.
न्याव्यध्: न्याव्यध् न्य्-आ-व्यध्, cl. 4. P. -विध्यति, -व्यद्धुम्, to cause to burst forth, let loose, set free.
न्युङ्ख: न्युङ्ख न्युङ्ख, अस्, m. a kind of Sāman, the sixfold repetition of the triliteral name of God or ॐ, [cf. न्यूङ्ख]; (अस्, आ, अम्), proper, right; pleasing, agreeable.
न्युच्: न्युच् न्य्-उच्, cl. 4. P. -उच्यति, &c., Ved. to rejoice in, delight in, take pleasure in; (Sāy.) to assent to, agree to.
न्योचनी: न्य्-ओचनी, f., Ved. (probably) a kind of woman's ornament; (Sāy.) a female servant or slave.
न्योचर: न्य्-ओचर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) belonging to or fit for a place.
न्युत्त: न्युत्त न्य्-उत्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. उद् or उन्द् with नि), dipped in, sprinkled.
न्युप्य: न्य्-उप्य, ind. having offered, having presented (cakes &c. to the Manes).
न्युब्ज्: न्युब्ज् न्य्-उब्ज्, cl. 6. P. -उब्जति, &c., to bend down, press down, throw down.
न्युब्ज: न्य्-उब्ज, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or bent downwards, lying on the face or with the face downwards; looking downwards; bent, crooked; hump-backed, crooked-backed (as the result of disease); convex; (अस्), m. the Nyag-rodha tree; a sort of ladle made of Kuśa grass; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Averrhoa Carambola; a vessel used at Śrāddhas. —न्युब्ज-खड्ग, अस्, m. a crooked sword, a sabre.
न्युष्: न्युष् न्य्-उष् [cf. rt. 1. उष्], cl. 1. P. -ओषति, &c., Ved. to burn down; (Sāy.) to consume utterly.
न्यूङ्ख: न्यूङ्ख न्यूङ्ख, अस्, m. the insertion of the sound ओ in different places with variety of prosodial length and accentuation in the recitation of hymns, (this sound may be repeated any number of times in the recitation of Mantras, or may be made long, short, or prolated, or may have different accents.)
न्यूङ्खय: न्यूङ्खय, Nom. P. न्यूङ्खयति, -यितुम्, to insert the Nyūṅkha, (occurring in fut. pass. part. न्यूङ्खनीय and न्यूङ्ख्य); (A. -ते), to make a peculiar sound, to growl.
न्यून: न्यून न्य्-ऊन, अस्, आ, अम् (see ऊन), lessened, diminished, shortened, made smaller, less, inferior, deficient, defective, wanting, destitute, deprived of (e. g. अर्थ-न्यून, deprived of property, destitute of wealth); imperfect or defective in some organ (e. g. पाद-न्यून, having a defect in the feet); low, vile, wicked, despicable, blamable; (अम्), ind. less; (अम्), n. an euphemistic expression for the vulva. —न्यून-ता, f. or न्यून-त्व, अम्, n. inferiority, deficiency, incompleteness. —न्यून-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, deficient in intellect, ignorant, foolish. —न्यून-पञ्चाशद्-भाव, अस्, n. ‘having but forty-nine properties of human nature,’ an idiot. —न्यूनाक्षर (°न-अक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, defective in letters or syllables. —न्यू-नाङ्ग (°न-अङ्°), अस्, ई, अम्, defective in a limb or organ, maimed, mutilated, imperfect. —न्यूनाधिक (°न-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, less or more, unequal. —न्यू-नाधिक-विभाग, अस्, m. unequal partition. —न्यू-नेन्द्रिय (°न-इन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wanting some organ or sense, deficient, imperfect (as blind, deaf, &c.).
न्यूनय: न्यूनय, Nom. P. न्यूनयति, -यितुम्, or न्यूनी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to lessen, diminish, make less.
न्यूह्: न्यूह् न्य्-ऊह् [cf. rt. 2. ऊह्], cl. 1. A. -ओहते or -ऊहते, Ved. to attend to, observe; (Sāy.) to bear up or support completely, (as if fr. rt. 1. ऊह्।)
न्यृ: न्यृ न्य्-ऋ [cf. rt. 4. ऋ], cl. 5. P. -ऋणोति or -ऋण्वति, &c., Ved. to put or place in; to infuse: Caus. न्य्-अर्पयति, -यितुम्, to throw down, cast down, overthrow.
न्यृञ्ज्: न्यृञ्ज् न्य्-ऋञ्ज् [cf. rt. 2. ऋञ्ज्], cl. 6. A. -ऋञ्जते, &c., Ved. to reach, attain, gain, obtain, win; (Sāy.) to propitiate, befriend.
न्यृष्: न्यृष् न्य्-ऋष् [cf. rt. 2. ऋष्], cl. 6. P. -ऋषति, &c., Ved. to press down or under, suppress, hide, cover; to put in; (Sāy.) to attain to.
न्यृष्ट: न्य्-ऋष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed under; (Sāy.) attained to, gained, endowed.
न्ये: न्ये न्य्-ए (= न्य्-आ-इ), cl. 2. P. न्य्-ऐति, &c., Ved. to come or fall into.
न्योकस्: न्योकस् न्य्-ओकस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. belonging to home or one's native country, domestic, home-bred; (Sāy.) dwelling in an eternal mansion, having an eternal abode.
न्योजस्: न्योजस् न्य्-ओजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, powerful.
न्वै: न्वै न्वै for नु-वै, ind., Ved. indeed, really, certainly.
नर्मगर्भ: नर्म-गर्भ; add — the action of the amorous hero in concealment.
निरयिन्: निरयिन्, ई, m. an inhabitant of hell.
निरायति: निर्-आयति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has no future, one whose end is at hand, soon to be destroyed.
निरोष्ठ्य: निर्-ओष्ठ्य, अम्, n. a verse containing no labial letter.
निर्मार्ष्टि: निर्-मार्ष्टि, इस्, f., N. of the wife of Duḥsaha.
निलायन: नि-लायन, अम्, n. the act of hiding one's self.
निष्पात: निष्पात, अस्, m. rapid stroke or dash.
निस्तप्: निस्-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, &c., to melt gold &c. repeatedly, (स् is changed to ष्, unless repeated action is intended, see निष्-टप्।)
निस्व: नि-स्व, अस्, आ, अम्, without soul or spirit, spiritless, weak.
नीराग: नी-राग, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. निस् + राग), without colour, colourless; without feeling or emotion, emo-tionless.
नुत्ति: नुत्ति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 1. नुद्), repelling, removal.
नैहार: नैहार, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नी-हार), produced by fog or mist or dew; misty, dewy.
न्येज्: न्य्-एज्, cl. 1. A. -एजते, &c., to tremble, quake with fear.
